author: William W. Purkey
text: You've gotta dance like there's nobody watching,Love like you'll never be hurt,Sing like there's nobody listening,And live like it's heaven on earth.

author: Elbert Hubbard
text: A friend is someone who knows all about you and still loves you.

author: Elie Wiesel
text: The opposite of love is not hate, it's indifference. The opposite of art is not ugliness, it's indifference. The opposite of faith is not heresy, it's indifference. And the opposite of life is not death, it's indifference.

author: Mahatma Gandhi
text: When I despair, I remember that all through history the way of truth and love have always won. There have been tyrants and murderers, and for a time, they can seem invincible, but in the end, they always fall. Think of it--always.

author: Mahatma Gandhi
text: Where there is love there is life.

author: Jalaluddin Rumi
text: Out beyond ideas of wrongdoing and rightdoing there is a field.I'll meet you there.When the soul lies down in that grassthe world is too full to talk about.

author: Tom Bodett
text: They say a person needs just three things to be truly happy in this world: someone to love, something to do, and something to hope for.

author: Shel Silverstein
text: How many slams in an old screen door? Depends how loud you shut it. How many slices in a bread? Depends how thin you cut it. How much good inside a day? Depends how good you live 'em. How much love inside a friend? Depends how much you give 'em.

author: Emily Dickinson
text: If I can stop one heart from breaking, I shall not live in vain.

author: Bob Marley
text: One love, one heart, one destiny.

author: Friedrich Nietzsche
text: The man of knowledge must be able not only to love his enemies but also to hate his friends.

author: Lisa Schroeder
text: Was it hard?" I ask.Letting go?"Not as hard as holding on to something that wasn't real.

author: Sharon Salzberg
text: You yourself, as much as anybody in the entire universe, deserve your love and affection

author: Elie Wiesel
text: Friendship marks a life even more deeply than love. Love risks degenerating into obsession, friendship is never anything but sharing.

author: Jonathan Safran Foer
text: Time was passing like a hand waving from a train I wanted to be on. I hope you never have to think about anything as much as I think about you.

author: Percy Bysshe Shelley
text: The sunlight claps the earth, and the moonbeams kiss the sea: what are all these kissings worth, if thou kiss not me?

author: Fred Rogers
text: When I say it's you I like, I'm talking about that part of you that knows that life is far more than anything you can ever see or hear or touch. That deep part of you that allows you to stand for those things without which humankind cannot survive. Love that conquers hate, peace that rises triumphant over war, and justice that proves more powerful than greed.

author: Anaïs Nin
text: Throw your dreams into space like a kite, and you do not know what it will bring back, a new life, a new friend, a new love, a new country.

author: Mother Teresa
text: If we have no peace, it is because we have forgotten that we belong to each other.

author: Deb Caletti
text: That's what people do who love you. They put their arms around you and love you when you're not so lovable.

author: Fyodor Dostoyevsky
text: The soul is healed by being with children.

author: Sharon Salzberg
text: You can search throughout the entire universe for someone who is more deserving of your love and affection than you are yourself, and that person is not to be found anywhere. You, yourself, as much as anybody in the entire universe, deserve your love and affection.

author: T.D. Jakes
text: No woman wants to be in submission to a man who isn't in submission to God!

author: John Lennon
text: If someone thinks that peace and love are just a cliche that must have been left behind in the 60s, that's a problem. Peace and love are eternal.

author: Jodi Picoult
text: The damage was permanent; there would always be scars. But even the angriest scars faded over time until it was difficult to see them written on the skin at all, and the only thing that remained was the memory of how painful it had been.

author: Cassandra Clare
text: If there's a thing I've learned in my life it's to not be afraid of the responsibility that comes with caring for other people. What we do for love: those things endure. Even if the people you do them for don't

author: Brené Brown
text: Owning our story can be hard but not nearly as difficult as spending our lives running from it. Embracing our vulnerabilities is risky but not nearly as dangerous as giving up on love and belonging and joy—the experiences that make us the most vulnerable. Only when we are brave enough to explore the darkness will we discover the infinite power of our light.

author: Edgar Allan Poe
text: The best things in life make you sweaty.

author: Jalaluddin Rumi
text: Goodbyes are only for those who love with their eyes. Because for those who love with heart and soul there is no such thing as separation.

author: Mahatma Gandhi
text: The day the power of love overrules the love of power, the world will know peace.

author: Bertrand Russell
text: To fear love is to fear life, and those who fear life are already 3-parts dead.

author: Mahatma Gandhi
text: Whenever you are confronted with an opponent. Conquer him with love.

author: Demi Lovato
text: He's not your prince charming if he doesn't make sure you know that you're his princess.

author: Gabriel García Márquez
text: nothing in this world was more difficult than love.

author: F. Scott Fitzgerald
text: She was beautiful, but not like those girls in the magazines. She was beautiful, for the way she thought. She was beautiful, for the sparkle in her eyes when she talked about something she loved. She was beautiful, for her ability to make other people smile, even if she was sad. No, she wasn't beautiful for something as temporary as her looks. She was beautiful, deep down to her soul. She is beautiful.

author: Karl Lagerfeld
text: Don’t sacrifice yourself too much, because if you sacrifice too much there’s nothing else you can give and nobody will care for you.

author: G.K. Chesterton
text: To love means loving the unlovable. To forgive means pardoning the unpardonable. Faith means believing the unbelievable. Hope means hoping when everything seems hopeless.

author: Charles M. Schulz
text: Are you upset little friend? Have you been lying awake worrying? Well, don't worry...I'm here. The flood waters will recede, the famine will end, the sun will shine tomorrow, and I will always be here to take care of you.

author: Zayn Malik
text: Life is funny. Things change, people change, but you will always be you, so stay true to yourself and never sacrifice who you are for anyone.

author: Ingrid Bergman
text: A kiss is a lovely trick designed by nature to stop speech when words become superfluous.

author: John Keats
text: I am certain of nothing but the holiness of the Heart's affections and the truth of the Imagination.

author: William Wilberforce
text: You may choose to look the other way but you can never say again that you did not know.

author: Marvin J. Ashton
text: Be the one who nurtures and builds. Be the one who has an understanding and a forgiving heart one who looks for the best in people. Leave people better than you found them.

author: Susan Polis Schutz
text: This life is yours. Take the power to choose what you want to do and do it well. Take the power to love what you want in life and love it honestly. Take the power to walk in the forest and be a part of nature. Take the power to control your own life. No one else can do it for you. Take the power to make your life happy.

author: Friedrich Nietzsche
text: Amor Fati – “Love Your Fate”, which is in fact your life.

author: Oscar Wilde
text: Keep love in your heart. A life without it is like a sunless garden when the flowers are dead. The consciousness of loving and being loved brings a warmth and a richness to life that nothing else can bring.

author: Osho
text: One thing: you have to walk, and create the way by your walking; you will not find a ready-made path. It is not so cheap, to reach to the ultimate realization of truth. You will have to create the path by walking yourself; the path is not ready-made, lying there and waiting for you. It is just like the sky: the birds fly, but they don't leave any footprints. You cannot follow them; there are no footprints left behind.

author: Mother Teresa
text: The Simple PathSilence is PrayerPrayer is FaithFaith is LoveLove is ServiceThe Fruit of Service is Peace

author: Martin Luther King Jr.
text: There can be no deep disappointment where there is not deep love.

author: Jason Mraz
text: Transformation is my favorite game and in my experience, anger and frustration are the result of you not being authentic somewhere in your life or with someone in your life. Being fake about anything creates a block inside of you. Life can’t work for you if you don’t show up as you.

author: Christina Westover
text: Unrequited love is the infinite curse of a lonely heart.

author: Jim Henson
text: Only time can heal your broken heart. Just as only time can heal his broken arms and legs.

author: Nicholas Sparks
text: All of sudden, this shooting star went by, and all I could think was that they were listening to us somehow.

author: Emery Allen
text: I feel like a part of my soul has loved you since the beginning of everything.Maybe we’re from the same star.

author: Coco Chanel
text: There is no time for cut-and-dried monotony. There is time for work. And time for love. That leaves no other time.

author: Gerard Way
text: Tears are words the heart can't express

author: Brian Andreas
text: Wanting him to come back before anyone notices part of the world has not moved since he left.

author: Charlie Chaplin
text: Your naked body should only belong to those who fall in love with your naked soul.

author: Pythagoras
text: As long as Man continues to be the ruthless destroyer of lower living beings, he will never know health or peace. For as long as men massacre animals, they will kill each other. Indeed, he who sows the seed of murder and pain cannot reap joy and love.

author: John Milton
text: Freely we serveBecause we freely love, as in our willTo love or not; in this we stand or fall.

author: Jason Mraz
text: It’s strange how dreams get under your skin and give your heart a test for what’s real and what’s imaginary.

author: Turcois Ominek
text: I'm guilty of giving people more chances than they deserve but when I'm done, I'm done.

author: Monique Duval
text: He offered her the world. She said she had her own.

author: Pierre Teilhard de Chardin
text: Someday, after mastering the winds, the waves, the tides and gravity, we shall harness for God the energies of love, and then, for a second time in the history of the world, man will have discovered fire.

author: Margaret Atwood
text: A truth should exist,it should not be usedlike this. If I love youis that a fact or a weapon?

author: Nisargadatta Maharaj
text: Wisdom is knowing I am nothing,Love is knowing I am everything,and between the two my life moves.

author: Cornel West
text: Never forget that justice is what love looks like in public.

author: Jessica Howell
text: Sometimes good things fall apart, so better things can fall together.

author: Alysha Speer
text: Love is hard to find, hard to keep, and hard to forget.

author: Sigmund Freud
text: Whoever loves becomes humble. Those who love have , so to speak , pawned a part of their narcissism.

author: Nicole Krauss
text: If I had a camera,' I said, 'I'd take a picture of you every day. That way I'd remember how you looked every single day of your life.

author: Walter Benjamin
text: The only way of knowing a person is to love them without hope.

author: Chad Sugg
text: Love the trees until their leaves fall off, then encourage them to try again next year.

author: Jason Mraz
text: Frustration and Love can’t exist in the same place at the same time, so get real and start doing what you would rather be doing in life. Love your life. All of it. Even the heavy shit that happened to you when you were 8. All of it was and IS perfect.

author: Richard Feynman
text: Physics isn't the most important thing. Love is.

author: Osho
text: With me, illusions are bound to be shattered. I am here to shatter all illusions. Yes, it will irritate you, it will annoy you - that's my way of functioning and working. I will sabotage you from your very roots! Unless you are totally destroyed as a mind, there is no hope for you.

author: Albert Camus
text: Nothing in life is worth,turning your back on,if you love it.

author: Shannon Hale
text: You are my butterfly and refuse to set you free.

author: Bertrand Russell
text: Those who have never known the deep intimacy and the intense companionship of happy mutual love have missed the best thing that life has to give.

author: Edith Wharton
text: There is one friend in the life of each of us who seems not a separate person, however dear and beloved, but an expansion, an interpretation, of one's self, the very meaning of one's soul.

author: Warren W. Wiersbe
text: Truth without love is brutality, and love without truth is hypocrisy.

author: Federico García Lorca
text: But hurry, let's entwine ourselves as one, our mouth broken, our soul bitten by love, so time discovers us safely destroyed.

author: Simone de Beauvoir
text: One's life has value so long as one attributes value to the life of others, by means of love, friendship, and compassion

author: Dylan Thomas
text: I know we're not saints or virgins or lunatics; we know all the lust and lavatory jokes, and most of the dirty people; we can catch buses and count our change and cross the roads and talk real sentences. But our innocence goes awfully deep, and our discreditable secret is that we don't know anything at all, and our horrid inner secret is that we don't care that we don't.

author: Nicole Yatsonsky
text: Your truest friends are the ones who will stand by you in your darkest moments--because they're willing to brave the shadows with you--and in your greatest moments--because they're not afraid to let you shine.

author: Robert A. Heinlein
text: May you live as long as you wish and love as long as you live.

author: Asa Don Brown
text: Self-talk reflects your innermost feelings.

author: Martin Luther King Jr.
text: Let us not seek to satisfy our thirst for freedom by drinking from the cup of bitterness and hatred.

author: Jalaluddin Rumi
text: Gamble everything for love, if you're a true human being.

author: Jennifer Salaiz
text: How 'bout a shot of truth in that denial cocktail.

author: Oscar Wilde
text: A kiss may ruin a human life

author: Aaron Ben-Ze'ev
text: Sometimes loneliness makes the loudest noise.

author: Charlotte Eriksson
text: I haven’t been very impressed lately.By people,or places,or the way someone said he loved me and then slowly changed his mind.

author: Zelda Fitzgerald
text: I love you, even if there isn’t any me, or any love, or even any life. I love you.

author: Robert Browning
text: how sad and bad and mad it was - but then, how it was sweet

author: Martin Luther King Jr.
text: I believe that unarmed truth and unconditional love will have the final word in reality. This is why right, temporarily defeated, is stronger than evil triumphant.

author: Rick Warren
text: The best use of life is love. The best expression of love is time. The best time to love is now.

author: Pico Iyer
text: We travel, initially, to lose ourselves; and we travel, next to find ourselves. We travel to open our hearts and eyes and learn more about the world than our newspapers will accommodate. We travel to bring what little we can, in our ignorance and knowledge, to those parts of the globe whose riches are differently dispersed. And we travel, in essence, to become young fools again- to slow time down and get taken in, and fall in love once more.

author: Jean Anouilh
text: There is love of course. And then there's life, its enemy.

author: Albert Camus
text: Human relationships always help us to carry on because they always presuppose further developments, a future - and also because we live as if our only task was precisely to have relationships with other people.

author: Zelda Fitzgerald
text: I don't want to live, I want to love first and live incidentally.

author: Nikki Giovanni
text: the world is not a pleasant place to be without someone to hold and be held by.

author: Friedrich Nietzsche
text: The spiritualization of sensuality is called love: it is a great triumph over Christianity.

author: Slavoj Žižek
text: If you have reasons to love someone, you don’t love them.

author: Charles Haddon Spurgeon
text: Faith goes up the stairs that love has built and looks out the windows which hope has opened.

author: L.M. Montgomery
text: A broken heart in real life isn't half as dreadful as it is in books. It's a good deal like a bad tooth, though you won't think THAT a very romantic simile. It takes spells of aching and gives you a sleepless night now and then, but between times it lets you enjoy life and dreams and echoes and peanut candy as if there were nothing the matter with it.

author: Gabriel García Márquez
text: Never stop smiling not even when you're sad, someone might fall in love with your smile.

author: Emery Allen
text: You don't need another Human Being to make your life complete, but let's be honest. Having your wounds kissed by someone who doesn't see them as disasters In your soul, but cracks to put their love into, Is the most calming thing In this World.

author: Joyce Carol Oates
text: The worst thing: to give yourself away in exchange for not enough love.

author: Seth Brown
text: True friends will always push you towards the great possibilities of your future, false friends will always chain you to the mistakes in your past.

author: Lao Tzu
text: We join spokes together in a wheel, but it is the center hole that makes the wagon move.We shape clay into a pot, but it is the emptiness insidethat holds whatever we want.We hammer wood for a house, but it is the inner spacethat makes it livable.We work with being, but non-being is what we use.

author: Pope Benedict XVI
text: If you follow the will of God, you know that in spite of all the terrible things that happen to you, you will never lose a final refuge. You know that the foundation of the world is love, so that even when no human being can or will help you, you may go on, trusting in the One that loves you.

author: Ann Druyan
text: Ten long trips around the sun since I last saw that smile, but only joy and thankfulness that on a tiny world in the vastness, for a couple of moments in the immensity of time, we were one.

author: Nayyirah Waheed
text: If someone does not want me it is not the end of the world. But if I do not want me, the world is nothing but endings.

author: Jeremy Aldana
text: It’s not so much the journey that’s important; as is the way that we treat those we encounter and those around us, along the way

author: Ahmed Deedat
text: Language is the key to the heart of people.

author: Kurt Cobain
text: Peace,love,empathy

author: Rascal Flatts
text: I wake up and tear drops, they fall down like rain. I put on that old song we danced to and then, I head off to my job cause not much has changed. Punch the clock, head for home, check the phone. Just in case. Go to bed, dream of you. That's what I am doing these days.

author: Audre Lorde
text: I want to live the rest of my life, however long or short, with as much sweetness as I can decently manage, loving all the people I love, and doing as much as I can of the work I still have to do. I am going to write fire until it comes out of my ears, my eyes, my noseholes--everywhere. Until it's every breath I breathe. I'm going to go out like a fucking meteor!

author: Emily Dickinson
text: That I shall love always, I argue theethat love is life,and life hath immortality

author: Allan Rufus
text: Your inner strength is your outer foundation

author: Chad Sugg
text: Something amazing happens when you're in love and don't give a damn about what day it is anymore.

author: Jeffrey McDaniel
text: There's two kinds of women--those you write poems about and those you don't.

author: Johnny Depp
text: People say I make strange choices, but they’re not strange for me. My sickness is that I’m fascinated by human behavior, by what’s underneath the surface, by the worlds inside people.

author: Masashi Kishimoto
text: For awhile, I thought that was love.-Gaara

author: Ayn Rand
text: To say ‘I love you’ one must first know how to say the ‘I.’ The meaning of the ‘I’ is an independent, self-sufficient entity that does not exist for the sake of any other person. A person who exists only for the sake of his loved one is not an independent entity, but a spiritual parasite. The love of a parasite is worth nothing.

author: Gerard Way
text: You need just the right amount of 'Fuck the world' and the right amount of belief in something...and you need the right amount of love.

author: Melissa de la Cruz
text: Who knew that the path to a womans heart was through the soul of an honest man?

author: Helen Keller
text: Happiness does not come from without, it comes from within

author: Robert Frost
text: In three words I can sum up everything I've learned about life: it goes on.

author: Oscar Wilde
text: To live is the rarest thing in the world. Most people exist, that is all.

author: Mark Twain
text: Good friends, good books, and a sleepy conscience: this is the ideal life.

author: Allen Saunders
text: Life is what happens to us while we are making other plans.

author: Pablo Picasso
text: Everything you can imagine is real.

author: George Bernard Shaw
text: Life isn't about finding yourself. Life is about creating yourself.

author: Albert Einstein
text: Life is like riding a bicycle. To keep your balance, you must keep moving.

author: Bob Marley
text: Who are you to judge the life I live?I know I'm not perfect-and I don't live to be-but before you start pointing fingers...make sure you hands are clean!

author: Khaled Hosseini
text: But better to get hurt by the truth than comforted with a lie.

author: Mark Twain
text: The fear of death follows from the fear of life. A man who lives fully is prepared to die at any time.

author: Albert Einstein
text: I speak to everyone in the same way, whether he is the garbage man or the president of the university.

author: George Harrison
text: If you don't know where you're going, any road'll take you there

author: Isaac Asimov
text: The saddest aspect of life right now is that science gathers knowledge faster than society gathers wisdom.

author: Gustave Flaubert
text: Do not read, as children do, to amuse yourself, or like the ambitious, for the purpose of instruction. No, read in order to live.

author: Margaret Mead
text: Never doubt that a small group of thoughtful, committed, citizens can change the world. Indeed, it is the only thing that ever has.

author: Gilda Radner
text: I wanted a perfect ending. Now I've learned, the hard way, that some poems don't rhyme, and some stories don't have a clear beginning, middle, and end. Life is about not knowing, having to change, taking the moment and making the best of it, without knowing what's going to happen next.Delicious Ambiguity.

author: Jonathan Swift
text: May you live every day of your life.

author: May Sarton
text: We have to dare to be ourselves, however frightening or strange that self may prove to be.

author: Oscar Wilde
text: Anyone who lives within their means suffers from a lack of imagination.

author: John Lennon
text: When I was 5 years old, my mother always told me that happiness was the key to life. When I went to school, they asked me what I wanted to be when I grew up. I wrote down ‘happy’. They told me I didn’t understand the assignment, and I told them they didn’t understand life.

author: George Bernard Shaw
text: A life spent making mistakes is not only more honorable, but more useful than a life spent doing nothing.

author: Abigail Van Buren
text: The best index to a person's character is how he treats people who can't do him any good, and how he treats people who can't fight back.

author: Audrey Hepburn
text: The most important thing is to enjoy your life—to be happy—it's all that matters.

author: Stephen King
text: Monsters are real, and ghosts are real too. They live inside us, and sometimes, they win.

author: Alan Moore
text: My experience of life is that it is not divided up into genres; it’s a horrifying, romantic, tragic, comical, science-fiction cowboy detective novel. You know, with a bit of pornography if you're lucky.

author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
text: Do not go where the path may lead, go instead where there is no path and leave a trail.

author: Arthur C. Clarke
text: Two possibilities exist: either we are alone in the Universe or we are not. Both are equally terrifying.

author: Albert Camus
text: Nobody realizes that some people expend tremendous energy merely to be normal.

author: Margaret Mitchell
text: Life's under no obligation to give us what we expect.

author: Albert Schweitzer
text: Sometimes our light goes out, but is blown again into instant flame by an encounter with another human being.

author: E.E. Cummings
text: Unbeing dead isn't being alive.

author: Kalu Ndukwe Kalu
text: The things you do for yourself are gone when you are gone, but the things you do for others remain as your legacy.

author: Gordon B. Hinckley
text: Life is to be enjoyed, not endured

author: John Lennon
text: The more I see, the less I know for sure.

author: Nicolas Chamfort
text: The most wasted of all days is one without laughter.

author: Abraham Lincoln
text: Do I not destroy my enemies when I make them my friends?

author: G.K. Chesterton
text: The true soldier fights not because he hates what is in front of him, but because he loves what is behind him.

author: H. Jackson Brown Jr.
text: Don't say you don't have enough time. You have exactly the same number of hours per day that were given to Helen Keller, Pasteur, Michaelangelo, Mother Teresa, Leonardo da Vinci, Thomas Jefferson, and Albert Einstein.

author: François Rabelais
text: I go to seek a Great Perhaps.

author: Jorge Luis Borges
text: I am not sure that I exist, actually. I am all the writers that I have read, all the people that I have met, all the women that I have loved; all the cities I have visited.

author: Albert Camus
text: Live to the point of tears.

author: Logan Pearsall Smith
text: People say that life is the thing, but I prefer reading.

author: Mark Twain
text: Don't part with your illusions. When they are gone you may still exist, but you have ceased to live.

author: Paul Simon
text: I've got nothing to do today but smile.

author: Emily Dickinson
text: That it will never come again is what makes life so sweet.

author: Haruki Murakami
text: No matter how much suffering you went through, you never wanted to let go of those memories.

author: Anaïs Nin
text: Life shrinks or expands in proportion to one's courage.

author: Émile Zola
text: If you ask me what I came to do in this world, I, an artist, will answer you: I am here to live out loud.

author: Jodi Picoult
text: Once you had put the pieces back together, even though you may look intact, you were never quite the same as you'd been before the fall.

author: Friedrich Nietzsche
text: He who has a why to live for can bear almost any how.

author: Paulo Coelho
text: We can never judge the lives of others, because each person knows only their own pain and renunciation. It's one thing to feel that you are on the right path, but it's another to think that yours is the only path.

author: Eckhart Tolle
text: The past has no power over the present moment.

author: François de La Rochefoucauld
text: No persons are more frequently wrong, than those who will not admit they are wrong.

author: Lao Tzu
text: A good traveler has no fixed plans and is not intent on arriving.

author: Maxine Hong Kingston
text: In a time of destruction, create something.

author: A.A. Milne
text: One of the advantages of being disorganized is that one is always having surprising discoveries.

author: Paulo Coelho
text: Don't waste your time with explanations: people only hear what they want to hear.

author: Frank Zappa
text: If you end up with a boring miserable life because you listened to your mom, your dad, your teacher, your priest, or some guy on television telling you how to do your shit, then you deserve it.

author: Oprah Winfrey
text: You can have it all. Just not all at once.

author: Anaïs Nin
text: We do not grow absolutely, chronologically. We grow sometimes in one dimension, and not in another; unevenly. We grow partially. We are relative. We are mature in one realm, childish in another. The past, present, and future mingle and pull us backward, forward, or fix us in the present. We are made up of layers, cells, constellations.

author: Eleanor Roosevelt
text: The purpose of life is to live it, to taste experience to the utmost, to reach out eagerly and without fear for newer and richer experience.

author: Sylvia Plath
text: Remember, remember, this is now, and now, and now. Live it, feel it, cling to it. I want to become acutely aware of all I’ve taken for granted.

author: Boris Pasternak
text: I don't like people who have never fallen or stumbled. Their virtue is lifeless and it isn't of much value. Life hasn't revealed its beauty to them.

author: Robert Louis Stevenson
text: Life is not a matter of holding good cards, but of playing a poor hand well.

author: John Lennon
text: There's nowhere you can be that isn't where you're meant to be...

author: Confucius
text: It does not matter how slowly you go as long as you do not stop.

author: Dr. Seuss
text: They say I'm old-fashioned, and live in the past, but sometimes I think progress progresses too fast!

author: Bob Marley
text: Better to die fighting for freedom then be a prisoner all the days of your life.

author: Harvey Fierstein
text: Never be bullied into silence. Never allow yourself to be made a victim. Accept no one's definition of your life, but define yourself.

author: Oprah Winfrey
text: Be thankful for what you have; you'll end up having more. If you concentrate on what you don't have, you will never, ever have enough

author: Anaïs Nin
text: Luxury is not a necessity to me, but beautiful and good things are.

author: Ben Okri
text: The most authentic thing about us is our capacity to create, to overcome, to endure, to transform, to love and to be greater than our suffering.

author: Erica Jong
text: I have accepted fear as part of life – specifically the fear of change... I have gone ahead despite the pounding in the heart that says: turn back....

author: Hayley Williams
text: Sometimes it takes a good fall to really know where you stand

author: Stephen Fry

text: The best way to predict your future is to create it.

author: Dave Eggers
text: We are unusual and tragic and alive.

author: Henry Wadsworth Longfellow
text: I do not believe anyone can be perfectly well, who has a brain and a heart

author: Tom Hiddleston
text: We all have two lives. The second one starts when we realize that we only have one.

author: Rick Warren
text: You were made by God and for God and until you understand that, life will never make sense.

author: Libba Bray
text: But we can't go back. We can only go forward.

author: Ernest Hemingway
text: His talent was as natural as the pattern that was made by the dust on a butterfly's wings. At one time he understood it no more than the butterfly did and he did not know when it was brushed or marred. Later he became conscious of his damaged wings and of their construction and he learned to think and could not fly any more because the love of flight was gone and he could only remember when it had been effortless.

author: Bill Watterson
text: Hobbes: Do you think there's a God?Calvin: Well, somebody's out to get me!

author: Zora Neale Hurston
text: I have known the joy and pain of friendship. I have served and been served. I have made some good enemies for which I am not a bit sorry. I have loved unselfishly, and I have fondled hatred with the red-hot tongs of Hell. That's living.

author: Henry Rollins
text: I am ready for whatever's coming. I expect nothing but to be let down or turned away. I am alone. Goddamn. The shit hurts sometimes, but I realize what I am, what I have become.

author: Vincent van Gogh
text: Art is to console those who are broken by life.

author: John Webster
text: Whether we fall by ambition, blood, or lustLike diamonds we are cut with our own dust

author: Mary Tyler Moore
text: You can't be brave if you've only had wonderful things happen to you.

author: Danny Kaye
text: Life is a blank canvas, and you need to throw all the paint on it you can.

author: Thich Nhat Hanh
text: Drink your tea slowly and reverently, as if it is the axis on which the world earth revolves - slowly, evenly, without rushing toward the future.

author: Gustave Flaubert
text: One can be the master of what one does, but never of what one feels.

author: Marcel Proust
text: My destination is no longer a place, rather a new way of seeing.

author: Louis Sachar
text: I'm not saying it's going to be easy. Nothing in life is easy. But that's no reason to give up. You'll be surprised what you can accomplish if you set your mind to it. After all, you only have one life, so you should try to make the most of it.

author: Turcois Ominek
text: Your time is way too valuable to be wasting on people that can't accept who you are.

author: Albert Einstein
text: We know from daily life that we exist for other people first of all, for whose smiles and well-being our own happiness depends.

author: Roy T. Bennett
text: You can have everything you want if you can put your heart and soul into everything you do.

author: Neil deGrasse Tyson
text: We are all connected; To each other, biologically. To the earth, chemically. To the rest of the universe atomically.

author: Oscar Wilde
text: I won't tell you that the world matters nothing, or the world's voice, or the voice of society. They matter a good deal. They matter far too much. But there are moments when one has to choose between living one's own life, fully, entirely, completely—or dragging out some false, shallow, degrading existence that the world in its hypocrisy demands. You have that moment now. Choose!

author: Woody Allen
text: Life is full of misery, loneliness, and suffering - and it's all over much too soon.

author: Friedrich Nietzsche
text: Is life not a thousand times too short for us to bore ourselves?

author: John Lennon
text: Part of me suspects that I'm a loser, and the other part of me thinks I'm God Almighty.

author: Roy T. Bennett
text: Consistency is the true foundation of trust. Either keep your promises or do not make them.

author: Roy T. Bennett
text: Be with someone who inspires you and makes you be the best version of yourself.

author: C.G. Jung
text: Mistakes are, after all, the foundations of truth, and if a man does not know what a thing is, it is at least an increase in knowledge if he knows what it is not.

author: William Stafford
text: Wisdom is having things right in your lifeand knowing why.

author: Albert Einstein
text: The tragedy of life is what dies inside a man while he lives.

author: Deepak Chopra
text: When you make a choice, you change the future.

author: Masashi Kishimoto
text: There's no advantage to hurrying through life." -Shikamaru Nara

author: Ashly Lorenzana
text: We judge others instantly by their clothes, their cars, their appearance, their race, their education, their social status. The list is endless. What gets me is that most people decide who another person is before they have even spoken to them. What's even worse is that these same people decide who someone else is, and don't even know who they are themselves.

author: Kahlil Gibran
text: I slept and I dreamed that life is all joy. I woke and I saw that life is all service. I served and I saw that service is joy.

author: Lana Del Rey
text: Live fast. Die young. Be wild. Have fun.

author: Oliver James
text: Do your own thing on your own terms and get what you came here for

author: Oscar Wilde
text: Life is not complex. We are complex. Life is simple, and the simple thing is the right thing.

author: Tom Hiddleston
text: Stay hungry, stay young, stay foolish, stay curious, and above all, stay humble because just when you think you got all the answers, is the moment when some bitter twist of fate in the universe will remind you that you very much don't.

author: Helen Exley
text: Books can be dangerous. The best ones should be labeled ‘This could change your life’.

author: Steve Jobs
text: I have looked in the mirror every morning and asked myself: "If today were the last day of my life, would I want to do what I am about to do today?" And whenever the answer has been "No" for too many days in a row, I know I need to change something.

author: Charles M. Schulz
text: In the Book of Life, The answers aren't in the back.

author: Sarah Kay
text: Life will hit you hard in the face, wait for you to get back up just so it can kick you in the stomach. But getting the wind knocked out of you is the only way to remind your lungs how much they like the taste of air.

author: Langston Hughes
text: Well, I like to eat, sleep, drink, and be in love.I like to work, read, learn, and understand life.

author: Garrison Keillor
text: I believe in looking reality straight in the eye and denying it.

author: Jim Morrison
text: I think the highest and lowest points are the important ones. Anything else is just...in between.

author: Ann Brashares
text: I'm afraid of time... I mean, I'm afraid of not having enough time. Not enough time to understand people, how they really are, or to be understood myself. I'm afraid of the quick judgements or mistakes everybody makes. You can't fix them without time. I'm afraid of seeing snapshots, not movies.

author: Joyce Meyer
text: Spending time with God is the key to our strength and success in all areas of life. Be sure that you never try to work God into your schedule, but always work your schedule around Him.

author: Vladimir Nabokov
text: Let all of life be an unfettered howl.

author: Irving Berlin
text: Life is 10 percent what you make itand 90 percent how you take it.

author: Martha Graham
text: All that is important is this one moment in movement. Make the moment important, vital, and worth living. Do not let it slip away unnoticed and unused.

author: A.J. Russell
text: All sacrifice and suffering is redemptive. It is used to either teach the individual or to help others. Nothing is by chance.

author: Sean Mangan
text: Life is too short when you think of the length of death

author: Anthony Robbins
text: I've come to believe that all my past failure and frustration were actually laying the foundation for the understandings that have created the new level of living I now enjoy.

author: Alan W. Watts
text: The art of living... is neither careless drifting on the one hand nor fearful clinging to the past on the other. It consists in being sensitive to each moment, in regarding it as utterly new and unique, in having the mind open and wholly receptive.

author: Edward Gorey
text: I really think I write about everyday life. I don't think I'm quite as odd as others say I am. Life is intrinsically, well, boring and dangerous at the same time. At any given moment the floor may open up. Of course, it almost never does; that's what makes it so boring.

author: Helen Keller
text: A bend in the road is not the end of the road…Unless you fail to make the turn.

author: Nicholas Sparks
text: I'm sure you think that I don't understand what you're going through, but I do. It's just that sometimes, our future is dictated by what we are, opposed to what we want.

author: Stephen Hawking
text: I have noticed that even those who assert that everything is predestined and that we can change nothing about it still look both ways before they cross the street

author: Lana Del Rey
text: We have nothing to lose, nothing to gain, nothing we desired anymore- except to make our lives into a work of art.

author: Hazrat Ali Ibn Abu-Talib A.S
text: Do not let your difficulties fill you with anxiety, after all it is only in the darkest nights that stars shine more brightly.

author: Stephen Hawking
text: My expectations were reduced to zero when I was 21. Everything since then has been a bonus.", December 12, 2004)]

author: The Subject Tonight Is Love: 60 Wild and Sweet Poems of Hafiz
text: For a day, just for one day,Talk about that which disturbs no oneAnd bring some peace into yourBeautiful eyes.

author: Arundhati Roy
text: Another world is not only possible, she is on her way. On a quiet day, I can hear her breathing.

author: Thornton Wilder
text: We can only be said to be alive in those moments when our hearts are conscious of our treasures.

author: Jimmy Carter
text: We should live our lives as though Christ was coming this afternoon.

author: Chuck Palahniuk
text: You know how both life and porno movies end. The only difference is life starts with the orgasm.

author: Confucius
text: Forget injuries, never forget kindnesses.

author: Roy T. Bennett
text: When you lose your smile, you lose your way in the chaos of life.

author: James J. Lachard
text: Man surprised me most about humanity. Because he sacrifices his health in order to make money.Then he sacrifices money to recuperate his health. And then he is so anxious about the future that he does not enjoy the present; the result being that he does not live in the present or the future; he lives as if he is never going to die, and then dies having never really lived.

author: John Burroughs
text: I still find each day too short for all the thoughts I want to think, all the walks I want to take, all the books I want to read, and all the friends I want to see.

author: George Orwell
text: At 50, everyone has the face he deserves.

author: Eric Berne
text: The moment a little boy is concerned with which is a jay and which is a sparrow, he can no longer see the birds or hear them sing.

author: Angela Schwindt
text: While we try to teach our children all about life, our children teach us what life is all about.

author: Albert Camus
text: A man's work is nothing but this slow trek to rediscover, through the detours of art, those two or three great and simple images in whose presence his heart first opened.

author: Wiz Khalifa
text: I don’t chase after anyone, If you wanna walk out of my life, then I’ll hold the fucking door open for you.

author: Anaïs Nin
text: Dreams are necessary to life.

author: J.A. Konrath
text: One of the greatest journeys in life is overcoming insecurity and learning to truly not give a shit.

author: Anne Sexton
text: Live or die, but don't poison everything.

author: Charles Baudelaire
text: What strange phenomena we find in a great city, all we need do is stroll about with our eyes open. Life swarms with innocent monsters.

author: Henry David Thoreau
text: It is not worth the while to let our imperfections disturb us always.

author: Roy T. Bennett
text: If you care about something enough, you'll find a way to make it happen.

author: André Gide
text: The true hypocrite is the one who ceases to perceive his deception, the one who lies with sincerity.

author: John Steinbeck
text: Power does not corrupt. Fear corrupts... perhaps the fear of a loss of power.

author: Confucius
text: Give a bowl of rice to a man and you will feed him for a day. Teach him how to grow his own rice and you will save his life.

author: Goldie Hawn
text: You often meet your fate on the road you take to avoid it.

author: Julio Cortázar
text: Creo que todos tenemos un poco de esa bella locura que nos mantiene andando cuando todo alrededor es tan insanamente cuerdo.

author: Jonathan Safran Foer
text: It has shown me that everything is illuminated in the light of the past. It is always along the side of us...on the inside, looking out.

author: Erol Ozan
text: Some beautiful paths can't be discovered without getting lost.

author: James Russell Lowell
text: Fate loves the fearless.

author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
text: Sorrow looks back, Worry looks around, Faith looks up

author: Virginia Euwer Wolff
text: Rise to the occassion which is life!

author: H.P. Lovecraft
text: I never ask a man what his business is, for it never interests me. What I ask him about are his thoughts and dreams.

author: Marjorie Pay Hinckley
text: The trick is to enjoy life. Don't wish away your days, waiting for better ones ahead.

author: Ani DiFranco
text: Art is the reason I get up in the morning, but the definition ends there. It doesn't seem fair that I'm living for something I can't even define.

author: Ron White
text: I believe when life gives you lemons, you should make lemonade...and try to find someone whose life has given them vodka, and have a party.

author: Joseph Brodsky
text: Life—the way it really is—is a battle not between good and bad, but between bad and worse

author: Steve Martin
text: Be so good they can't ignore you.

author: Baltasar Gracián
text: Never compete with someone who has nothing to lose.

author: Orson Welles
text: I don't pray really, because I don't want to bore God.

author: Helen Keller
text: Everything has its wonders, even darkness and silence, and I learn, whatever state I may be in, therein to be content

author: Rai Aren
text: I made the choice to be vegan because I will not eat (or wear, or use) anything that could have an emotional response to its death or captivity. I can well imagine what that must feel like for our non-human friends - the fear, the terror, the pain - and I will not cause such suffering to a fellow living being.

author: Roy T. Bennett
text: Real change is difficult at the beginning. Without the familiar to rely upon, you may not in as much command as you had once been. When things are not going your way, you will start doubting yourself. Stay positive, keep the faith, and keep moving forward – your breakthrough may be just around the corner.

author: Sam Levenson
text: For beautiful eyes, look for the good in others; for beautiful lips, speak only words of kindness; and for poise, walk with the knowledge that you are never alone.

author: Michel Houellebecq
text: The absence of the will to live is, alas, not sufficient to make one want to die.

author: Diane Von Furstenberg
text: The most important relationship in your life is the relationship you have with yourself. Because no matter what happens, you will always be with yourself.

author: Richard Brautigan
text: all of us have a place in history. mine is clouds.

author: Henrik Ibsen
text: To live is to war with trolls.

author: Robert Frost
text: And were an epitaph to be my story I'd have a short one ready for my own. I would have written of me on my stone: I had a lover's quarrel with the world.

author: Tehyi Hsieh
text: Life is partly what we make it, and partly what it is made by the friends we choose.

author: Hilary Duff
text: People are going to say what they want to say and think what they want to think, and I can't change their minds.

author: Roy T. Bennett
text: You make the world a better place by making daily improvements to become the best version of yourself.

author: Kobayashi Issa
text: Never forget:we walk on hell,gazing at flowers.

author: Emil M. Cioran
text: Man starts over again everyday, in spite of all he knows, against all he knows.

author: Zayn Malik
text: No matter how hard life is, don't lose hope

author: Tennessee Williams
text: You can be young without money, but you can't be old without it.

author: Ida Scott Taylor McKinney
text: Do not look back and grieve over the past, for it is gone; and do not be troubled about the future, for it has yet to come. Live in the present, and make it so beautiful that it will be worth remembering

author: Audrey Hepburn
text: My life isn’t theories and formulae. It’s part instinct, part common sense. Logic is as good a word as any, and I’ve absorbed what logic I have from everything and everyone… from my mother, from training as a ballet dancer, from Vogue magazine, from the laws of life and health and nature.

author: Tennessee Williams
text: Why did I write? Because I found life unsatisfactory.

author: Ana Monnar
text: Whatever is going to happen will happen, whether we worry or not.

author: Dan Howell
text: My only regrets are the moments when i doubted myself and took the safe route. Life is too short to waste time being unhappy.

author: Immanuel Kant
text: One who makes himself a worm cannot complain afterwards if people step on him.

author: Oprah Winfrey
text: We can't become what we need to be by remaining what we are.

author: Susan Ertz
text: ... millions long for immortality who don't know what to do with themselves on a rainy Sunday afternoon.

author: Evanescence
text: If people make fun of you, that probably means you're doing something right.

author: Charles de Lint
text: We're all made of stories. When they finally put us underground, the stories are what will go on. Not forever, perhaps, but for a time. It's a kind of immortality, I suppose, bounded by limits, it's true, but then so's everything.

author: Shaun Hick
text: You need to spend time crawling alone through shadows to truly appreciate what it is to stand in the sun.

author: Meher Baba
text: Don't Worry Be Happy

author: Eckhart Tolle
text: Realize deeply that the present moment is all you will ever have.

author: Hilary Duff
text: I can’t really act the way I want to act, or say what I want to say all the time. And a lot of times, I cover that up with a smile.

author: Roy T. Bennett
text: If you have kindness in your heart, you offer acts of kindness to touch the hearts of others wherever you go—whether they are random or planned. Kindness becomes a way of life.

author: Gerard Way
text: Being happy doesn't mean that everything is perfect. It means that you've decided to look beyond the imperfections.

author: Franz Kafka
text: He is terribly afraid of dying because he hasn’t yet lived.

author: Carrie Fisher
text: I don’t want life to imitate art. I want life to be art.

author: Neil Gaiman
text: Normally, in anything I do, I'm fairly miserable. I do it, and I get grumpy because there is a huge, vast gulf, this aching disparity, between the platonic ideal of the project that was living in my head, and the small, sad, wizened, shaking, squeaking thing that I actually produce.

author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
text: Life is a series of surprises and would not be worth taking or keeping if it were not.

author: Emil M. Cioran
text: The fact that life has no meaning is a reason to live --moreover, the only one.

author: Madonna
text: Sometimes you have to be a bitch to get things done.

author: Jalaluddin Rumi
text: This place is a dream. Only a sleeper considers it real. Then death comes like dawn, and you wake up laughing at what you thought was your grief.

author: Robin Hood
text: Rise and rise again until lambs become lions

author: Deepak Chopra
text: Mathematics expresses values that reflect the cosmos, including orderliness, balance, harmony, logic, and abstract beauty.

author: Czesław Miłosz
text: LearningTo believe you are magnificent. And gradually to discover that you are not magnificent. Enough labor for one human life.

author: Dolly Parton
text: If you don’t like the road you’re walking, start paving another one.

author: Rita Mae Brown
text: I finally figured out the only reason to be alive is to enjoy it.

author: Carl Sandburg
text: Life is like an onion; you peel it off one layer at a time, and sometimes you weep.

author: Leo Babauta
text: The way I define happiness is being the creator of your experience, choosing to take pleasure in what you have, right now, regardless of the circumstances, while being the best you that you can be.

author: Alain de Botton
text: There is no such thing as work-life balance. Everything worth fighting for unbalances your life.

author: Gordon B. Hinckley
text: It is not so much the major events as the small day-to-day decisions that map the course of our living. . . Our lives are, in reality, the sum total of our seemingly unimportant decisions and of our capacity to live by those decisions.

author: Roy T. Bennett
text: Keep your promises and be consistent. Be the kind of person others can trust.

author: Rabindranath Tagore
text: Let your life lightly dance on the edges of Time like dew on the tip of a leaf.

author: Arthur Schopenhauer
text: What disturbs and depresses young people is the hunt for happiness on the firm assumption that it must be met with in life. From this arises constantly deluded hope and so also dissatisfaction. Deceptive images of a vague happiness hover before us in our dreams, and we search in vain for their original. Much would have been gained if, through timely advice and instruction, young people could have had eradicated from their minds the erroneous notion that the world has a great deal to offer them.

author: Marcus Tullius Cicero
text: While there's life, there's hope.

author: John Berger
text: Autobiography begins with a sense of being alone. It is an orphan form.

author: Lana Del Rey
text: Find someone who has a life that you want and figure out how they got it. Read books, pick your role models wisely. Find out what they did and do it.

author: Brad Meltzer
text: We are all ordinary. We are all boring. We are all spectacular. We are all shy. We are all bold. We are all heroes. We are all helpless. It just depends on the day.

author: Charles Baudelaire
text: Life has but one true charm: the charm of the game. But what if we’re indifferent to whether we win or lose?

author: Yoko Ono
text: Each time we don't say what we wanna say, we're dying.

author: David McCullough
text: To me, history ought to be a source of pleasure. It isn't just part of our civic responsibility. To me, it's an enlargement of the experience of being alive, just the way literature or art or music is."; NEH 2003 Jefferson Lecturer interview profile]

author: Leo Babauta
text: Instead of focusing on how much you can accomplish, focus on how much you can absolutely love what you’re doing.

author: Tom Hiddleston
text: Never stop. Never stop fighting. Never stop dreaming. And don’t be afraid of wearing your heart on your sleeve - in declaring the films that you love, the films that you want to make, the life that you’ve had, and the lives you can help reflect in cinema. For myself, for a long time… maybe I felt inauthentic or something, I felt like my voice wasn’t worth hearing, and I think everyone’s voice is worth hearing. So if you’ve got something to say, say it from the rooftops.

author: Lin Yutang
text: If you can spend a perfectly useless afternoon in a perfectly useless manner, you have learned how to live

author: Joseph Heller
text: I want to keep my dreams, even bad ones, because without them, I might have nothing all night long.

author: Lana Del Rey
text: I used to wonder if it was God's plan that I should be alone for so much of my life. But I found peace. I found happiness within people and the world.

author: Robert Brault
text: Having perfected our disguise, we spend our lives searching for someone we don’t fool.

author: Oprah Winfrey
text: Doing the best at this moment puts you in the best place for the mext moment

author: Federico García Lorca
text: I know there is no straight road No straight road in this world Only a giant labyrinth Of intersecting crossroads

author: H.P. Lovecraft
text: Contrary to what you may assume, I am not a pessimist but an indifferentist- that is, I don't make the mistake of thinking that the... cosmos... gives a damn one way or the other about the especial wants and ultimate welfare of mosquitoes, rats, lice, dogs, men, horses, pterodactyls, trees, fungi, dodos, or other forms of biological energy.

author: Helen Keller
text: People don’t like to think, if one thinks, one must reach conclusions. Conclusions are not always pleasant.

author: Robert W. Service
text: There's a race of men that don't fit in, A race that can't sit still;So they break the hearts of kith and kin, And they roam the world at will.They range the field and rove the flood, And they climb the mountain's crest; Their's is the curse of the gypsy blood, And they don't know how to rest.

author: Albert Camus
text: There is but one truly serious philosophical problem and that is suicide. Judging whether life is or is not worth living amounts to answering the fundamental question of philosophy. All the rest — whether or not the world has three dimensions, whether the mind has nine or twelve categories — comes afterwards. These are games; one must first answer.

author: Ray Bradbury
text: Self-consciousness is the enemy of all art, be it acting, writing, painting, or living itself, which is the greatest art of all.

author: Conan O'Brien
text: When all else fails, there's always delusion.

author: Bill Watterson
text: CALVIN:When I grow up I want to be an inventor. First I will invent a time machine. Then I'll come back to yesterday and take myself to tomorrow and skip this dumb assignment.

author: Epictetus
text: Freedom is the only worthy goal in life. It is won by disregarding things that lie beyond our control.

author: Bill Watterson
text: CALVIN:As usual goodness hardly puts up a fight.

author: Franz Kafka
text: All I am is literature, and I am not able or willing to be anything else.

author: Red Haircrow
text: Dance above the surface of the world. Let your thoughts lift you into creativity that is not hampered by opinion.

author: Woody Allen
text: You rely too much on brain. The brain is the most overrated organ.

author: Leo Tolstoy
text: The best stories don't come from "good vs. bad" but "good vs. good.

author: Marvin Gaye
text: If you cannot find peace within yourself, you will never find it anywhere else.

author: Ken Levine
text: We all make choices, but in the end our choices make us.

author: King James Gadsden
text: Life keeps throwing me lemons because I make the best lemonade...

author: Anaïs Nin
text: All those who try to unveil the mysteries always have tragic lives. At the end they are always punished.

author: Christopher    Rice
text: Everyday is a bank account, and time is our currency. No one is rich, no one is poor, we've got 24 hours each.

author: al-Hasan al-Basri
text: The world is 3 days: As for yesterday, it has vanished along with all that was in it. As for tomorrow, you may never see it. As for today, it is yours, so work on it.

author: Thisuri Wanniarachchi
text: Life is at its best when everything has fallen out of place, and you decide that you're going to fight to get them right, not when everything is going your way and everyone is praising you.

author: A.W. Tozer
text: Sometimes I go to God and say, "God, if Thou dost never answer another prayer while I live on this earth, I will still worship Thee as long as I live and in the ages to come for what Thou hast done already. God’s already put me so far in debt that if I were to live one million millenniums I couldn’t pay Him for what He’s done for me.

author: Christopher McCandless
text: The very basic core of a man's living spirit is his passion for adventure. The joy of life comes from our encounters with new experiences, and hence there is no greater joy than to have an endlessly changing horizon, for each day to have a new and different sun.

author: Masashi Kishimoto
text: Being hurt inevitably breeds feelings of hatred towards your attacker. But when we hurt others, we have to deal with their hatred for us, and our own feelings of guilt. Knowing what it feels like to be hurt is exactly why we try to be kind to others. That’s what makes us humans.

author: John von Neumann
text: If people do not believe that mathematics is simple, it is only because they do not realize how complicated life is.

author: Matt Smith
text: I think, that if the world were a bit more like ComicCon, it would be a better place.

author: Ansel Adams
text: In wisdom gathered over time I have found that every experience is a form of exploration.

author: Fred Rogers
text: The connections we make in the course of a life--maybe that's what heaven is.

author: Leo Babauta
text: The life you have left is a gift. Cherish it. Enjoy it now, to the fullest. Do what matters, now.

author: Gautama Buddha
text: Those who have failed to work toward the truth have missed the purpose of living.

author: Karl Lagerfeld
text: People who say that yesterday was better than today are ultimately devaluing their own existence.

author: Roy T. Bennett
text: Keep your mind open. The meaning of things lies in how people perceive them. The same thing could mean different meanings to the same people at different times.

author: Tom Robbins
text: In the haunted house of life, art is the only stair that doesn't creak.

author: Bill Watterson
text: To invent your own life's meaning is not easy, but it's still allowed, and I think you'll be happier for the trouble.

author: Bob Dylan
text: It frightens me, the awful truth, of how sweet life can be...

author: Andy Rooney
text: It's paradoxical that the idea of living a long life appeals to everyone, but the idea of getting old doesn't appeal to anyone.

author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry
text: That is the hardest thing of all. It is much harder to judge yourself than to judge others. If you succeed in judging yourself, it's because you're truly a wise man.

author: Douglas Pagels
text: Each new day is a blank page in the diary of your life. The secret of success is in turning that diary into the best story you possibly can.

author: Marcus Garvey
text: If you haven't confidence in self, you are twice defeated in the race of life. With confidence, you have won even before you have started.

author: Kurt Vonnegut Jr.
text: Those who cannot remember the past are condemned to repeat it." (George Santayana)I've got news for Mr. Santayana: we're doomed to repeat the past no matter what. That's what it is to be alive.

author: Carl Sandburg
text: A man must find time for himself. Time is what we spend our lives with. If we are not careful we find others spending it for us. . . . It is necessary now and then for a man to go away by himself and experience loneliness; to sit on a rock in the forest and to ask of himself, 'Who am I, and where have I been, and where am I going?' . . . If one is not careful, one allows diversions to take up one's time—the stuff of life.

author: Kurt Cobain
text: There are a lot of things I wish I would have done, instead of just sitting around and complaining about having a boring life.

author: Lao Tzu
text: In dwelling, live close to the ground. In thinking, keep to the simple. In conflict, be fair and generous. In governing, don't try to control. In work, do what you enjoy. In family life, be completely present.

author: Gregory David Roberts
text: If fate doesn't make you laugh, you just don't get the joke.

author: Hayao Miyazaki
text: Life is a winking light in the darkness.

author: Peter Stone
text: In my many years I have come to a conclusion that one useless man is a shame, two is a law firm, and three or more is a congress.

author: Anna Wintour
text: It’s always about timing. If it’s too soon, no one understands. If it’s too late, everyone’s forgotten.

author: Charles M. Schulz
text: Well, I can understand how you feel. You worked hard, studying for the spelling bee, and I suppose you feel you let everyone down, and you made a fool of yourself and everything. But did you notice something, Charlie Brown?" "What's that?""The world didn't come to an end.

author: Albert Einstein
text: Dancers are the athletes of God.

author: C.G. Jung
text: How can I be substantial if I do not cast a shadow? I must have a dark side also If I am to be whole

author: Joseph Campbell
text: The first step to the knowledge of the wonder and mystery of life is the recognition of the monstrous nature of the earthly human realm as well as its glory, the realization that this is just how it is and that it cannot and will not be changed. Those who think they know how the universe could have been had they created it, without pain, without sorrow, without time, without death, are unfit for illumination.

author: Truman Capote
text: Life is a moderately good play with a badly written third act.

author: Frances E. Willard
text: The world is wide, and I will not waste my life in friction when it could be turned into momentum.

author: Hazrat Ali Ibn Abu-Talib A.S
text: Life consists of two days, one for you one against you. So when it's for you don't be proud or reckless, and when it's against you be patient, for both days are test for you.

author: Chetan Bhagat
text: Life is not to be taken seriously, as we are really temporary here. We are like a pre-paid card with limited validity. If we are lucky, we may last another 50 years. And 50 years is just 2,500 weekends. Do we really need to get so worked up? It’s ok, bunk a few classes, goof up a few interviews, fall in love. We are people, not programmed devices.

author: Martin Luther King Jr.
text: It may be true that the law cannot make a man love me, but it can stop him from lynching me, and I think that's pretty important.

author: H.L. Mencken
text: You can't do anything about the length of your life, but you can do something about its width and depth.

author: Lily Tomlin
text: I said "Somebody should do something about that." Then I realized I am somebody.

author: Brian Cox
text: We are the cosmos made conscious and life is the means by which the universe understands itself.

author: Sakyong Mipham
text: Like gravity, karma is so basic we often don't even notice it.

author: Mario Puzo
text: Keep your friends close but your enemies closer.

author: Gordon B. Hinckley
text: Through all of living have much joy and laughter, life is to be enjoyed, not just endured.

author: Annie Dillard
text: Spend the afternoon, you can't take it with you.

author: Og Mandino
text: Count your blessings. Once you realize how valuable you are and how much you have going for you, the smiles will return, the sun will break out, the music will play, and you will finally be able to move forward the life that God intended for you with grace, strength, courage, and confidence.

author: Jean-Jacques Rousseau
text: Or, rather, let us be more simple and less vain.

author: Eddie Cantor
text: Slow down and enjoy life. It's not only the scenery you miss by going too fast - you also miss the sense of where you are going and why.

author: Diane Von Furstenberg
text: You're always with yourself, so you might as well enjoy the company.

author: Jean Webster
text: I'm going to enjoy every second, and I'm going to know I'm enjoying it while I'm enjoying it. Most people don't live; they just race. They are trying to reach some goal far away on the horizon, and in the heat of the going they get so breathless and panting that they lose sight of the beautiful, tranquil country they are passing through; and then the first thing they know, they are old and worn out, and it doesn't make any difference whether they've reached the goal or not.

author: Seneca
text: Life is like a play: it's not the length, but the excellence of the acting that matters.

author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
text: Imitation is suicide.

author: Angelina Jolie
text: You'd think, 'What if I make a mistake today, I'll regret it'. I don’t believe in regret, I feel everything leads us to where we are and we have to just jump forward, mean well, commit and just see what happens.

author: Eric Wright
text: But instead of spending our lives running towards our dreams, we are often running away from a fear of failure or a fear of criticism.

author: Alan W. Watts
text: If you say that getting the money is the most important thing, you'll spend your life completely wasting your time. You'll be doing things you don't like doing in order to go on living, that is to go on doing thing you don't like doing, which is stupid.

author: Stuart Chase
text: For those who believe, no proof is necessary. For those who don't believe, no proof is possible.

author: Richard Bach
text: No matter how qualified or deserving we are, we will never reach a better life until we can imagine it for ourselves and allow ourselves to have it.

author: Maya Angelou
text: My life has been one great big joke,A dance that's walked,A song that's spoke,I laugh so hard I almost choke,When I think about myself.

author: Claudia Gray
text: Everyone is lonely, we have to remember that life is to be lived one day at a time. You cannot worry about the past or future. Happiness is in the now.

author: Leonardo da Vinci
text: All our knowledge has its origin in our perceptions

author: Carl Sagan
text: A celibate clergy is an especially good idea, because it tends to suppress any hereditary propensity toward fanaticism.

author: Anton Chekhov
text: You have lost your reason and taken the wrong path. You have taken lies for truth, and hideousness for beauty. You would marvel if, owing to strange events of some sorts, frogs and lizards suddenly grew on apple and orange trees instead of fruit, or if roses began to smell like a sweating horse; so I marvel at you who exchange heaven for earth. I don't want to understand you.

author: D.H. Lawrence
text: Life is ours to be spent, not tobe saved.

author: Denis Waitley
text: There are two primary choices in life: to accept conditions as they exist, or accept the responsibility for changing them

author: David Rossi
text: Scars show us where we have been, they do not dictate where we are going.

author: Samuel Beckett
text: No, I regret nothing, all I regret is having been born, dying is such a long tiresome business I always found.

author: Roy T. Bennett
text: If you care about someone enough, you’ll always be there for them no matter what.

author: Bono
text: Stop asking God to bless what you're doing. Find out what God's doing. It's already blessed.

author: Jeanette Winterson
text: Do you wake up as I do, having forgotten what it is that hurts or where, until you move? There is a second of consciousness that is clean again. A second that is you, without memory or experience, the animal warm and waking into a brand new world. There is the sun dissolving the dark, and light as clear as music, filling the room where you sleep and the other rooms behind your eyes.

author: Carroll Bryant
text: Know who you are, and be it. Know what you want, and go out and get it!

author: Elizabeth I
text: The past can not be cured.

author: T.S. Eliot
text: There is one who remembers the way to your door: Life you may evade, but Death you shall not.

author: Masashi Kishimoto
text: One day you will be the one called Master (Naruto). You'll be the one to treat others to ramen. We can't stay kids forever."- Shikamaru Nara (Naruto)

author: Anthony Robbins
text: People are not lazy, they simply have impotent goals..that is..goals that do not inspire them.

author: Sarah Dessen
text: After all, it's all kinds of things that make up a life, right? The big, like falling in love and spending time with your family, and the little....like blow drying your hair, applying concealer, and cursing those magazine inserts. It all counts. It has to.

author: Andy Warhol
text: Being born is like being kidnapped. And then sold into slavery.

author: Masashi Kishimoto
text: People live their lives bound by what they accept as correct and true. That’s how they define Reality. But what does it mean to be “correct” or “true”? Merely vague concepts… Their Reality may all be a mirage. Can we consider them to simply be living in their own world, shaped by their beliefs?

author: Alysha Speer
text: I choose to write because it's perfect for me. It's an escape, a place I can go to hide. It's a friend, when I feel out casted from everyone else. It's a journal, when the only story I can tell is my own. It's a book, when I need to be somewhere else. It's control, when I feel so out of control. It's healing, when everything seems pretty messed up.And it's fun, when life is just flat-out boring.

author: Joan Erickson
text: Vital lives are about action. You can't feel warmth unless you create it, can't feel delight until you play, can't know serendipity unless you risk.

author: Roy T. Bennett
text: Nobody is exempt from the trials of life, but everyone can always find something positive in everything even in the worst of times.

author: Nicholas Sparks
text: Do you know what you're saying when you say, "Whatever"? It's just a code word for the f-word, followed by "you." And at your age, you never, ever. say that to anyone.' " Blaze leaned back. "So now, when someone says it to me, I just say, 'You too.' (72)

author: Og Mandino
text: Realize that true happiness lies within you. Waste no time and effort searching for peace and contentment and joy in the world outside. Remember that there is no happiness in having or in getting, but only in giving. Reach out. Share. Smile. Hug. Happiness is a perfume you cannot pour on others without getting a few drops on yourself.

author: Nicholas Sparks
text: You should read something else."Why would he have done that to him?"I don't know," she said.Do you ever feel like Job?"She smiled, a little twinkle in her eyes.Sometimes."But you haven't lost your faith?"No," I knew she hadn't, but I think I was losing mine.Is it because you think you might get better?"No," she said,"its because its the only thing I have left.

author: Hank Green
text: You are always a little bit wrong

author: Evanescence
text: Don't be afraid of the shadows, that only means there's a light nearby.

author: Ashley  Smith
text: Life is full of beauty. Notice it. Notice the bumble bee, the small child, and the smiling faces. Smell the rain, and feel the wind. Live your life to the fullest potential, and fight for your dreams.

author: Nathaniel Hawthorne
text: Oh, for the years I have not lived, but only dreamed of living.

author: Anne Morrow Lindbergh
text: it takes as much courage to have tried and failed as it does to have tried and succeded.

author: C.G. Jung
text: Even a happy life cannot be without a measure of darkness, and the word happy would lose its meaning if it were not balanced by sadness.

author: Harper Lee
text: As you grow up, always tell the truth, do no harm to others, and don't think you are the most important being on earth. Rich or poor, you then can look anyone in the eye and say, 'I'm probably no better than you, but I'm certainly your equal.

author: Pearl S. Buck
text: I feel no need for any other faith than my faith in the kindness of human beings. I am so absorbed in the wonder of earth and the life upon it that I cannot think of heaven and angels.

author: Ai Yazawa
text: The longer we live, the more weight we carry in our hearts.

author: Václav Havel
text: Hope is not a feeling of certainty that everything ends well. Hope is just a feeling that life and work have a meaning.

author: Roy T. Bennett
text: One of the best ways to influence people is to make those around you feel important.

author: Oliver Wendell Holmes Sr.
text: It's faith in something and enthusiasm for something that makes a life worth living.

author: Khaled Hosseini
text: and every day I thank [God] that I am alive, not because I fear death, but because my wife has a husband and my son is not an orphan.

author: Jack Kerouac
text: Be in love with your life, every detail of it.

author: Karl Lagerfeld
text: I am a fashion person, and fashion is not only about clothes -- it's about all kinds of change

author: Ray Bradbury
text: Stuff your eyes with wonder," he said, "live as if you'd drop dead in ten seconds. See the world. It's more fantastic than any dream made or paid for in factories. Ask no guarantees, ask for no security, there never was such an animal. And if there were, it would be related to the great sloth which hangs upside down in a tree all day every day, sleeping its life away. To hell with that," he said, "shake the tree and knock the great sloth down on his ass.

author: Albert Einstein
text: Life isn't worth living, unless it is lived for someone else.

author: Shane L. Koyczan
text: Don't let your luggage define your travels, each life unravels differently.

author: Henri J.M. Nouwen
text: The spiritual life does not remove us from the world but leads us deeper into it

author: Roy T. Bennett
text: We don’t truly appreciate what we have until it’s gone… We don’t really appreciate something until we have experienced some events; we don't really appreciate our parents until we ourselves have become parents. Be grateful for what you have now, and nothing should be taken for granted.

author: Audre Lorde
text: There is no thing as a single-issue struggle because we do not live single-issue lives.

author: Carrie Underwood
text: God put us here, on this carnival ride. We close our eyes never knowing where it'll take us next.

author: Nisargadatta Maharaj
text: You will receive everything you need when you stop asking for what you do not need

author: Elbert Hubbard
text: The best way to prepare for life is to begin to live.

author: Margaret Drabble
text: When nothing is sure, everything is possible.

author: Jonathan Safran Foer
text: I want an infinitely blank book and the rest of time......why didn't I learn to treat everything like it was the last time, my greatest regret is how much I believed in the future.

author: Rainer Maria Rilke
text: She who reconciles the ill-matched threadsOf her life, and weaves them gratefullyInto a single cloth – It’s she who drives the loudmouths from the hallAnd clears it for a different celebration.

author: Dan Howell
text: You know, people ask me. They say 'Dan, three years later do you really want to be drawing cat whiskers on your face?' but they don't understand. The cat whiskers, they come from within.

author: Jimmy Buffett
text: It takes no more time to see the good side of life than to see the bad.

author: Robert Holden
text: If you think something is missing in your life, it is probably YOU...

author: Hayao Miyazaki
text: Personally I am very pessimistic. But when, for instance, one of my staff has a baby you can't help but bless them for a good future. Because I can't tell that child, 'Oh, you shouldn't have come into this life.' And yet I know the world is heading in a bad direction. So with those conflicting thoughts in mind, I think about what kind of films I should be making.

author: Walter Bagehot
text: Life is a compromise of what your ego wants to do, what experience tells you to do, and what your nerves let you do.

author: Marcel Proust
text: People do not die for us immediately, but remain bathed in a sort of aura oflife which bears no relation to true immortality but through which theycontinue to occupy our thoughts in the same way as when they were alive. Itis as though they were traveling abroad.

author: Robin S. Sharma
text: Dreamers are mocked as impractical. The truth is they are the most practical, as their innovations lead to progress and a better way of life for all of us.

author: Bill Gates
text: Life is not fair get used to used to it

author: Gautama Buddha
