text: You are the most sensual person I know; the goddess of my dreams; the gold at the end of the rainbow; the topping on my ice cream and the best thing that has ever happened to me.And when I wake up in the morning and still find you there next to me, I know that I am living my dream.

author: F.K. Preston
text: Live this life as gently as you would breathe in the seaside air. Then release all those dreams and wonders to the water. Keep breathing until you’re inches from where you wish to be. Then exhale, remembering that gentle life you grew up from.

author: Clarice Lispector
text: When I think of what I already lived through it seems to me I was shedding my bodies along the paths.

author: Darnell Lamont Walker
text: I need my eulogy to look better than my resume. I'm living for that.

author: Darnell Lamont Walker
text: None of my life is based on how others think I should have lived it.

author: Bemy Wells
text: a little modesty averts disgrace

author: Sarah Perry
text: to live at all is to be bruised

author: Magnus Nwagu Amudi
text: Show me a universal life manual and I will show you a ready-made scam.Life is spontaneous. Live and learn.

author: Topsy Gift
text: Life is too short to spend it living for mundane things

author: Naresh Soni
text: Life is lie, Living is the truth.

author: 1 Minuto na Palma da Mão
text: Although complex, life is simple. It is individual.Living is the challenge. It is interactive. It's collective.

author: Steven Wilson
text: I feel I'm living in parentheses

author: Teo Yi Han
text: What does the anticipation feel like? The sensation of staring into the void, the awareness of an end’s impending arrival? Burning and being extinguished simultaneously?

author: Anthony L.S.
text: The strangest things in life, are often closer to reality, than reality would like to admit.

author: Asa Don Brown
text: May you begin living beyond.

author: Akilnathan Logeswaran
text: It's not a homeless life for me,It's just that I'm home lessThan others like to be.

author: Korey G. Miracle
text: The point to life is not only to live it, but to enjoy it.

author: Azim Jamal & Brian Tracy
text: If someone likes you when you are living a lie, remember - he likes the lie, not you.

author: Darnell Lamont Walker
text: I don't believe in sin. My relationships that failed have failed because I somehow attract devout christians. I don't believe in virtue either. I think people just do shit and it's life.

author: Ali Smith
text: Then I wondered why on earth would anyone ever stand in the world as if standing in the cornucopic middle of the Hanging Gardens of Babylon but inside a tiny white-painted rectangle about the size of a single space in a car park, refusing to come out of it, and all around her or him the whole world, beautiful, various, waiting?

author: Saim Cheeda
text: Don’t waste your time dying over the past, spend it living in the present.

author: A.J. Beirens
text: Don't be sad that it's over.Be glad that you ever lived to see it.

author: Darnell Lamont Walker
text: One day you will be the only one in the room not living.

author: Rick Yancey
text: Nothing is more painful than the loneliness of being with someone who is never completely there.

author: Ellen Klages
text: Time has become quiet flexible inside the library. (This is true of most places with interesting books. Sit down to read for twenty minutes, and suddenly it's dark, with no clue as to where the hours have gone.)

author: Clarence E. Flynn
text: DEATHWhy do you fear me?I am your friend.I but guide trav'lersRounding the bend ---Lead them to freedomFrom time and age,Help them start writing a new page...Seek for me never,Keep your course true ---When I am neededI'll come to you,Then I will show youRoads without end ---Why do you fear me?I am your friend.

author: Lailah  Gifty  Akita
text: It is better to live with great faith than in fear.

author: Alesandro Bariko
text: I never even heard her voice."And after a while:"It is a strange grief."Softly:"To die of nostalgia for something you never lived.

author: Neil Gaiman
text: ~I hope that in this year to come, YOU make mistakes. Because if YOU are making mistakes, then YOU are making NEW things, trying NEW things, learning, living, pushing YOURself, changing YOURself, changing YOUR world. YOU're doing things YOU've never done before, n MORE importantly, YOU're doing something~

author: Renee Cefalu
text: Stop wasting time and start living.

author: Aida Mitsu
text: Those who want to start a new journey, there are always new roads open for you

author: Kingsolver Barbara
text: To live is to change, to die one hundred deaths.

author: Haley(fabulous/crazy/Daughter of the King of Kings
text: Live a good life. Love while you're at it.

author: Andrea T. Goeglein
text: Living the life I wanted was my ultimate responsibility. Learning to forgive was my ultimate act of self-love.

author: Kahlil Gibran
text: Life is but a sleep disturbed By dreaming

author: Roy  Bennett
text: Maturity is when you stop complaining and making excuses and start making changes.

author: Robin Dabhi
text: We only regret the chances we didn't take

author: Alireza Salehi Nejad
text: Those who know how one should die knew how one should live.

author: Neel Burton
text: When we stop noticing small things, we are no longer truly alive.

author: Albert Camus
text: Instead of killing and dying in order to produce the being that we are not, we have to live and let live in order to create what we are.

author: Ebelsain Villegas
text: Don't limit your imagination,the best part of your life,is living your desires.

author: Alex Marwood
text: Most people have to get to a point where they don't have a choice before they'll change something.

author: Naguib Mahfouz
text: Fear does not prevent death. It prevents life.

author: Bradley B. Dalina
text: Simplicity make no mans great, but makes life easier and not complicated.

author: Piet Hein
text: Living isa thing you donow or never --which do you?

author: Udayveer Singh
text: Leaving Humanity is only your decision.

author: Udayveer Singh
text: When your Knowledge is linked together it’s called Experience.

author: Bradley B. Dalina
text: Air, Food, Water, Shelter, Love and Godis what we all need to live.If one more thing is missing, it's being wise.WISE enough to consume them wisely.

author: Bradley B. Dalina
text: Air, Food, Water, Shelter, Love and Godis what we all need to live.If one more thing is missing, it's being wise.WISE enough to consume them well.

author: S.J. Watson
text: There were never going to be any happy ending for me. I know that now. But that is all right. That is all right.

author: Darnell Lamont Walker
text: I'm homeless. I've taken to the belief that home is not where we lay our heads comfortably some nights, or where we entertain visiting friends. It's not where love is unconditional. When I look up and realize I haven't run away in a long time, I'll know I'm home.

author: James Hilton
text: Life's more important than a living. So many people who make a living are making death, not life. Don't ever join them. They're the gravediggers of our civilization - The safe men. The compromisers. The moneymakers. The muddlers-through. Politics is full of them... so is businesses... so is the church. They're popular. Successful. Some of them work hard, other are slack, but all of them could tell a good story. Never where there such charming gravediggers in the world's history.

author: Hardwell & Dyro & Bright Lights
text: You'll never fly, if you're too scared of the height,You'll never live if you're just too scared to die,Everybody wants heaven, I knowBut darling freedom ain't free, it's a long roadYou'll never find your place up there in the skyIf you never say goodbye.

author: Fay Weldon
text: For who ever lived totally as they wanted to; who ever, if they have time to think about it, dies wholly satisfied? And those who remain know it.

author: Jill Telford
text: Forget the American dream...whats your dream? The thing that keeps you up at night...the thing that makes you happy...the thing that keeps your spirit going. Do that thing. Don't label it a hobby or what you do in your spare time type of thing...label that thing you do the thing you love to do. The thing you were born to do. When you stop doing what you love you lose a huge part of yourself. Don't get lost.

author: Noetis
text: Within Eros, there is (the) promise; within Love there is (the) Truth.

author: Raaz Ojha
text: Happiness is an art and the one who knows this art lives happily even if they don't have anything.

author: Harper Lee
text: Best way to clear the air is to have it all out in the open.

author: Nana Awere Damoah
text: People will doubt you, but do you doubt your own self? People will insult your integrity, but do you trust yourself? If you are at peace with yourself and with God, you can be at peace with the world.

author: Darnell Lamont Walker
text: If you weren't built for this life, you'd be dead by now. i think the problem is people don't share enough of their pain with the world, so they never know who else is in pain, too, and what others are going through. we're never really alone in anything.

author: Charlotte Eriksson
text: I am a complicated person with a simple life.

author: Atsuko Asano
text: Whoever lives wins. Don't feel guilty about having survived. If you have time to be feeling guilty, work on living a day longer, a minute longer. And once in a while, remember the ones that died before you. That's good enough."Vol 1 Chap 4

author: Alireza Salehi Nejad
text: My art, my greatest art, is the skill to live within me.

author: Alireza Salehi Nejad
text: Those who know who one should die knew how one should live.

author: Alireza Salehi Nejad
text: In this world and the hereafter, we should not be afraid of no one but ourselves.

author: Alireza Salehi Nejad
text: One dies the way he lives.

author: Joshua Ferris
text: What separated the living from one another could be as impenetrable as whatever barrier separated the living from the dead.

author: Sai Marie Johnson
text: One day I decided that existing simply did not work for me, and that was when I began to live.

author: Shellie Palmer
text: My life isn't perfect and it will never be I make mistakes, I learn from them and keep moving forward.

author: Susana Fortes
text: Sometimes, staying alive solely depends on keeping your head in place and your senses alert

author: Derek Keck
text: 233Life is for the living and the dead, she said in a smile,And flashed me a bit of pale thigh in the summer time

author: Louis Kahn
text: Even a brick wants to be something.A brick wants to be something.It aspires. Even a common, ordinary brick... wants to be something more than it is.It wants to be something better than it is.

author: Aniruddha Sastikar
text: It is the 'Teacher', that shapes a novice; not only with his studies, but character too.

author: Aniruddha Sastikar
text: Living appears good, long, and tiresome, but it is way too short than a single stroke of lightning.

author: Jason Goodman
text: Why live unless you live large? Death is a reality, always present, waiting, with that in mind, live today, it is everything you own.

author: Denice Envall
text: I don’t see how anyone can find happiness in this world.

author: Jacob Nordby
text: Living is art.Breathing and heart beating is music.Seeing is painting the world with our eyes.Touching is sculpting the shape of everything.Life is the most intense art of all.

author: Shaun Hick
text: This is for you, for your breath, whose absence would lessen a greater world.

author: Michael Lee
text: Death does not come when the body is too exausted to live.Death comes because the brilliance inside of us can only be contained for so long.We do not die.We pass on.Pass on the life burning through our throats.When you leave me, I will not cry for you.I will run into the strongest wind I can find and welcome you home.

author: Jeff Dixon - Storming the Kingdom
text: All of our lives are a living, breathing story, and each heartbeat means a new page has been turned; chapters don't close, they continue.

author: Abby Musgrove
text: I don’t existmetal pressed to pagesspilling blood, inkin vein each thought ragesSunlight shootingthrough a forest of pinesblack top windingand yellow dotted linesI am not hereonly a deep aching,a lightning flashand a tree trunk breakingSheets once alive covered in a deep redmark the presentbut I am not yet deadNothing is hereonly the rain and mistfresh air and soilI do not need to exist.

author: Maya Angelou
text: What is a fear of living? It's being preeminently afraid of dying. It is not doing what you came here to do, out of timidity and spinelessness. The antidote is to take full responsibility for yourself - for the time you take up and the space you occupy. If you don't know what you're here to do, then just do some good.

author: Sagar Gosavi
text: If living Life is an art, then Only You can be the artist to make it colorful.

author: Aniruddha Sastikar
text: Simplicity comes at a cost; the rich can't stand for, forget affording.

author: santosh inani
text: Dress for the position you want, not the position you have.

author: B.J. Neblett
text: We are the sum total of our experiences. Those experiences – be they positive or negative – make us the person we are, at any given point in our lives. And, like a flowing river, those same experiences, and those yet to come, continue to influence and reshape the person we are, and the person we become. None of us are the same as we were yesterday, nor will be tomorrow.

author: Charlotte Eriksson
text: It will not always be easy, but it will always be beautiful.

author: Jordan Beem
text: Religion is a virus that we cannot get rid of. A virus of the brain that comes from no other source than itself. We who are uninfected must find the cure.

author: Ricky Maye
text: A hero stands up to the villain in themselves.

author: Prashant Chopra
text: Most of us focus so much on 'capturing' the moment that we don't realize we keep losing it for the next which we will lose next:-)

author: Ricky Maye
text: Life and death are something everyone will experience. It is living that only few will have embraced

author: Perky Peppermint
text: Living is more than just existing. When you are living you feel emotions that you may not be able to decipher. You commit mistakes and learn from them and you will be carved in people’s hearts and souls with love and happiness so when you are gone you may not be able to exist anymore but you will still be living inside people’s heart and souls and your memory will forever be cherished by them.

author: Ricky Maye
text: In all of your living don’t forget to live.

author: Ricky Maye
text: I would encourage you to embrace life in your living.

author: Seamus Heaney
text: The way we are living,timorous or bold,will have been our life.

author: Sri Aurobindo
text: Live according to Nature, runs the maxim of the West; but according to what nature, the nature of the body or the nature which exceeds the body? This first we ought to determine.

author: Mark Slouka
text: The only thing your life teaches you is how to live your life. And that’s only if you’re very lucky. And you listen very hard.

author: Ander Monson
text: To be alive is to be dizzy and not to know exactly where to go.

author: Guru Arjan Dev
text: By forgetting the Supreme Lord, all the ailments cling to the man.

author: Shrikant Rao
text: Living a happy life is more than enough.

author: Pietros Maneos
text: All that really matters isto feel alive, if only for a single moment –to feel in Intense Sensationthat our existence is not an endless repetitionof sleeping, eating, drinking, and dressing.

author: Ingrid Nkenlifack
text: I feel sad for the people who I hear always plan, plan, plan the next day's event to occur. Life only stands still for them.

author: Krishna Sagar
text: No matter what, you can only live this moment.

author: Monica E. Tunnell
text: Life is not meant to be lived on the sidelines or the edge of the pool. It is meant to be embraced, inhaled, and devoured. It is meant to be tasted, chewed and swallowed, savoring each and every experience as if it were the most delicious delicacy ever eaten.

author: Kahlil Gibran
text: You are good in countless ways, and you are not evil when you are not good, you are only loitering and sluggard.

author: Duncan William Gibbons
text: Ones life will have much more meaning and happiness if one makes their own decisions

author: Mary Cholmondeley
text: Every year I live I am more convinced that the waste of life lies in the love we have not given, the powers we have not used, the selfish prudence that will risk nothing, and which shirking pain, misses happiness as well. No one ever yet was the poorer in the long run for having once in a lifetime ‘let out all the length of the reins.

author: Stacey T. Hunt
text: The problem with catching dreams is you forget how truly incredible they are when you live with them everyday.

author: Maggie Schein
text: a soul is far too large to hide.

author: smishra
text: It sometime is so amazing to know, how the most ordinary day turns so extraordinary, in a flash of second. And depending on harshness of a sudden jolt of reality, sometime one has no option but to still be hopeful, listen to the heartbeat, still dream grand, still dream impossible; and keep one's inner self illuminated forever. After all, dream only turns into reality, if one is genuinely passionate and truthful to it. What a waste of life it would be otherwise.

author: Gerard Way
text: Someday your life will flash before your eyes. Make sure it's worth watching.

author: Taylor Swift
text: That I always had space to run and that I had the opportunity to play with my imagination. I also loved that my mum drew and painted with me. I always remember that my parents loved me, and that is essential when you're a kid; they always showed me how proud they were of my achievements. It's also very important when parents put their kids' drawings on the refrigerator.

author: Richelle E. Goodrich
text: Life is a book that someone else is reading—and you, a key character—hence the need for continual conflict and resolution. We can't have any boring books.

author: Nadair Desmar
text: You are message to the world make it motivating.

author: Tirumalai S. Srivatsan
text: Whether rich or poor, following the Should Life will lead to heartache and struggle. Leading your life will lead to places you never thought you'd be, people you never thought you'd meet, knowledge you never thought you'd gain, and a life of adventure and growth. Lead your life; not the Should Life.

author: Roel van Sleeuwen
text: Life is a game, you live so you play. Follow your dreams and win what your happy heart desires.

author: Ainun Annisa
text: Karma will hit you. So don't say bullshit.

author: Adem Spahic
text: Learn to appreciate the things you have in the life you're living. It is your present.

author: Aniruddha Sastikar
text: Life itself has an incomparable ability to test your wits that you won’t require anything extra or don’t have to go anywhere outside your space to get them tested. – Aniruddha.

author: Jeanette Winterson
text: The inside and the outside of our lives are each the shell where we learn to live.

author: Viscount Henry St. John Bolingbroke
text: There is so much trouble in coming into the world, and so much more, as well as meanness, in going out of it, that 'tis hardly worth while to be here at all.

author: D.M.X.
text: To live, is to suffer. To survive, well, that's to find meaning in the suffer.

author: Dejan Stojanovic
text: It is not possible to express the most precious insights, To see all that craves to be seen, To visit even the closest neighbors in the universe, To learn all that needs to be learned, To live without dying, And I am sad about it.But I livedAnd I am happy about that.

author: Don Polson
text: Pray that you are in the right place, at the right time, to meet the right person, that together you may help one another.

author: Jordan Ghere
text: Can't look at the damage that's been done, it's not healthy. Have to look ahead of it. Can't change what I've done, only what I'm gonna do.

author: Dave Guerrero
text: Hate is infectious, but so is love, the difference between the two is one takes effort and the other one doesn’t.

author: Bilal Hussain
text: Life....Isn't a roller coaster, it isn't unexpected or surprising. It's not a free ticket to go along for the ride... Simply put, Life is life. Its who you are, what you do that defines you and your life, so choose ... but choose wisely, because life is here to stay...

author: Seneca
text: It takes the whole of life to learn how to live, and--what will perhaps make you wonder more--it takes the whole of life to learn how to die.

author: Charles Bukowski
text: there are so many dayswhen living stops and pulls up and sitsand waits like a train on the rails.

author: NRN
text: There is no time frame on living life, only the frame we place about ourselves to hinder our lives from living to its fullest.

author: sue atchley ebaugh
text: The process of living, for each of us, is pretty similar. For every gain there is a setback. For every success, a failure. For every moment of joy, a time of sadness. For every hope realized, one is dashed.

author: Alastair Reid
text: And what cats have to tellon each return from hellis this: that dying is what the living do, that dying is what the loving do, and that dead dogs are those who do not knowthat dying is what, to live, each has to do.

author: Natalie Goldberg
text: As writers we live life twice, like a cow that eats its food once and then regurgitates it to chew and digest it again. We have a second chance at biting into our experience and examining it. ...This is our life and it's not going to last forever. There isn't time to talk about someday writing that short story or poem or novel. Slow down now, touch what is around you, and out of care and compassion for each moment and detail, put pen to paper and begin to write.

author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
text: My life should be unique; it should be an alms, a battle, a conquest, a medicine.

author: Olive Schreiner
text: My feeling is that there is nothing in life but refraining from hurting others, and comforting those who are sad.

author: Kellie Elmore
text: I firmly disbelieve in death. A spirit never dies. Where it wanders when it leaves the flesh, is a cognitive proposition.

author: A.D. Sams
text: See the world anew and write down the bones of it.

author: Moazzam Shaikh
text: The best standard of living will be attained when your house will be filled with God's blessings.

author: Barwa
text: architecture is a way of life

author: Joshua Wisenbaker
text: Scars are an affirmation of living.

author: Kristie LeVangie
text: Living erotically is opening oneself up to nature-- externally and within.

author: T.A
text: Everyone has their own New York in the heart, place where there is hope for everybody.

author: Kim Krizan
text: I write so the endangered thoughts roaming naked and vulnerable through the misty jungles of my mind aren't slain by the guns of practical living.

author: Deanna Vasquez
text: A person who reads lives more than one life, but that means that they die more than once as well.

author: Ashok  Kallarakkal
text: There is more to life than just living.

author: T.A
text: One life, One story. Make it a fairytale.

author: T.A
text: People don't buy Moet & Dom because they love the taste, the buy it because they need "Livin' Large" photo on Facebook!

author: T.A
text: Ignore what you don't like. Insist what u need.

author: T.A
text: None but ourselves will put the concrete on our road to success.

author: Grigoris Deoudis
text: Prosperity cannot be experienced by living detached from Nature. Everything else is only a gradation of materialistic, earthly ambitions. We came from the stars and there lies the path to our substantive evolution.

author: William Golding
text: It seems to me that we do live in two worlds... there is this physical one, which is coherant, and there is the spiritual one, which to the average man with his flashes of religious experience, is very often incoherant. This experience of having two worlds to live in all the time, or not all the time, is a vital one, and is what living is like.

author: George Alexiou
text: Life is sweet or bitter depending on where your attention is, at that moment.

author: Hedley
text: you got one life so dont stop living it!

author: Heather Gudenkauf
text: We're always on breath away from something--living or dying--, sometimes it just can't be helped.

author: Paul   Newman
text: You only grow when you are alone.

author: Sonia Rumzi
text: Work on your character, let life fall into place.

author: Rossana Condoleo
text: The role of any person in this world is to be themselves without damaging the rest. We are important as long as the rest "is". - Rossana Condoleo

author: EfratCybulkiewicz
text: As in Plato’s myth of the cave, some of us don't stay long enough in one single place, relationship, journey or country but that does not mean we evade reality or makes us unstable. It simply means, we are not very keen to entertain ourselves, for long periods of time, with the same old same old reflections or shadows on the wall, when aware of the existence of the sun; the price for enlightenment, solitude

author: Alex Malley

author: Kilroy J. Oldster
text: A restless human heart always seeks to increase personal understanding and works to attain excellence.

author: Uma Shanker

author: Publilius Syrus

author: Constance Friday

author: Rebecca Brockway
text: Success does not often arrive by miracle or magic but through perseverance and practice.

author: lauren klarfeld
text: A fight is like the perfect storm. It is risky and dangerous. But, as the African proverb goes, Smooth seas do not make skillful sailors. Fights are often learning opportunities—if we’re willing to dig deep enough past our own egos.

author: Paitingroads.com
text: We are our own biggest enemy. We criticize ourselves in a harsh way about everything, our looks, our weight, our careers, our failures and success, the way people treat us; the list goes on. Instead of critiquing ourselves and putting ourselves down, how about tapping ourselves on the shoulder and saying “I did goooood”. GIVE YOURSELF A BREAK.

author: Constance Chuks Friday
text: Despise your weakness, not yourself.

author: bell hooks
text: Commitment to truth telling lays the groundwork for the openness and honesty that is the heartbeat of love. When we see ourselves as we truly are and accept ourselves, we build the necessary foundation for self-love.

author: Donna Goddard
text: To be creative, first we must be generous. Then we must have a quiet, indomitable belief in our own worth.

author: Donna Goddard
text: Do we find ourself or does our self get demolished?

author: Constance Chuks Friday
text: The better you become as each day goes by, the more you heap dust upon you past until you completely bury it. No matter how obnoxious it was

author: Rashedur Ryan Rahman

author: Innocent Mwatsikesimbe

author: Rashedur Ryan Rahman
text: Your every positive action in your life will increase your self-esteem and this self-esteem will boost you for more positive action to take you on success

author: Rashedur Ryan Rahman
text: Give yourself a great self-respect to know who you are then your confidence will shine on you

author: Miena Fiagome
text: Initiative + Progress = Success.

author: Randa Manning-Johnson
text: Most are constantly asking for more, but with that comes more responsibility and most aren't willing to or able to handle that. Greatness comes at a cost and requires an investment. If you don't want the work.... you don't want the prize.

author: Marieta Maglas- Eschatological Regression
text: I need to open this door of self in order to throw out everything that is useless and to save the meaning ofthe things I have to keep.

author: kurbhatt
text: What a person want in life ?1. Simple, steady life.2. Self satisfaction and craziness from work and life he live.3. Luxury/Royal life.Choice is yours, in which way you want to live.

author: Sira Masetti
text: If you lose one battle, don’t give up. Get up again, you have a war to win.

author: Rob R Morris
text: Self-change can only come after self-understanding.

author: Rob R Morris
text: Being afraid does not define your character, but what you do in the face of fear does.

author: Rob R Morris
text: We underestimate the power of our own mind – for both good and bad. If we can learn to control our mindset and our responses to the adverse things in our lives, we can absolutely control our own destiny.

author: Rob R Morris
text: We are not defined by the adversities in our lives, we are defined by how we manage them.

author: Christopher Earle
text: When our thoughts, at times, wander into darkness... remember we are human and have been imbued with free will to choose the light.

author: Chris Matakas
text: As an instructor, my goal has always been to use Jiu Jitsu as a vehicle to help our students achieve their goals, whatever the case may be. I have yet to find a better vehicle for growth, and the moment I do I will certainly pursue it with the rivaled fervor that I approached Jiu Jitsu.

author: Chris Matakas
text: I can think of no more worthwhile aim than pursuing mastery in this craft while transcending one’s own limitations.
