author: Kim Pape
text: Only you can make yourself strong. Nobody else can do it for you.

author: Jack London
text: I am a sick man - oh, not my body. It is my soul, my brain. I seem to have lost all values. I care for nothing. If you had been this way a few months ago, it would have been different. It is too late, now.

text: I didn't know how I could want things so badly while making it impossible to ever get them.

author: Linda Boström Knausgård

author: Damond Jiniya
text: Sometimes I Curse My Love Affair with Life

text: One day, you will stand at the summit of a figurative mountain and look back on your life's journey. And, to your utter amazement, you will see how your experiences with depression, dark and painful as they were, only added to the overall beauty of your life.

text: Being in home is like magic moments, in a magic world, among magicians.

author: Durgesh Satpathy
text: God is a creation of human brain

author: Seth Adam Smith

text: It's just a bad day, not a bad life.

author: Yahia Kareem
text: Life is a form of continuous sufferings and lies.

author: Wendy Law-Yone
text: It isn't discomfort, or dis-ease as he put it. It's this aching, throbbing, god-awful incurable pain - and it's known as life. When will the doctors learn: It isn't death that's the disease.

author: Norah Vincent
text: If I was lonely, if I was afraid of being alone, then why abandon myself? Why run to someone else looking to give myself the thing that only I could give? I wanted to escape myself because I felt empty, and the emptiness frightened me. But obviously, I was empty because I was always running out, running away. The only way to fill the emptiness was to remain, to take up residence in myself.

author: Barbara Field Benziger
text: I am not manic-just happy. It has been such a long time since I was happy. Please join me on my magic carpet for now.

author: Barbara Field Benziger
text: I'm not manic-just happy. It has been such a long time since I was happy. Please join me on my magic carpet for now.

author: Tiwanee Benjamin
text: I pop the lenses out of my sunglasses that way I see the bright side of things because if you always look at the dark side of things your not seeing the brightness that all things have and it's like you're stuck in a cloud of darkness

author: Patrick Marber
text: Larry: She doesn't want to be happy.Dan: Everybody wants to be happy.Larry: Depressives don't. They want to be unhappy to confirm they're depressed. If they were happy they couldn't be depressed anymore. They'd have to go out into the world and live. Which can be depressing.

author: Uneñ Ameji
text: There is a valid reason why they say live everyday as if it were your last, the truth is...., there is no tomorrow - just today

author: Charlotte Eriksson
text: I wanted to say all these things about how you just have to hold on to the things you love and let go of all the rest.

author: D. Antoinette Foy

author: Rukhsar Din
text: When I recall memories, it all seems like a film, not a reality.

author: Britany Lopez
text: If only sorrow could bring hope, I'd learn to live again

author: Paola Marie M.
text: Remember if it's not happy then it's not the end so babe keep fighting, you'll win this war.

author: pavankumar nagaraj
text: I want to re-start my life,

author: Touaxia Vang
text: Better live than dead.

author: Daniel Defoe
text: I had great Reason to consider it as a Determination of Heaven, that in this desolate Place, and in this desolate Manner I should end my life; the Tears would run plentifully down my Face when I made these Reflections, and sometimes I would expostulate with myself, Why Providence should thus compleately ruine its Creatures, and render them so absolutely miserable, so without Help abandon'd, so entirely depress'd, that it could be hardly rational to be thankful for such a Life.

author: C.S. Lewis
text: Lewis encourages his cancer-stricken and temporarily depressed wife that uncertainty rather than hopelessness is our cross.

author: Justin Kanayurak
text: Once you hit rock bottom, that's where you perfectly stand; That's your chance of restarting, but restarting the right way.

author: Chuck Palahniuk
text: Here in the bathroom with me are razor blades. Here is iodine to drink. Here are sleeping pills to swallow. You have a choice. Live or die. Every breath is a choice. Every minute is a choice. To be or not to be. Every time you don't throw yourself down the stairs, that's a choice. Every time you don't crash your car, you reenlist.

author: Charles R. Swindoll
text: Hope doesn't require a massive chain where heavy links of logic hold it together. A thin wire will do...just strong enough to get us through the night until the winds die down.

author: Martin R. Lemieux
text: Your path might be a lonely one... but, you are NOT alone!

author: Ursula K. Le Guin
text: Almost everything carried to its logical extreme becomes either depressing or carcinogenic.

author: Haruki Murakami
text: I think most readers would say the same. Most would choose Midori. And the protagonist, of course, chooses her in the end. But some part of him is always in the other world and he cannot abandon it. It’s a part of him, an essential part. All human beings have a sickness in their minds. That space is a part of them.

author: Of Monsters and Men
text: After every sunny day, comes a stormy night

author: Erica Stone
text: You go to bed different... tossing and turning is the norm... you wake to a sunny day but clouds follow you wherever you go. You wonder if you are strong enough to climb out of the depression you are living in and your prayers to God seem empty because you are sooo very tired of telling him the same thing over and over again..... if we are really being real... there may even be moments after impact you forget how to pray... maybe you don't even want to.

author: Ashly Lorenzana
text: Trees lose their leaves in blizzards like these.

author: Brian Hugh Warner
text: There’s a big difference, I discovered, between wanting to die and not wanting to live. When you want to die, you at least have a goal. When you don’t want to live, you’re really just empty.

author: Taylor Swift
text: There are times when I'm caught up in everything and I have to say to myself, "Please feel good; please feel better; everything's okay; you're fine; things aren't falling apart; take a second; get back to a place where you realize that you don't actually have real problems." That happens. You never know when those tables are gonna turn... For me, confidence is something that can come crashing down in one second.

author: Hiroko Sakai
text: Believe me. Your hardship, tears and sorrows you are facing now are the training of your spirit. The strength you learn from there brings you more love and smiles in your future. Wherever you are, love all the people around you like your family. then you are not alone anymore.

author: Robert Hughes
text: The greater the artist, the greater the doubt. Perfect confidence is granted to the less talented as a consolation p

author: Bathsheba Dailey
text: You cannot move forward if you are always thinking backwards

author: Ashly Lorenzana
text: Just remember that those who feel profoundly depressed are those whose happiness is likewise intense. What's so wrong with that?

author: Ashly Lorenzana
text: If you love yourself the most at your happiest moments, there is no reason not to be fond of who you are in the dark.

author: Wendell Berry
text: Novelty is a new kind of loneliness.

author: Bathsheba Dailey
text: Never take the first brick out of the wall unless you know it is meant to fall

author: Марко Соколовић
text: I thought I was dreaming and I dreamed.

author: Dawn Gluskin
text: Ask. Trust. Give thanks. Simple right?

author: Temitayo Olami
text: May your glory shine so bright that the world sees God's light in all you do!

author: Omoakhuana Anthonia
text: Prayer is communication. You talk, God listens. You listen when God talks.

author: Criss Jami
text: Worldly religion is that which replaces Faith with mere wishful thinking. One must not make the common mistake of putting his faith in all the things he thinks God ought to bless him with; he should instead keep his faith planted in God Himself. Present to Him his needs and wants like a child to his Father, but have faith only in His wisdom and goodness like a servant to his King. God must always be one's Everything before He is one's token to everything.

author: Mary Kate
text: Why, 'inspire?' As y'all can see I love things with the word, 'inspire!' Well, let me remind you that all inspiration comes from God, and my prayer, is that He will lead me, to inspire you to find the true inspiration that He will freely give to you!

author: H.W. Brands
text: Accustomed to motion, he was forced to be still.

author: Santosh Thankachan
text: Hope Thrives When Prayer Strives.

author: Francis Bacon
text: We gave ourselves for lost men, and prepared for death. Yet we did lift up our hearts and voices to God above, who "showeth His wonders in the deep".

author: Sanober  Khan
text: You only have to do one good thing to be in somebody’s lifetime of prayers.

author: M.B. Dallocchio
text: It is not enough to hope for something to happen and throw it into the universe. You, too, must also work to make it happen.

author: Teresa of Ávila
text: Reflect carefully on this, for it is so important that I can hardly lay too much stress on it. Fix your eyes on the Crucified and nothing else will be of much importance to you.

author: Bernice Morgan
text: Work, he tells them one night, is a kind of prayer.

author: minister from Australia or New Zealand...(Jim Cymbala)
text: You can tell how popular a church is by who comes on Sunday morning.You can tell how popular the pastor or evangelist is by who comes on Sunday night.But you can tell how popular Jesus is by who comes to the prayer meeting.

author: Balroop Singh
text: The power of prayer is so profound that it can assuage our emotions. It calms the mind, dilutes all our worries, gives an anchor to fears and endows us with a remarkable peace of mind.

author: Sophie Scholl
text: Dear God, you created us in your likeness, our hearts are uneasy until they find you - From the film Sophie Scholl

author: Amanda  Hudson
text: Life is fragile,handle with prayer.

author: Mark Batterson
text: If you are not open to the unprecedented, you will repeat history. If you are open to the unprecedented, you will change history. The difference is prayer.

author: Sarah Thebarge
text: As I watched them file down the stairs, I didn't cry and I wasn't afraid. But I couldn't tell if it was Jesus or the gin.

author: Sarah Thebarge
text: I just want to tell you if that's what You have planned for me, if I am meant to be an obscure flower in the corner of the expansive garden, I will live there and I will love You and I will bloom just for You -- only, always, ever.

author: AbdulAziz Mohammed
text: God, change the burden of my heart to be like a gentle rain which falls equally on all

author: Geoffrey Wood
text: Properly understood, Imagination and Prayer are directly proportional —the more they pray beyond their bounds, they expand their vision beyond their resources, their experiences, their expectations.

author: Kingsley Opuwari Manuel
text: What we call the Lord's prayer is actually the Disciple's Prayer because It says "Forgive us our trespasses" and Our LORD Jesus had no sin. Selah

author: Jonathan Edwards
text: Prayer is as natural an expression of faith as breathing is to life.

author: Stormie Omartian
text: It’s important that you keep asking God to show you what He wants you to do. If you don’t ask, you won’t know.

author: Stormie Omartian
text: If you want to determine if your thoughts are from the enemy or from God, ask yourself, 'Are these thoughts I’d choose to have?

author: Stormie Omartian
text: In the darkest times of your life, your praise to God should be the loudest. Let the enemy know you’re not afraid of the dark.

If I am someone else, it's also because books move men more than journeys or tears.After many pages you end up learning a variant, a different move than the one taken and thought inevitable.I break away from what I am when I learn to treat my own life differently.

author: Pliny the Elder

author: D'Andre Lampkin

Well honey, love is apart of life. And if you're too afraid to risk loving me, than you won't have me, because the only thing I'll ever do is live.

I don't know any of this"."You didn't have to, Pappa", I said. "You valued learning and you taught me to value it. Once I learned to value it, the rest came without trouble."- Isaac Asimov (Isaak Yudovich Ozimov). It's been a good life.

author: Tom Walsh
text: It seems that the more we learn about our work, the easier and the more interesting it becomes to us. Tasks that used to be tedious now make sense, and we see how they're related to other elements of our jobs. Plus, they're easier to take care of now, so they don't bother us nearly as much when we need to do them. When we know more about our work and its ramifications, we can see the connections between what we do and the effects that those things have on other people.

author: Gordon B. Hinckley
text: Believe in the sacred word of God, the Holy Bible, with its treasury of inspiration and sacred truth; in the Book of Mormon as a testimony of the living Christ. Believe in the Church as the organization which the God of Heaven established for the blessing of His sons and daughters of all generations of time.

author: Gordon B. Hinckley
text: No matter the circumstances, I encourage you to go forward with faith and prayer, calling on the Lord. You may not receive any direct revelation. But you will discover, as the years pass, that there has been a subtle guiding of your footsteps in paths of progress and great purpose.

author: Jodi Livon
text: We are the authors of the stories our soul unfolds.

author: Allyson Giles
text: Keep the dream alive and the heart open

author: Erin Fall Haskell
text: The only human disease is amnesia.

author: Jenna Alatari
text: The most exciting and most defining part of our spirituality comes from the journey we take.

author: Jodi Livon
text: When you act on an intuitive impulse, you are celebrating one of the thoroughly joyful aspects of life on this planet. That calm, guiding inner voice is a natural part of you and deserves to be honored. What is not natural is ignoring it.

author: Milan LaBrey
text: Love sets the foundation for all human values.

author: Jennifer Sodini
text: I am exactly who I am choosing to be. Should I change my choice, the universe will always be there to assist me.

author: Atalina M Homan
text: Like an alchemical wave sending ripples of love to every part of our being, once we become conscious of an intelligent life force existing within us, everything changes.

author: Jennifer Sodini
text: The glass is neither half empty, nor half full. The glass is just a glass and it's content can perpetually change with your perception.

author: Jennifer Sodini
text: God is a sound frequency, and we can all tune in if we just listen. Some find The Rhythm through different melodies, but it's all music.

author: Jennifer Sodini
text: To ascend you must rise above, and I believe in the idea of keeping your “feet in the clouds and your head in the stars”.

author: Lateef Abader
text: Education is a vital path to achieve success. Using what we've learnt to help others completes it,and the result of selfless sharing of knowledge is both spiritually enlightening and humbly satisfying

author: Jennifer Sodini
text: There is no "I", there's only "we". Meaning all you can touch, and all that you see is a part of you, and a part of me.

author: Misha Hoo
text: The power of Manifestation is the ability to make seen the unseen, to real~ise the unreal

author: Abraham Lincoln
text: I have always found that mercy bears richer fruits than strict justice.

author: Cherie Carter-Scott
text: Anger makes you smaller, while forgiveness forces you to grow beyond what you are.

author: Marilynne Robinson
text: There is a saying that to understand is to forgive, but that is an error, so Papa used to say. You must forgive in order to understand. Until you forgive, you defend yourself against the possibility of understanding. ... If you forgive, he would say, you may indeed still not understand, but you will be ready to understand, and that is the posture of grace.

author: Richard Paul Evans
text: The truest grace is not to forgive, but to have never found fault.

author: Ray A. Davis
text: Nothing releases like forgive. Nothing renews like forget.

author: Roy  Bennett
text: The ultimate form of forgiveness is in comprehending there’s nothing to forgive.

author: Gisclerc Morisset
text: Forgiveness can be viewed as love, But love doesn't always guarantee forgiveness.

author: Saurabh Sharma
text: I respect all the innocent souls because they are kind enough to forgive the selfish people around them.

author: Heather Brewer
text: ... but if I've learned one thing, it's this: forgiveness is crucial. If you can't forgive someone you're mad at, that anger will poison you. You have to learn to let it go"... "people have reasons for doing the things that they do, especially when they care about you. You may not always understand what they are, but if you can try to understand the person then you might see that they really care, despite what happened."pg 100 Meredith to Vlad

author: Leigh  Powers
text: Forgiveness doesn't mean what happened wasn't wrong or didn't matter. If it wasn't wrong or didn't hurt, there wouldn't be anything to forgive.

author: Charlie Jane Anders
text: You turned your guilt into resentment, because that seems easier to face. You won't move on until you turn it back into guilt, and then into forgiveness for yourself.

author: Ibnoulkhatib Yahya
text: Never wait people to thank you , God is the only one who would reward you …

author: Omoakhuana Anthonia
text: Unforgiveness is so much stress, I tell you. You just keep going round in circles instead of taking a straight path which forgiveness offers.

author: Deborah L. Robinson
text: There is always someone to forgive, if not another, than yourself.

author: Joss Whedon
text: To forgive is an act of compassion... It's not done because people deserve it. It's done because they need it.

author: Robin Dabhi
text: Before getting upset, always ask yourself: Will this even matter in six months, in a year, or in five years? if the answer is no, then let it go.

author: Sachin Kumar Puli
text: Forgive, Adapt and Evolve, because holding on stagnates your opportunity of being better.

author: Tara Estacaan
text: LIVE WELL___Forget them not, yet forgive, forgive..from self-harm, quita new page, right nowyour spirit's new year's eve.

author: PureDragonWolf
text: How can you forgive someone when they can't give a reason why?

author: Paul R Bland
text: Forgiveness has no deadline.

author: Tiffany Luard
text: Never limit oneself based on the limitations of others. If you can not inspire them - leave them to be inspired by your lead

author: Nāgārjuna
text: Although you may spend your life killing, you will not exhaust all your foes. But if you quell your own anger, your real enemy will be slain.

author: Rev. Kellen Roggenbuck
text: Remember that churches would be empty ruins without the sinners who transform them into places of life, love and worship.

author: Aagam Shah
text: Do hugs, not drugs. Spread love, not legs. Respect, don't judge. Listen more, talk less. Understand, don't assume. Forgive and forget..!!

author: Colleen McCullough
text: Until you can leave the matter of forgiveness to God, you will not have acquired true humility.

author: James E. Faust
text: Forgiveness comes more readily when, we have faith in God and trust in His word. Such faith “enables people to withstand the worst of humanity. It also enables people to look beyond themselves. More importantly, it enables them to forgive.

author: Jeanette Coron
text: If someone puts you through hell, don’t be mad or bitter about it, because the thing that will free you from that hell is forgiveness.

author: Touaxia Vang
text: Laugh it off, Life gets better.

author: Carl Burnam
text: When the resurrection sings itself in the robin's glad song, and bursting buds defy the death grip of winter, and you walk upon the yielding earth near my grave...remember that my soul is not there, but rather it is absent from the body and present with the Lord.

author: Reverend John Clampitt
text: No woman will be licensed to preach in the Louisiana Presbytery as long as I'm a member of it!

author: Reverend Ada Caston Slaton Bonds
text: If I left any good or planted any flowers among thorns, the credit goes to God and my many substantial friends.

author: Jenim Dibie
text: I hope my forgiveness reminds you,Of the part you forgot to break in me.

author: Rebecca O'Dwyer - Centred Woman
text: The only person we have the right or the power to forgive is ourselves. For everything else there is the Art of Acceptance.

author: Gillian Duce
text: Yesterday is done. Today has just begun. I am not going let anyone's negative issues do anything to me other than inspire me to do better.

author: Manasa Rao
text: When you say the word 'sorry' make sure you understand that an apology has 3 parts. "I'm sorry", "It's my fault and I won't do it again" and "How can I make things better". The last part is the most important.

author: Manasa Rao
text: Sometimes it's too heavy to give a second chance.

author: Mary A. Pérez
text: There is help for the helpless, hope for the hopeless, and forgiveness for the inexcusable.

author: Jo De Raman
text: When the actions of others no longer matter, then you will have succeeded within your own mind.

author: Asa Don Brown
text: Forgiveness has the ability to transform our thoughts.

author: Asa Don Brown
text: Forgiveness is the ultimate liberator of our mind, body, and spirit.

author: David Hoffmeister
text: The whole message of the Course is: do not wait. In other words, salvation is offered to you this instant; be vigilant! Watch your mind. Be as attentive as you can this very instant. And the Course does not give specifics, like if this arises, do that. It is all based on sorting out the two thinking systems; the right mind and the wrong mind. That is where healing takes place. It draws attention away from symptoms level, whether it be financial problems, health issues or whatever.

author: John Banville
text: Still the dream persists, suppressed but always there, that somehow by some miraculous effort of the heart what was done could be undone. What form would such atonement take that would turn back time and bring the dead to life? None. None possible, not in the real world. And yet in my imaginings I can clearly see this cleansed new creature steaming up out of myself like a proselyte rising drenched from the baptismal river amid glad cries.

author: Atkinson Talvat
text: Life experiences are but moments, you can let them pass or you can make them last.

author: Natalie Lloyd
text: If you're brave enough to love, and forgive, and call up the factofabulous memories... there's no curse in the world that has any power over you.

author: Kristen McNulty
text: The story of grace is the Gospel of not just forgiveness, but also of redemption. God uses the weak, the ones who have failed and the ones who had run out of second chances long ago.

author: Raymond E. Feist
text: Forgive me, Magnus.’‘I don’t know if I can.’‘You must.’Still looking into the distance, he said, ‘You need my forgiveness?’‘No. I’m dead. You can do nothing for me. You need to forgive me so you can live.

author: Indy Bissessur
text: Forgiveness means that you are willing to give someone else a second chance to breathe in new life in his body. That is one of the greatest attribution of a Leader.

author: Ikechukwu Izuakor
text: One of the greatest lessons we can learn in life is how to keep mute when the boiling ring of anger is dropped within us

author: Sai Marie Johnson
text: I've found that one of the most important things in life is to learn how to forgive yourself.

author: German Proverb
text: If God were not willing to forgive sin, heaven would be empty

author: X H
text: I forgive you, only if you promise to be happy in whatever you do.

author: -Shandel Slaten
text: I think forgiveness is a missing key to corporate success.

author: Corrie ten Boom
text: To forgive is to set a prisoner free and discover the prisoner was you.

author: Terraine Francois
text: Forgiveness is one of the keys to moving forward because if you don't forgive, you are stuck in the past.

author: Terraine Francois
text: Know how you want to be treated, and expect that when you deal with people. Also remember to give people the respect that you want.

author: Ashly Lorenzana
text: Dogs are how people would be if the important stuff is all that mattered to us.

author: Catherine the Great
text: The more a man knows, the more he forgives.

author: Nomthandazo Tsembeni
text: Never waste time holding grudges for people who have wronged you.Time waits for no one.Apologise when you are wrong,Express your love when you should,Forgive the ones who wronged you,And appreciate the one who makes efforts to see you smile.

author: Lacey Sturm
text: When you forgive somebody, it’s not so much for them as it is for you. You need to be free from that. And you need to rise above that.

author: Justin David Nevins
text: A mistake does not make a shadow. The people who you hurt through the mistake and what they decide to say about it is what leaves a shadow. The only way to erase that shadow is to shed light on it. If that is not possible, moving on to somewhere brighter is always an option.

author: Brian MacLearn
text: The moment after being let go, when we can finally let it go, is the moment when love once again has hope.

author: Holly Lynn Payne
text: ....life is the work of the spirit trying to have a human experience.

author: L.R. Knost
text: When you're lying in bed at night and regrets from the day come to steal your sleep... "I should have" "If only I'd" "I wish I'd"...grab one of them and turn it into an "I will" and sleep peacefully knowing tomorrow will be a better day.

author: L.R. Knost
text: Forgiveness empties the past of its power to empty the present of its peace.

author: H. L. Balcomb
text: Forgiveness, she was only required to accept the seed of healing, and to let it grow on its own time.

author: H. L. Balcomb
text: Kill him with your blessings of healing.

author: Nelson Mandela
text: Courageous people do not fear forgiving, for the sake of peace.

author: Dinesh Kumar Radhakrishnan
text: Be happy by forgiving or forgetting or doing both, but we can gain no happiness by holding grudges.

author: Sun Fire Elements
text: Asking forgiveness is not an admission of cowardice and of sin, It is to show that having inner peace is far more important than pride especially if they think that you have wronged them in any way.

author: Mary Baker Eddy
text: Happiness is spiritual, born of truth and love.

author: C. Kennedy Omorphi
text: No one should have to go through life without forgiveness. It's essential

author: Nike Thaddeus
text: You never get a second chance to make a first impression. God bless those who see beyond our flaws painted in bold strokes.

author: Dustin Cruz
text: Don't miss a chance at happiness because of your past misery.

author: John Green
text: You are helpful, and you are loved, and you are forgiven, and you are not alone.

author: M.L. Stedman
text: It is so much less exhausting. You only have to forgive once. To resent, you have to do it all day, every day. You have to keep remembering all the bad things ... I would have to make a list, a very, very long list and make sure I hated the people on it the right amount ... No ... we always have a choice. All of us.

author: Jeffrey Spahr-Summers
text: Forgiveness is a gift we can only give to ourselves.

author: Toni Petrinovich
text: Only through Absolution will you reach the Absolute.

author: Tyler Perry
text: It's not an easy journey, to get to a place where you forgive people. But it is such a powerful place, because it frees you.

author: Habeeb Akande
text: I would rather be a conscious wrongdoer than a mindless saint.

author: M.L. Stedman
text: I can leave myself to rot in the past, spend my time hating people for what happened, like my father did, or I can forgive and forget.""But it's not that easy."He smiled that Frank smile. "Oh, but my treasure, it is so much less exhausting. You only have to forgive once. To resent, you have to do it all day, every day. You have to keep remembering all the bad things...

author: Paulo Coelho
text: Simply having the courage to say senseless things made me euphoric. I was free, with no need to seek or to give explanations for what I was doing. This freedom lifted me to the heavens - where greater love, one that forgives everything and never allows you to feel abandoned, once again enveloped me.

author: Tyler Perry
text: I didn't have a catharsis for my childhood pain, most of us don't, and until I learned how to forgive those people and let it go, I was unhappy.

author: Anita R. Sneed-Carter
text: Lay down an unforgiving spirit, because there'll be no peace until you do.

author: Michael M. Rose
text: Love always precedes repentance. Divine love is a catalyst for our turning, our healing. Where fear & threat may gain our compliance, love captures our heart. It changes the heavy burden of the "have-to's" of imposed obedience to the "get-to's", a joyful response to the genuine love of God. It is in the security of this love we find Sabbath (rest).

author: Heikichi Nakao Otani
text: Nakao: Koizumi, I'm so sorry I said such cruel things.Otani: What's that?Nakao: The whispering of your heart.

author: Alain de Botton
text: Forgiveness requires a sense that bad behaviour is a sign of suffering rather than malice.

author: Dana Arcuri
text: Forgiveness is empowering for the forgiver. Years of resentment, frustration, and pain are set FREE!

author: Imam Ali bin abi Taleb
text: And be aware that people fall under one of two categories: they are either your brother and sister in faith, or they are your counterpart in humanity.

author: Dorothy Allison
text: I want hard stories, I demand them from myself. Hard stories are worth the difficulty. It seems to me the only way I have forgiven anything, understood anything, is through that process of opening up to my own terror and pain and reexamining it, re-creating it in the story, and making it something different, making it meaningful - even if the meaning is only in the act of the telling.

author: Alan Cohen
text: You have the power to take away someone's happiness by refusing to forgive. That someone is you.

author: Joanne Crisner
text: In the middle of this journey, we lose a bit of ourselves. We do not know where we are or where we’re headed. We look for directions, seek for guidance, and if we’re lucky, we find it without too much time lost. And if we’re truly lucky, we gain our whole selves back, with an ounce of wisdom on top.

author: Danielle Pierre
text: At times, we are the bridge that allows another to re-enter the world after a loss. Don't mistake it for more or its beauty may be lost.

author: Tim LaHaye
text: My life's an open book. Some of the pages are a little ripped, but it's open.

author: L M Bryski
text: My ship had lost crew mates before, yet I sailed on.

author: M. L. Stedman
text: As Tom wandered back to Mrs Mewett’s, he thought about the little relics at the lighthouse – Docherty’s knitting, his wife’s jar of humbugs that sat untouched in the pantry. Lives gone, traces left. And he wondered about the despair of the man, destroyed by grief. It didn’t take a war to push you over that edge.

author: C.S. Lewis
text: One never meets just Cancer, or War, or Unhappiness (or Happiness). One only meets each hour or moment that comes. All manner of ups and downs. Many bad spots in our best times, many good ones in our worst. One never gets the total impact of what we call ‘the thing itself’. But we call it wrongly. The thing itself is simply all these ups and downs: the rest is a name or an idea.

author: Jesus Christ
text: For what shall it profit a man, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul? Gospel of Mark ~ Mark 8:36

author: Laura Staley
text: Sometimes life events break your heart. Even as you grieve, allow light to seep through the cracks, uplift, and illuminate a healing. Baby turtles emerge from the cracking of shells; new life can burst forth. Clear away all broken belongings as a metaphorical pathway fresh, loving experiences in uncharted waters.

author: Lynda Cheldelin Fell
text: The bereaved need more than just the space to grieve the loss. They also need the space to grieve the transition.

author: Josephine Hart
text: Life… has a way of testing the fault line

author: Anat Talshir
text: ...hope nourishes while loss empties a person out," he said.... "Lila, my love, my love,...lay down your weapons. Don't punish us because I told myself a different story than the one you told yourself.

author: she was taken away from him.
text: Letting her go wasn't a choice because he would never let her go

author: Trevor Driggers
text: We put our lives on hold for people who so easily forget about us.

author: Christina Moracho
text: She can feel her vanished talent like a phantom limb, the empty ache of its subtraction from the short list of her assets, and she knows with spiteful certainty that it is gone for good.

author: Jenny Qi
text: I have suffered through enough illnesses, trauma and heartbreak to finally understand that life will keep moving forward inexorably, if terribly at times. I am starting to realize that it can be delightful too, if I let it. My love is not diminished if I let go of sorrow. I almost believe that.

author: Kate McGahan
text: The more we love the more we lose. The more we lose the more we learn. The more we learn the more we love. It comes full circle. Life is the school, love is the lesson. We cannot lose.

author: Kayko Tamaki
text: As a young girl I was told the truth. I knew about death. I was afraid to lose but not afraid to die.

author: Latoya Alston
text: Loss is only temporary when you believe in God!

author: Mamur Mustapha
text: Politics is an alternative to war and if you're in it, you live it as such. You win some & you lose at times.

author: Connie  Jordan
text: Sorrowful tears drench the earth, rise again in the form of hope

author: Turcois Ominek
text: We hunger for connection but take pride in being distant.

author: Cass van Krah
text: It is not about what you lose when it is over. Far more, it is about what you gain during the journey!

author: Barry DeCarli
text: despairsometimeshope leads us on teases us withits shiny baublesits stunning horizonsit can carry us overthe roiling turmoilthe raging stormthen as easilywith its cornucopia of liesdrop us into the wavesto flounder against its loss

author: Jenim Dibie
text: The things you let go will someday teach you how to fly.

author: Dave Eggers
text: I should probably get a stone. A stone would be good. A stone would save me, would salvage all the damage we had already done, all the things we had given up or lost.

author: - Morris R. Gates
text: Oh, the need to lay my tongue in the rivers of wine,To taste of her lustHow a star feels as it bursts infinitely into diamondsThe earth cries, but it is only the heavens that weep for herThe sun needs to rise once moreCast its loving arms across the mountains and her valleysAnd pull her from the shadowsTo bathe her in the warmth the heart only knows as love

author: Brenda Perlin
text: Being married definitely took work. When we fought, I felt like I wanted to float away and drown, whereas before I knew I could walk away without any strings attached.

author: Cynthia Mock Burroughs
text: Time does have a way of softening most things. Anger, hate, and even loss are often diluted by the passage of time. And memories, well they become more precious as days go by . . . until one day the cup that seemed half-empty, incredibly, becomes half-full.

author: Chris Kyle
text: It was a tragic end to a heroic life.

author: Anne Roiphe
text: Grief is in two parts. The first is loss. The second is the remaking of life.

author: Helen Keller
text: What we have once enjoyed deeply we can never lose. All that we love deeply becomes a part of us.

author: Bhavya Kaushik
text: I believe there is no heaven or hell. There are no devils or angels. No afterlife or salvation. My soul won't be incarnated or lost in the oblivion. One day, I will just stop existing... and that's it!

author: Álvaro de Campos
text: Nothing: a landscape, a glass of wine, a little loveless love, and the vague sadness caused by our understanding nothing and having lost the little we're given.

author: Bai Juyi
text: On the seventh day of the Seventh-month, in the Palace of Long Life,We told each other secretly in the quiet midnight worldThat we wished to fly in heaven, two birds with the wings of one,And to grow together on the earth, two branches of one tree."Earth endures, heaven endures; some time both shall end,While this unending sorrow goes on and on for ever.

author: Lyrical Treasure
text: There is something about loss and pain that opens the doors of wisdom in your heart, doors that would have remained locked for a whole lifetime.

author: AribaZafar
text: Be Creative, consume time, don't let the time consumes you..

author: Aleksandra Ninkovic
text: We don't know predestined ways,or what future might behold,someone leaves,someone remains,and new things replace the old.We don't know a thing for sure,what's today,is there tomorrow?Yet,somehow we still endure,through those moments filled with sorrow.Can we really be mistaken,trying just the best we can?something's given and some taken,never knowing how nor when.We don't know that much,it's true,life's a mystery divine,a day came,when i lost you,treasured guiding star of mine.

author: Anne Lamott
text: Some aching beauty comes with huge loss, although maybe not right away, when it would be helpful. Life is a very powerful force, despite the constant discouragement. So if you are a person with connections to life, a few tendrils eventually break through the sidewalk of loss, and you notice them, maybe space out studying them for a few moments, or maybe they tickle you into movement and response, if only because you have to scratch your nose.

author: Julia McCann
text: The leaves of the trees will stroke your cheeks, The wind will blow through your chest and cleanse your soul, The magical sounds of the earth, animals and the elements will hug your ears, The positive vibrations of the earth will fall asleep next to your heart and the breathtaking beauty of the earth will ease your mind. If you allow it, the earth, in itself, will heal you.

author: Aaron Carter
text: Having a dream, living that dream, losing that dream, dreaming again and then having that dream come true again is one of the greatest feelings ever because I`m stronger.

author: Kendal Rob
text: Sometimes words just arent enough. Sometimes it's easier to magically lose yourself in the memories long past, the ones you so selfishly took for granted. And sadly sometimes that's the only way to keep those people in your life- recapturing their glorious light before they fade. And inevitably their memory along with them.

author: Stephen King
text: You lost your innocence when you grew up, all right, everyone knew that, but did you have to lose your hope, as well?

author: Isaac Asimov
text: John Dalton's records, carefully preserved for a century, were destroyed during the World War II bombing of Manchester. It is not only the living who are killed in war.

author: Leah Reader
text: You should love something while you have it, love it fully and without reservation, even if you know you'll lost it someday. We lose everything. If you're trying to avoid loss, there's no point in taking another breath, or letting your heart beat one more time. It all ends. That's all life is. Breathing in, breathing out. The space between two breaths.

author: Edith Hamilton
text: She was brave from excess of grief

author: David Niven
text: Max, for some people there are no victories, just alternate forms of losing.

author: Evinda Lepins
text: Death is only final when you know you're not going to see them again!

author: Janet Fitch
text: I hadn’t understood at the time. If sinners were so unhappy,why would they prefer their suffering? But now I knew why.Without my wounds, who was I? My scars were my face, my pastwas my life.

author: Derrick A. Bell
text: A rule without exceptions is an instrument capable of doing mischief to the innocent and bringing grief -- as well as injustice -- to those who should gain exemptions from the rule's functioning.

author: Bhavya Kaushik
text: I feel like I am a diluted version of myself. A piece of crayon that was left unused. An abandoned car that was forgotten by its owner. I feel like I am a roadside accident. People are just stopping by to see the damage, but no one is trying to help me. I want you to come back and stop me from burning my own fuel. I want you to put me back in the pack of crayons. I want you to make me whole again.

author: Kristin Granger
text: I harken to the call of my heart, embracing the depth that flows liquid ambered and animal soft within my cells.The dark abyss of denial has always been a poor mans trade for the guiding light of emotional wisdom.This crust of mortal skin is baptised with tear streaked holy waters. I rise to my heart with an uncommon courage and wade soul deep.Tissue thin ripples of redemption drift across the pain towards my future self, bathing me in hope. I rise and step closer to all that I AM.

author: Kayko Tamaki
text: Mama, I love you and miss you so very much. The absence of of your physical presence propels me further into understanding the spirit. I am inspired to be aware and mindful of everything around me because there-- you exist, always speaking to me and always with me.

author: Kevin Brooks
text: Stories aren't facts, Cait, they're not details. Stories are feelings. You've got your feelings, haven't you?""Too many," I said."Well, that's all you need." He put his hand on mine. "Cry yourself a story, love. It works. Believe me."So that's what I did, I cried myself a story.And this is it.

author: Wendy Card
text: It may be difficult, but thru sorrow, it’s important to find happiness in our memories and be very thankful to have them!

author: Ursula K. Le Guin
text: All that grieved me - that I was half one thing and half another and nothing wholly - was the sorrow of my childhood, but the strength and use of my life after I grew up.

author: Walter Mosley
text: I destroyed that doll, hoping the sacrifice would somehow reverse time and bring my father back. I was a mad scientist and an angry child.

author: Albert Camus
text: Against eternal injustice, man must assert justice, and to protest against the universe of grief, he must create happiness.

author: Balroop Singh
text: We live, oblivious of the reality that grief is an incessant stream that flows into our life time and again and brings all those boulders back, which we had discarded in the hope of never meeting again.

author: Don Van Vliet
text: Well, the gold fish in the bowl lay upside down bloatingFull in the sky and the plains were bleached white with skeletonsVarious species grouped together accordingTo their past beliefsThe only way they ever all got together wasNot in love but shameful grief

author: John Berger
text: Happiness is not something to be pursued, it is something met, an encounter. Most encounters, however, have a sequel; this is their promise. The encounter with happiness has no sequel. All is there instantly. Happiness is what pierces grief.

author: Ariana Carruth
text: When we start rating each other’s lives and afflictions, we lose a bit of our humanity, compassion and perspective.

author: Jalaluddin Rumi
text: Grief can be the garden of compassion. If you keep your heart open through everything, your pain can become your greatest ally in your life's search for love and wisdom

author: Julian Barnes
text: Perhaps grief, which destroys all patterns, destroys even more: the belief that any patterns exist. But we cannot, I think, survive without such belief. So each of us must pretend to find, or re-erect, a pattern.

author: Deshwal Sachin
text: Life has only three states-Happiness,Grief and Emptiness.The extreme state of life is emptiness.

author: Jalaluddin Rumi

text: There are no rules of architecture for a castle in the clouds.

author: Vladimir Nabokov
text: Some might think that the creativity, imagination, and flights of fancy that give my life meaning are insanity.

author: Bill Hicks
text: Watching television is like taking black spray paint to your third eye.

author: Ray Bradbury
text: Love what you do and do what you love. Don't listen to anyone else who tells you not to do it. You do what you want, what you love. Imagination should be the center of your life.

author: J.K. Rowling
text: Imagination is not only the uniquely human capacity to envision that which is not, and, therefore, the foundation of all invention and innovation. author: John Keats
text: My imagination is a monastery, and I am its monk

author: Jeanette Winterson
text: I spin worlds where we could be together. I dream you. For me, imagination and desire are very close.

author: Emily Dickinson
text: The possible's slow fuse is lit by the Imagination.

author: Pearl S. Buck
text: All things are possible until they are proven impossible.

author: Alexandre Dumas
text: So rapid is the flight of dreams upon the wings of imagination.

author: Sue Monk Kidd
text: I believe in the goodness of imagination.

author: Anne Lamott

author: Marcel Proust
text: The inertia of the mind urges it to slide down the easy slope of imagination, rather than to climb the steep slope of introspection.

author: Emily Dickinson
text: your brain is wider than the sky

author: Jim Davis
text: An imagination is a powerful tool. It can tint memories of the past, shade perceptions of the present, or paint a future so vivid that it can entice... or terrify, all depending upon how we conduct ourselves today.

author: Fernando Pessoa
text: Through an experience that simultaneously involved my sensibility and intelligence, I realized early on that the imaginative life, however morbid it might seem, is the one that suits temperaments like mine. The fictions of my imagination (as it later developed) may weary me, but they don't hurt or humiliate. Impossible lovers can't cheat on us, or smile at us falsely, or be calculating in their caresses. They never forsake us, and they don't die or disappear. --The book of Disquiet

author: Mervyn Peake
text: As I see it, life is an effort to grip before they slip through one's fingers and slide into oblivion, the startling, the ghastly or the blindingly exquisite fish of the imagination before they whip away on the endless current and are lost for ever in oblivion's black ocean.

author: Thomas Henry Huxley
text: To a clear eye the smallest fact is a window through which the infinite may be seen.

author: Stephen King

author: Louis Aragón

As a reader you imagine them in your own mind. So, together, as author and reader, we have both created the story.

author: Peter Nivio Zarlenga
text: I am imagination. I can see what the eyes cannot see. I can hear what the ears cannot hear. I can feel what the heart cannot feel

author: Josephine Jacobsen
text: I love the process of being taken from where I am to somewhere else.

author: Jorge Luis Borges
text: All theories are legitimate, no matter. What matters is what you do with them.

author: Heenashree Khandelwal
text: Imagination is the parallel universe of a writer. If he is not responding to you in this world, he is probably responding to someone in the imaginary world.

text: Suspense is like a woman. The more left to the imagination, the more the excitement. ... The conventional big-bosomed blonde is not mysterious. Although I do not profess to be an authority on women, I fear that the perfect title [for a movie], like the perfect woman is difficult to find.

author: Valaida Fullwood
text: I have a habit of letting my imagination run away from me. It always comes back though . . . drenched with possibilities.

author: Maurice Merleau-Ponty
text: The number and richness of man’s signifiers always surpasses the set of defined objects that could be termed signifieds. The symbolic function must always precede its object and does not encounter reality except when it precedes it into the imaginary…

author: Arthur Conan Doyle

author: Terence McKenna

author: Jean Toomer

author: Gordon Attard

author: Arundhati Roy
text: To call someone 'anti-American', indeed, to be anti-American, (or for that matter anti-Indian, or anti-Timbuktuan) is not just racist, it's a failure of the imagination. An inability to see the world in terms other than those that the establishment has set out for you: If you're not a Bushie you're a Taliban. If you don't love us, you hate us. If you're not Good you're Evil. If you're not with us, you're with the terrorists.

author: Raymond Queneau
text: He sought an adventure but didn't find one. He was inexperienced and besides he didn't have too much imagination.

author: James Christensen

author: Terence McKenna

author: Clarence Darrow

author: Enoch Powell

author: Mary Oliver

author: NOT A BOOK
text: You have only one life. So, live it happy with whatever conditions you have. When you give more weight to other's opinions than your own thoughts, you will end up living their unattainable life instead of yours..

author: Michael R. French
text: What's real and what's not? People we meet in books--Holden Caulfield, Captain Ahab, Huckleberry Finn, Harry Potter, Bilbo and Gandalf and Frodo-- can become more memorable, and more important to us than people with birth certificates and drivers' licenses. Characters spawned in an author's imagination find a home inside us. They make our lives richer. They become our best friends. They never disappoint. And they never die.

author: John J. Geddes

author: Imani Nettles

author: Judy Blume

Fortunately, I was able to tap back into that later on [through my books] to save my life.

author: Newton Kibiringi

author: Ursula K. Le Guin

These images are then interrogated, mocked, congratulated, or dismissed, depending on the context of the reading and the disposition of the reader.

author: A.M.M Alusi

text: Today's make believe is tomorrow's creativity.

author: Anna Jae

author: Maxwell Maltz
text: Thus man of all creatures is more than a creature, he is also a creator. Man alone can direct his success mechanism by the use of imagination, or imaging ability.

Think of that little stretched disk of iron at the end of a wire repeating in your ear not only sounds, but words—not only words, but all the most delicate and elusive inflections and nuances of tone which separate one human voice from another!

author: K. Lamb
text: Step inside your favorite storybook and become lost in a journey only your imagination can envision.

While thirty-seven people—perhaps thirty-seven are too many, perhaps seventeen would have been better or even seven—but still thirty-seven are still within the scope of one's imagination.

author: Mary Karr
text: But it’s a neurological fact that the scared self holds on while the reasoned one lets go. The adrenaline that let our ancestors escape the sabertooth tiger sears into the meat of our brains the extraordinary, the loud. The shrieking fight or the out-of-character insult endures forever, while the daily sweetness dissolves like sugar in water.

author: Frederick George Scott
text: May the ears of Canada never grow deaf to the plea of widows and orphans and our crippled men for care and support.
