text: Everyone you meet is fighting a battle you know nothing about. Be kind. Always.

author: Matthieu Ricard
text: Few of us would regret the years it takes to complete an education or master a crucial skill. So why complain about the perseverance needed to become a well-balanaced and truly compassionate human being?

author: Kayla Mueller
text: Some people find God in love; I find God in suffering. I've known for some time what my life's work is, using my hands as tools to relieve suffering.

author: Gary   Hopkins
text: Despite your best efforts, not everyone wants to be helped. Make a difference where you can and be at peace with the rest.

author: Pablo
text: I remember a time in a class on a cold winter morning a Japanese girl came with a surgical mask & I thought “wow people would go to extremes NOT to get sick in Japan” afterwards on a break I approached her & asked in a cynical manner: why the mask? Are you afraid of catching a cold? & then she said “in Japan you use it when YOU are under the weather & you don’t want other people to get sick, it is the polite thing to do” wow! that's a lesson I will never forget

author: Goitsemang Sandra Mvula
text: In life I've learnt to CHERISH the moments with those I meet in life, CONQUER my fears, CLIMB the ladder of opportunities, COUNT my blessings, and CARE for the needy.

author: Bryan Stevenson
text: We have a choice. We can embrace our humanness, which means embracing our broken natures and the compassion that remains our best hope for healing. Or we can deny our brokenness, forswear compassion, and, as a result, deny our own humanity.

author: Jill Bolte Taylor
text: I believe that the more time we spend choosing to run the deep inner-peace circuitry of our right hemispheres, the more peace we will project into the world, and the more peaceful our planet will be.

author: Aisha Mirza
text: They say compassion is the only voice; a gift which can help mend the broken, lift the fallen and soften the hardened.

author: Dalai Lama XIV
text: Great compassion is the root of altruistic action, the object of amazement to the world;there is no greater source of help and happiness.

author: Ansul Noor
text: A body without compassion is like the rose without the scent.

author: Stephen King
text: And as I thought about the body of Ray Brower in this light- or lack of it- what I felt was not queasiness or fear that he would suddenly appear before us, a green and gibbering banshee whose purpose was to drive us back the way we had come before we could disturb his- its- peace,but a sudden and unexpected wash of pity that he should be so alone and so defenceless in the dark that was now coming over our side of the world.

author: Annette Schrab Clark
text: Keep God within His and anothers' arm's reach.

author: Arthur Schopenhauer
text: How is it possible that suffering that is neither my own nor of my concern should immediately affect me as though it were my own, and with such force that is moves me to action?

author: Bono
text: Honesty, vulnerability and a good amount of courageous faith allows you to cry out in your bewilderment and not lose your belief in the process. These things allow you to wrestle your faith rather than lose it.

author: Gary   Hopkins
text: We have come to a point in time where using common sense, speaking factual truths and asking honest questions have been deemed radical behavior. While in turn, manipulation, thoughtlessness and dishonesty is often rewarded and rules the day.

author: Jennifer Hillman
text: Whisper sweetly the tenderness of the moment. Let the love teach you the true meaning and passion of this experience we share. With gratitude and reverence for the blessings and miracles I receive and witness, my heart still beats as the little things die to be reborn with a greater joy for life in each moment.

author: G.I. Gurdjieff
text: From looking at your neighbor and realizing his true significance, and that he will die, pity and compassion will arise in you for him and finally you will love him.

author: Robert G. Ingersoll
text: Is it a small thing to quench the flames of hell with the holy tears of pity -- to unbind the martyr from the stake -- break all the chains -- put out the fires of civil war -- stay the sword of the fanatic, and tear the bloody hands of the Church from the white throat of Science? Is it a small thing to make men truly free -- to destroy the dogmas of ignorance, prejudice and power -- the poisoned fables of superstition, and drive from the beautiful face of the earth the fiend of fear?

author: Benedictine prayer
text: Dear God, give bread to those who are hungry and a hunger and thirst for justice to those who have plenty. Amen.

author: Gary   Hopkins
text: We must empower our weak to be strong, and teach our strong to be compassionate. This will open a door to oneness.

author: Maya Angelou
text: My mother said I must always be intolerant of ignorance but understanding of illiteracy. That some people, unable to go to school, were more intelligent and more educated than college professors.

author: Egor Kraft
text: Imagine you saw a colour in your dream, which you have never seen before. It doesn't consist of any colours or shades that you know. Trying to describe that colour would be as difficult as trying to belive that there is enough love & compassion in the world so every human can feel happiness.

author: Piero Gheddo
text: Why are...poor people more ready to share their goods than rich people? The answer is easy: The poor have little to lose; the rich have more to lose and they are more attached to their possessions. Poverty provides a deeper motivation for understanding your neighbors, welcoming others and attending to those who are suffering. I would go so far as to say that poverty helps you understand what happiness is, what serenity is in life.

author: Randy Cohen
text: There is a kind of virtue that lies not in extraordinary actions, not in saving poor orphans from burning buildings, but in steadfastly working for a world where orphans are not poor and buildings comply with decent fire codes.

author: Virchand Gandhi
text: The universe is not for man alone, but is a theater of evolution for all living beings. Live and let live is its guiding principle. 'Ahimsa Paramo Dharmah' - Non-injury is the highest religion.

author: Susan Waterfield
text: Really good writing has purpose and that purpose should be to shape other minds to desire truth and a more noble purpose in life and to become more thoughtful and knowledgable about important things like being kind and loving towards all living beings on our planet and not just humans but all animals.

author: Roy  Bennett
text: A random act of kindness, no matter how small, can make a tremendous impact on someone else's life.

author: Kowtham Kumar K
text: Rather than being a human, be a humanitarian

author: Igbinovia Ixrael Lee
text: What weighs us down is not gravity! A little force of kindness can decelerate depravity.

author: R.B. O'Brien
text: I don’t believe in a god, not in the traditional sense anyway. I guess that’s what being raised Catholic has done to me. But I do believe in energy. I do believe in right and wrong. I do believe in kindness and truth.

author: Nurudeen Ushawu
text: My reason to live is to love, my reason to get is to give. - The Lord is my witness.

author: Jenim Dibie
text: Hearts of gold are heavy.

author: D. Antoinette Foy
text: Before you step out into the world today, remember that you will encounter people whose struggles you do not know. Remember the way a pair of eyes light up when greeted with kindness.

author: Michelle Franklin
text: What will I do when you're gone?" said Alasdair, with a faltering voice.Bryeison placed a hand on his shoulder and said, with raging tranquility, "Do what is good and what is right.

author: Millen Livis
text: Don’t try to please others at the expense of your values and your integrity. At the end of the day, you want to like yourself when you look in a mirror.

author: John Ruskin
text: Reading and writing are not education if they do not help people to be kind to all creatures

author: Maya Van Wagenen
text: Real popularity is taking the time to love others, reaching out, and never being afraid to be the first one dancing. REMEMBER THE GIRL IN PEARLS.

author: Michael Levy
text: A person's Acts of #Kindness far outlives their lifespan,for they leave behind a true, meaningful legacy.

author: Pushkar Saraf
text: A Simple act of Kindness can create endless Ripples

author: Monika Zands
text: See your greatness. Be your greatness. Pay it forward.

author: Tara Estacaan
text: Allow your humanity to shine.

author: Og Mandino
text: Extend to each person, no matter how trivial the contact, all the care and kindness and understanding and love that you can muster, and do it with no thought of any reward. Your life will never be the same again.

author: Jeffrey A.  White
text: Let kindness reveal your humanity.

author: Dan George
text: My mother had a kindness that embraced all life.She knew her place well and was comfortable in giving everything she had.This is the tradition of native women.

author: Nirav Sanchaniya
text: Some people don’t want to hurt your feelings.

author: Chris Matakas
text: The quality of your life is directly proportional to the positive effect you have on others’ lives.

author: Nike Thaddeus
text: Allow yourself to see the good in people. Not every sinister face harbors a wicked heart.

author: Jeffrey Lang
text: As I read the Qur’an and prayed the Islamic prayers, a door to my heart was unsealed and I was immersed in an overwhelming tenderness.

author: Ramsey Clark
text: Islam is the only religion that gives dignity to the poor.

author: Hoshiyar
text: There are two souls in a body of a human these souls are GOD & DEVIL.if u r going to do any work it is good or ither it is bad always listen ur GOD's soul.

author: Ilyas Kassam
text: Your inability to see the wisdom in someone else is not a reflection on their lack of perspicacity, it is a reflection on yours.

author: Usama Ejaz
text: Don't play with others, or at one day, you will be played by others.

author: L.M. Fields
text: Hold dear and true friends close to your heart, it matters not where you find them, only that you treat them with love and respect always.

author: Stanley Victor Paskavich
text: I like Kindness it's something the Government can't tax and it's free to give away that will return to you some day

author: Kim R. Shaffer
text: Kindness in your dealings with yourself and others will work wonders in your life. Much more so than rightness in your thinking.

author: Charles Bukowski
text: I heard an airplane passing overhead. I wished I was on it.

author: Bashō Matsuo
text: Every day is a journey, and the journey itself is home.

author: Jess "Chief" Brynjulson
text: They say life is a highway and we all travel our own roads, some good, some bad, yet each is a blessing of its own.

author: Jane Wilson-Howarth
text: A traveller with an open mind grows richer with each journey, with each encounter, with each conversation.

author: Jane Wilson-Howarth
text: On life’s journey, every person met, every place, every new word, language, scent & sound changes the traveller a little: forms who they are and whom they become

author: Hockson Floin
text: The story of life depends on how well you live your life.

author: Will Advise
text: To feel is to go to the places you were.

author: Kevin Keenoo
text: Traveling is as subtle as an early morning reverence.

author: litymunshi
text: my dear life separating you through the journey i actually bend all those easy paths for me was waiting .looking keel of end edge of today's canvas ,life visits stranger to me . i myself kept out me from my own journey

author: David Dweck
text: To find truth, one must travel a dense fog!

author: Murfi (MyMan)
text: If travelling was free, you won't see me again

author: Murfi (MyMan)
text: Travel is my worldSex is natureLove is life

author: Katrice Cabral
text: I get butterflies every time I wander beautiful places I've never been.

author: Allison Fallon
text: We have a set of rules for our faith, our sexuality, our marriages, our dating relationships, for choosing a church—nothing is off-limits. We tell ourselves to always do this, and never do that, and everything will turn out perfectly. Worse than that, we back up our rules with Bible verses and tell everyone else to follow them too.

author: S.K. Tremayne
text: We're all astronauts, really, aren't we; interstellar astronauts, travelling so far into the blackness we can never return.

author: lauren klarfeld
text: If you’ve gone to travel to have fun, you will most likely have no new choices to make. But if you have gone travelling to grow, then you are bound to have to make that choice—that of making a new home and welcoming people in it regardless of how different they are from you.

author: Charles Baudelaire
text: To be away from home and yet find oneself everywhere at home; to see the world, to be at the centre of the world, and yet remain hidden from the world.

author: Paul Theroux
text: If I read enough about one country I sometimes found that the intensity of the reading removed by desire to travel there.

author: M.Rehan Behleem
text: Travel as much as you can because your life is not bigger than this world...!!!

author: Paul Theroux
text: In travel, as in many other experiences in life, once is usually enough.

author: AnnaBella Cavanagh
text: Your Eyes Travel a Thousand Miles,But your mind will travel even more

author: Deejay Kapil
text: It is so gratifying to tell so many stories my eye can romance with, that i become the stories.They shall live on after me, and in that way it makes me immortal

author: Deejay Kapil
text: Every experience has a pattern and sometimes it teaches us through the spirit of patience captured, that there are no coincidences in life.

author: Lillian E. Smith
text: I soon realized that no journey carries one far unless, as it extends into the world around us, it goes an equal distance into the world within.

author: John Mulaney
text: Traveling can get kind of lonely sometimes, er… no, not traveling. What is the word? Life. Life can get kind of lonely.

author: Kahlil Gibran
text: Not without a wound in the spirit shall I leave this city.

author: John Steinbeck
text: Up ahead they's a thousan' lives we might live, but when it comes, it'll on'y be one. If I go ahead on all of 'em, it's too much. You got to live ahead 'cause you're so young, but—it's jus' the road goin' by for me.

author: Ashwin Sanghi
text: A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step unless you missed it.

author: Alex Day
text: If real, regular, normal, boring life, (when you're at home every day, seeing the same people, doing the same things) is like sitting at home on the floor surrounded by toys... traveling feels to me like going to Toys R Us with your toy box and getting to trade stuff in and buy new things and explore whole new ideas.

author: Faith Ringgold
text: I am free to go wherever I want for the rest of my life.

author: Sandra Lake
text: With age, comes wisdom. With travel, comes understanding.

author: Nike Thaddeus
text: Experience is not necessarily accumulated over the extent of time lived. In my opinion, it is accumulated over the degree and variety of activities a person has been involved in

author: Barry López
text: To inquire into the intricacies of a distant landscape, then, is to provoke thoughts about one’s own interior landscape, and the familiar landscapes of memory. The land urges us to come around to an understanding of ourselves.

author: John Muir
text: Only by going alone in silence, without baggage, can one truly get into the heart of the wilderness. All other travel is mere dust and hotels and baggage and chatter.

author: Tawny Lara
text: People add color to their story because they think it happened in black and white.

author: Alan W. Watts
text: To travel is to be alive, but to get somewhere is to be dead.

author: Hilaire Belloc
text: Let me put it thus: that from the height of Weissenstein I saw, as it were, my religion. I mean, humility, the fear of death, the terror of height and of distance, the glory of God, the infinite potentiality of reception whence springs that divine thirst of the soul; my aspiration also towards completion, and my confidence in the dual destiny.

author: Mark Twain
text: Travel is fatal to narrowmindedness, prejudice and bigotry.

author: Harun Yahya
text: I always wonder why birds stay in the same place when they can fly anywhere on the earth. Then I ask myself the same question.

author: Diana Rose Morcilla
text: Every journey has its own traveler. Every dream has its own dreamer. We are all belonged to a specific journey and dream. Some people are currently looking for it, some people are just figuring it out, some people are still lost, and to some they have finally found it.

author: Pradeepa Pandiyan
text: Explore often. Only when you will know how small you are and how big the world is.

author: Constance A. Dunn
text: You can go everywhere, but in the end you run back into yourself.

author: Paul Theroux
text: Ever since childhood, when I lived within earshot of the Boston and Maine, I have seldom heard a train go by and not wished I was on it. Those whistles sing bewitchment: railways are irresistible bazaars... Anything is possible on a train...

author: Grace Lichtenstein
text: Adventure can be an end in itself. Self-discovery is the secret ingredient...

author: T.L. Rese
text: To live is to travel, on a voyage more epic than the odysseys of myth - not from place to place, but through the poignant strangeness of time.

author: Paulo Coelho
text: After weeks on the road, listening to a language you don’t understand, using a currency whose value you don’t comprehend, walking down streets you’ve never walked down before, you discover that your old “I,” along with everything you ever learned, is absolutely no use at all in the face of those new challenges, and you begin to realize that buried deep in your unconscious mind there is someone much more interesting and adventurous and more open to the world and to new experiences.

author: Guido Colombo
text: There are no tips for life neither for travelling

author: Erin Reese
text: India will reveal to you the places in your heart that must be purified.

author: Claire Fontaine
text: Travel empties out everything you’ve into the box called your life, all the things you accumulate to tell you who you are

author: Nyanaponika Thera
text: Two thoughts cannot coexist at the same time: if the clear light of mindfulness is present, there is no room for mental twilight.

author: Tasha Hoggatt
text: Nothing has a greater influence over your life than your thoughts rather they are negative or positive.

author: J. Limbu
text: The idea of one's normality is delusional fact of the reality.

author: Mario Fingarov
text: Solve your problems or your problems solve you.

author: Saga Valsalan
text: Some situations feel worst in our life, but they are the best lessons for life.

author: F.K. Preston
text: There are things we cannot vocalise because the repercussions of particular thoughts have the power to break lives.

author: Saga Valsalan
text: Some' strong decisions stamp you as 'rude'. But in future, they will realize that you were right. But be cautious about the 'Some'.

author: Saga Valsalan
text: The world outside the window is beautiful only if you try to find beauty in those what you see

author: Saga Valsalan
text: The world around you know only that reflects on you, that is the success of a joker too.

author: Saga Valsalan
text: First you will suffer, then you will tolerate and finally you will accept all your pain. Life will be always like this

author: Aaron Dennis
text: Just because everyone agrees that something is true doesn't make it so; everyone was in accord for thousands of years, saying the world was flat, the sun revolved around the earth, but everyone was wrong.

author: Sai Baba
text: All action results from thought, so it is thoughts that matter.

author: Trevor Driggers
text: Even the brightest stars burn out eventually.

author: James Thornton
text: Your perspective guides your thoughts, your choices, your trajectory.

author: Ana Claudia Antunes
text: Having unthoughtful thoughts for me is unthinkable, so much so that I cannot even think about that.

author: Anoop Raghav
text: Quality of life does not depends up on the branded product that you use. It totally depends up on the quality of your thoughts and quality you maintain to express your thoughts

author: Sanober  Khan
text: Some days I don't know what is greater.My wisdom, or my stupidity.

author: Angie karan
text: Cultivate your thoughts in to positive seeds and see your life change for the better!

author: Bharath Mamidoju
text: Thoughts make life tough.

author: Sushil Singh
text: I' is nothing it just a thought..........!

author: Qasim Raza Qadri
text: My Life is My MOM & DAD

author: Theodor W. Adorno
text: The only true thoughts are those which do not grasp their own meaning

author: Udayveer Singh
text: The fear of Mortality is the base of Immortality

author: Even Engesland
text: An action made by an unwitting man, shall not define, nor justify a common thought or interpretation.

author: Even Engesland
text: An action made by an unwitting man, shall not define, nor justify a common thought and interpretation.

author: V.C. Andrews
text: I used to have this toy, a magic slate. You wrote or drew on it and then, just by pulling up the plastic cover, everything you did disappeared and you could start new. Maybe everyone feels that on New Year's Eve: They can pull up the magic sheet and rewrite their lives.

author: Hermann Hesse
text: The world, my friend Govinda, is not imperfect, or on a slow path towards perfection: no, it is perfect in every moment, all sin already carries the divine forgiveness in itself, all small children already have the old person in themselves, all infants already have death, all dying people the eternal life.

author: Angel Death
text: if i had forever to do whatever i wanted, i would spend three years in reality and spend the rest of my time just thinking and decrypting what i saw and what would have happened to make it like so.

author: Alexander Zalan
text: Sometimes I want to impersonate a fountain, but specific circumstances don't allow me to do it.

author: Sukant Ratnakar
text: If your thoughts can change your actions, then your actions can change your thoughts.

author: Saga Valsalan
text: When you change your perspective towards this world, you can find happiness everywhere.

author: Saga Valsalan
text: Love always flows. When we hinder it's path, it gets flooded, destroys everything around it.

author: Jovan Savage
text: Remember You Attract What You Think, Keep Your Thoughts Focus On What You Want and You’ll Be Amazed..

author: Nynke Visser
text: For one must label a thought with language for one can understand the meaning of the thinking mind.

author: Søren Kierkegaard
text: Our life always expresses the result of our dominant thoughts.

author: Henry Martin
text: In an era where Existence is incontestable, Truth is subjective, and Reality is perceived, fiction must mediate between the three.

author: Deeksha Mittal
text: Unhealthy gossiping is one way that divides heaven and hell.

author: William E. Peterson
text: You haven't lived a full life until you have been in a very tough situation when you thought you were going to die. War does that to you.

author: Farid Huseynli
text: Universe is nothing, but human thought.

author: Noel DeJesus
text: Thoughts are free, talk is cheap, and action is expensive. What's your worth?

author: Happy Positivity Blankly Ahead
text: Life is always uncertain. No one knows what's in there. But now my life is everywhere, I would just like to breathe and sleep and get all the rest I could. I wake up five in the morning some days just thinking about my own thoughts and stare blankly in thin air. Not sure what I am looking at but I know for a fact I am in my own world. Those times I am just inside my head just thinking about what is ahead.

author: Savan Solanki
text: It will, It had, It is happening, depending on how you think and react about it.

author: Marie Symeou
text: Life isn't about just talking, it's about thinking too.

author: Cat Alonso
text: You bothered yourself and changed the season. I was left behind with your awful sounds.

author: Diana Rose Morcilla
text: Our every action has consequences. Thoughts have consequences. Since actions start from thoughts I guess I can say technically that thoughts in general have consequences. In our thoughts we make dreams. So if I think I can do it, then my actions will be "I CAN" and I am able to do it. So the result or the consequence will be "I did it!".

author: Shey Stahl
text: If someone asked you what color the sky is, what would you say?

author: Franco Santoro
text: The time we need in order to heal our wounds and finally manifest our deepest dreams is only as long as the gap between two thoughts. These are thoughts in polarity, such as separation and unity, conflict and peace, misery and joy, hate and love, etc. Since as human beings we are all capable of experiencing both thoughts, the only skill we need to develop involves mastering the GAP.

author: Jyoti Mishra
text: I think so muchmay be it never endswhen this night endsthere's another at handI sleep with oneand wake with onewith everything else onthis life goes on.

author: Joel S. Manuel
text: There is no need to suffer silently and there is no shame in seeking help.

author: Alan Cohen
text: Your thoughts do not create reality. They either permit it or they do not.

author: Eve Edwards
text: My thoughts are wing'd with hopes,My hopes with love.Thoughts, hopes and love return to me no more,Until Cynthia shine as she hath done before.

author: Eugene V. Debs
text: I am opposing a social order in which it is possible for one man who does absolutely nothing that is useful to amass a fortune of hundreds of millions of dollars, while millions of men and women who work all the days of their lives secure barely enough for a wretched existence.

author: Jeffrey D. Sachs
text: We need to defend the interests of those whom we've never met and never will.

author: John Maiorana (oohGiovanni)
text: Where wealth is health, bankruptcy is death.

author: Jean-Jacques Rousseau
text: A taste for ostentation is rarely associated in the same souls with a taste for honesty

author: Bertrand Russell
text: ...what is the use of making everybody rich if the rich themselves are miserable?

author: Steve Jobs
text: I think the world’s a better place because Bill realized that his goal isn’t to be the richest guy in the cemetery, right?

author: David Harvey
text: ...those thoroughly incorporated within the inexorable logic of the market and its demands find that there is little time and space in which to explore emancipatory potentialities outside what is marketed as 'creative' adventure, leisure, and spectacle. Obliged to live as appendages of the market and of capital accumulation rather than as expressive beings, the realm of freedom shrinks before the awful logic and the hollow intensity of market involvements

author: Taiwo Abraham
text: If you're perpetually broke, you should be working hard at overcoming stupidity and not getting rich.

author: Yiddish Proverb
text: If the rich could hire other people to die for them, the poor could make a wonderful living.

author: Ingrid Nkenlifack
text: There are two types of people in life when it comes to their careers: people who visualize, and people who imitate. The people who visualize paint their own vision of what their mark is in the world, while the people who imitate can only see what the visualizers want them to.

author: J.R. Tompkins
text: She bent and placed a single daisy upon the grave. A simple white daisy. The plainest of flowers, perhaps the purest, Elspeth thought. It had cost next to nothing at all, and perhaps that was the point. She wasn’t being cheap. She was being symbolic. In her mind, Andrea deserved only the unstained purity of the simplest of daisies, a daisy that was unsoiled by a wealth that couldn’t find the money to have claimed her soul.

author: Andrew-Knox B Kaniki
text: Sharing knowledge is sharing wealth

author: Richard Goldschmidt
text: I have accumulated a wealth of knowledge in innumerable spheres and enjoyed it as an always ready instrument for exercising the mind and penetrating further and further. Best of all, mine has been a life of loving and being loved. What a tragedy that all this will disappear with the used-up body!

author: Joseph Murphy
text: God is the source of my supply. His riches flow to me freely, copiously, and abundantly. All my financial and other needs are met at every moment of time and point of space; there is always a divine surplus.

author: Hamzat haruna Ribah
text: Those who fight for food will die in hunger, those who fight for wealth will end up poor heated, only those who seek knowledge and freedome will succeed even at there past.

author: Anthon St. Maarten
text: We have created a manic world nauseous with the pursuit of material wealth. Many also bear their cross of imagined deprivation, while their fellow human beings remain paralyzed by real poverty. We drown in the thick sweetness of our sensual excess, and our shameless opulence, while our discontent souls suffocate in the arid wasteland of spiritual deprivation.

author: Joseph C. Kunz Jr.
text: True wealth, success, and happiness can only be achieved by balancing our business life with the duty we have to our self and to our family.

author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
text: Thought and knowledge are natures in which apparatus and pretension avail nothing. Gowns, and pecuniary foundations, though of towns of gold, can never countervail the least sentence or syllable of wit. Forget this, and out American colleges will recede in their public importance whilst they grow richer every year.

author: فرید الدین عطار
text: How arrogant you areTo think your wretched Self so singular!The disappointments of this world will dieIn less time than the blinking of an eye,And as the earth must pass, pass by the earth Don't even glance at it, know what it's worth;What empty foolishness it is to careFor what must one day be dispersed to air!

author: Poppy Z. Brite
text: Some nights are made for torture, or reflection, or the savoring of loneliness.

author: Andy Rooney
text: If you smile when you are alone, then you really mean it.

author: Masashi Kishimoto
text: The pain of being alone is completely out of this world, isn't it? I don't know why, but I understand your feelings so much, it actually hurts.

author: Dag Hammarskjöld
text: What makes loneliness an anguish is not that I have no one to share my burden, but this: I have only my own burden to bear.

author: Virginia Woolf
text: To whom can I expose the urgency of my own passion?…There is nobody—here among these grey arches, and moaning pigeons, and cheerful games and tradition and emulation, all so skilfully organised to prevent feeling alone.

author: Jacob Baylis
text: Loneliness is the endless disease that eats at our soul.

author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
text: No one has ever properly understood me, I have never fully understood anyone; and no one understands anyone else

author: Leonard Cohen
text: A teacher I once had told me that the older you get, the lonelier you become and the deeper the love you need. Loneliness creates an appetite for deeper love, and the entire predicament deepens. And as a result of suffering, your capacity to love deeply increases.

author: Ellie Elisabeth
text: I think the hardest part of being a teenage, or any age really, is the misconception that you're alone. You're not alone. You're not the only one going through what you're going through, and life does get better if you want it to.

author: Adel Abouhana
text: No one understands the lines you are writing, and after 25 years you are the only one that speakes that languge .

author: Robert Silverberg
text: The main thing about aliens is that they are alien. They feel no responsibility for fulfilling any of your expectations. (Dark City Lights)

author: Luis Barragán
text: Art is made by the alone for the alone.

author: Ingmar Bergman
text: Here, in my solitude, I have the feeling that I contain too much humanity.

author: Muhammad Anwar Jalil
text: Beware! devil occupies your soul with forbidden desires

author: Chun Yang Hee
text: To you who eat a lot of rice because you’re lonely, To you who sleep a lot because you’re bored, To you who cry a lot because you are sad, I write this down. Chew on your feelings that are cornerned like you would chew on rice.Anyway, life is something that you need to digest.

author: Jerhia
text: Lonely and Alone: There's a difference.

author: Durgesh Satpathy
text: She never wished for the thing what she is experiencing. It is her inner voice that became her enemy.

author: Anne Michaels
text: The mainland can stretch until it breaks at the weakest points, and those weaknesses are called faults. Each island represented a victory and a defeat: it had either pulled itself free or pulled too hard and found itself alone. Later, as these islands grew older, they turned their misfortune into virtue, learned to accept their cragginess, their misshapen coasts, ragged where they'd been torn. They acquired grace.

author: Veronica Franco
text: The life is cruel death to me without you.

author: Nikolai A. Berdyaev
text: God desires that man should be. God does not wish to be alone. The meaning of existence is the conquest of loneliness, the acquisition of kinship and nearness.

author: Sam Killermann
text: Loneliness is a poison, but aloneness is a catalyst.

author: Penelope Gilliat
text: There is a predictable interlude when the rivals suddenly come together and speak for a second of their common loneliness, thus tritely demonstrating that we really are all the same, though I can't think of any really first-rate film, play, or book that isn't unconsciously dedicated to the fact that we are all inconsolably different.

author: Laura Hanna
text: For the first time in my life, I actually wished that everyone was the same. And I despised myself for my "differentness" or "uniqueness" as an individual. In the world there are lots of social groups people can fit into, and I've spent time roaming in and out of a few and being kicked out of many. Now I stand on the outside and look in. Wondering where is my place. Coming to a conclusion, I have no place.

author: Agnostic Zetetic
text: Fighting makes us feel alive, until it kills us. If it doesn’t kill us, the pain of sitting alone with ourselves, quietly, under constant assault by our own thoughts and memories of war can easily be enough to make us wish we’d died in battle instead.

author: Shinedown
text: I kept my whole life in suitcase, Never really stayed in one place,Maybe that's the way it should be,You know I live my life like a gypsy.

author: Albert Einstein
text: How was I able to live alone before, my little everything? Without you I lack self-confidence, passion for work, and enjoyment of life--in short, without you, my life is no life.[Written to his wife, Mileva]

author: Ted Dekker
text: Everyone is a lonely victim of life's complexity.

author: Stephen Smoke
text: It is one of life's great ironies that most people's only connection to success is their attachment to the pain of not having achieved it.

author: Bronnie Ware
text: Loneliness isn’t a lack of people. It is a lack of understanding and acceptance.

author: Janis Ian
text: So remember those who win the gameLose the love they sought to gainIn debitures of quality and dubious integrityTheir small-town eyes will gape at youIn dull surprise when payment dueExceeds accounts received at seventeen

author: Jack Kerouac
text: I was amazed by the fact that I was not the only writer living, not the only young man "with a locomotive in his chest, and that's a fact," not the only youth with a million hungers and not one of them appeasable, not the only one who is lonely among multitudes, and does not know why.

author: George Linnaeus Banks
text: I live for those who love me, for those who know me true; for the heaven that smiles above me and awaits my spirit too. For the cause that lacks assistance, for the wrong that needs resistance, for the future in the distance, and the good that I can do.

author: Robert Louis Stevenson
text: Truth in spirit, not truth to the letter, is the true veracity,

author: Lao Tzu
text: Highly evolved people have their own conscience as pure law.

author: Adolf Hitler
text: don't let what other people think, stop you from doing the things you love

author: R. W. Patterson
text: I know you’re tired…but this is your time, Laney. Claim your power. Make everything…from the beginning until the end…make it all count.

author: Soke Behzad Ahmadi
text: The purpose of Karate is to guide you out of trouble by any means necessary, both in actual combat and in life

author: Cass van Krah
text: Black hawk down.Black eagle up.

author: Sook Nyul Choi
text: One’s life is short, but the life of the spirit is long.

author: Gerry  Boylan
text: As we balance and become more and more identified with our spiritual nature, and the ego returns to its designated place, we again are led by the Spirit, but now in a conscious way.

author: Phoenix
text: The prophecy Revelations tells three stories1) God's plan to use mankind to transform a darker spirit and soul into light2) To use the Law of Creation and its processes to facilitate this plan3) To guide the collective spirit and consciousness of mankind from dark to light and then then God. As we grow the spirit of business systems that were created over the past several thousand of years will evolve too.

author: Khang Kijarro Nguyen
text: Identical twins do not possess identical souls.

author: C.L. Swinney
text: When life throws you curve balls, become a curve ball hitter.

author: Erin Fall Haskell
text: I'm not here to win the rat race of materialism. I am here to experience the depths of my soul in form.

author: Erin Fall Haskell
text: To love life is to love all of it.

author: Justin Kyle McFarlane Beau
text: Never once, did Christ ever utter, "I came here to start a religion"Early Christians did not worship items, relics, wars, or governments.

author: Ikechukwu Izuakor
text: Submission is not in the bowing of heads or knees but in the humbling of your whole being (spirit, soul and body)

author: Tagor Manroo
text: If you want to find a way, you have to go

author: Ikechukwu Izuakor
text: When words are too heavy for the mouth, the soul weeps in agony

author: Dave Zebian
text: You are a cosmic traveler; your body is temporary, but its essence is eternal...

author: Jacob Nordby
text: I have come to differentiate not at all between what is spiritual and the rest of life. There is only Life, all of it is good and the more I am aware of this in every moment, the more my spirit comes alive.

author: Elizabeth George
text: God’s Word is the tool the Holy Spirit uses to change our worldly thinking to heavenly thinking.

author: Dave Zebian
text: The waves of love roll throughout the Universe, and overflow in our hearts..Everything is ONE!

author: Swami Mukerji
text: Life is a series of awakenings.

author: Dr. Glen A. Staples
text: Be specific in your prayers. Carefully craft what you speak. What you say should be in accordance with the word of God and the guidance of the Holy Spirit. You will find that this will resolve attacks or issues that arise.

author: Rabbi Nachman de Bratslav
text: As the hand held before the eye conceals the greatest mountain, so the little earthly life hides from the glance the enormous lights and mysteries of which the world is full, and he who can draw it away from before his eyes, as one draws away a hand, beholds the great shining of the inner worlds.

author: Nuno Rosa
text: My distant but always a close friend, the loss of a mother is always painful for her children, I am beside you in this hour of grief. Life can be a stepmother , really severe! but in return also too short. soon will come the time you will say the words that you didn't said , you will do what you did not have time to do, to forgive you own for what you did not want to sayd .... Time exists in our soul, only the spirit is eternal.

author: Eve Glicksman
text: Ancient lovers believed a kiss would literally unite their souls, because the spirit was said to be carried in one's breath.

author: G.G. Renee Hill
text: Work filled with inspiration is worship. A heart filled with courage is unbreakable. A life filled with gratitude is fulfilled.

author: Leigh Hershkovich
text: Stand strong, firm and rooted like a solid tree. Though distractions may cause you to waver, remain balanced and calm. Otherwise, you will surely snap in half and fall to the ground at the slightest hint of difficulty. Be a filter, not a sponge. Learn to remove unnecessary junk from your life before it becomes a part of who you are. Stand tall, stand proud, keep your eyes and your body focused. Otherwise, you will blow away with the slightest gust of wind.

author: Nancy  Ash
text: When you let Soul drive the bus, life flows more effortlessly. -- From the book, Doing a 360, page 8

author: Usha Cosmico
text: The thing you let Die within when you are Alive, will be carried with your Soul after Death.

author: Patsie Smith
text: Global transformation can occur only when each individual has the courage to awaken from this amnesia to our true self and then make conscious choices true to our spirit. The human race is the only species on earth evolved enough to be capable of this privilege.

author: Peter   Atkins
text: The challenge of elucidating living processes -- including consciousness and all its baggage which we bundle together as 'the human spirit' -- is only one example of a challenge where hard work is paying off and science does not need to accept the false explanations peddled by religions.

author: LeeAnn Taylor
text: There is no ownership. There is only stewardship.

author: Simon Boylan
text: Beneath the cacophony of sound generated by our world lies the quiet whisper of universal intelligence. Allow it to be heard...

author: Gerard de Marigny
text: Of all the hardships and deprivations a people can suffer, I am not sure if the deprivations of art and culture are not the most devastating. As meat and rice are food for the body, art and culture are food for the soul. Starve the body and the person dies; starve the soul and the spirit dies.

author: Simon Boylan
text: All great religions hold the power to enslave & the power to enlighten...

author: Jocelyn  Murray
text: Some journeys lead nowhere, but they set the spirit free

author: Mohammad Ali Shomali
text: ..Imam Ali [A]..'However knows himself (his soul or spirit) knows [or has known] his Lord

author: Elizabeth Gilbert
text: Being content with what you have already is an art form that leads to a peace that can’t be replaced by anything else.

author: Margaret Elphinstone
text: If I imagine my soul, as I do when I pray, it's shaped like Stapafel. No change of place or religion can alter that. I lived beneath Stapafel from the hour I was born until I was sixteen. I've never seen it since, but that doesn't matter. My soul is in the likeness of a jagged peak with a rock like a man standing on its summit, and snags of rock shaped like trolls along its spine. Screes defend it, although it's not quite inaccessible if you know the way up.

author: Hiroko Sakai
text: What are we artists for? We are for showing you what you've wandered for to find the home of your spirit...

author: Anaïs Nin
text: And the day came when the risk to remain tight in a bud was more painful than the risk it took to blossom.

author: F. Scott Fitzgerald
text: Grown up, and that is a terribly hard thing to do. It is much easier to skip it and go from one childhood to another.

author: Peter Golkin
text: My two favourite things in life are libraries and bicycles. They both move people forward without wasting anything. The perfect day: riding a bike to the library.

author: Cynthia Occelli
text: For a seed to achieve its greatest expression, it must come completely undone. The shell cracks, its insides come out and everything changes. To someone who doesn't understand growth, it would look like complete destruction.

author: Nemo Nox
text: Rocks in my path? I keep them all. With them I shall build my castle.

author: Antonio Porchia
text: We become aware of the void as we fill it.

author: Henry David Thoreau
text: It is not that we love to be alone, but that we love to soar, and when we do soar, the company grows thinner and thinner until there is none at all. …We are not the less to aim at the summits though the multitude does not ascend them.

author: Richard M. Nixon
text: The finest steel has to go through the hottest fire.

author: Bernard Berenson
text: Consistency requires you to be as ignorant today as you were a year ago.

author: Jeanette Winterson
text: If I can't stay where I am, and I can't, then I will put all that I can into the going.

author: F. Scott Fitzgerald
text: Summer is only the unfulfilled promise of spring, a charlatan in place of the warm balmy nights I dream of in April. It’s a sad season of life without growth…It has no day.

author: Jalaluddin Rumi
text: If you are irritated by every rub, how will your mirror be polished??

author: Jim Loehr
text: We grow the aspects of our lives that we feed – with energy and engagement – and choke off those we deprive of fuel. Your life is what you agree to attend to.

author: Nancy Mairs
text: Out of the new arrivals in our lives--the odd word stumbled upon in a difficult text, the handsome black stranger who bursts in one night through the cat door, the telephone call out of a friend's silence of years, the sudden greeting from the girl-child---we constantly make of ourselves our selves.

author: Vernon Howard
text: By cultivating the beautiful we scatter the seeds of heavenly flowers, as by doing good we cultivate those that belong to humanity.

author: Serina Hernandez
text: I love the smell of rain and growing things.

author: Forest Whitaker
text: I try to be like a forest: revitalizing and constantly growing.

author: Jennifer DeLucy
text: Let the darkness find you if it must. Throw off the quick and tempting escapes, and seek help only from those who would teach you to grow, feed your soul, embrace your heart, but would not steal away your journey.

author: Harold J. Duarte-Bernhardt
text: We are all broken and wounded in this world. Some choose to grow strong at the broken places.

author: Amby Burfoot
text: As we run, we become.

author: Samuel Rutherford
text: Oh thrice fools are we who like new-born princes weeping in the cradle know not that there is a kingdom before them then let our Lord's sweet hand square us and hammer us and strike off the knots of pride self-love and world-worship and infidelity that He may make us stones and pillars in His Father's house.

author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry
text: there is no growth except in the fulfillment of obligations

author: Jennifer DeLucy
text: For within your flesh, deep within the center of your being, is the undaunted, waiting, longing, all-knowing. Is the ready, able, perfect. Within you, waiting its turn to emerge, piece by piece, with the dawn of every former test of trial and blackness, is the next unfolding, the great unfurling of wings, the re-forged backbone of a true Child of Light.

author: Scott Edmund Miller
text: Growth is an unavoidable part of life. Whether we mean for it to happen or not, our bodies continually nourish and regenerate themselves, our minds continually learn and expand, and our lives continually evolve. We have the power to craft our growth the way a landscaper crafts a majestic garden, or we can leave it to chance, allowing it to unfold wild as the weeds that spread across a vacant lot.

author: Tracey Bond
text: Online & social media subscribers are hungry for content, but when newsfeeding them for growth, try not to get them juiced up for more email junk they’ll trash over trunk…quality over quantity is the preferred principle thing!

author: Slaven Vujic
text: Rejoice in small things and they will continue to grow

author: Hans Zimmer
text: If somebody tells you a rule, break it. That's the only thing to move things forward.

author: Unknownimous
text: You will never get what you've never had if you never do what you've never done

author: Rachel Joyce
text: Sometimes caring for something already growing is more perilous than planting something new.

author: Manas A Datta
text: To be what it takes for truly being is the most profound skill among all that exists in any form

author: Haresh Sippy
text: The best way for you to grow is to sack yourself.

author: Seth Godin
text: The thing is, incremental daily progress (negative or positive) is what actually causes transformation. A figurative drip, drip, drip. Showing up, every single day, gaining in strength, organizing for the long haul, building connection, laying track — this subtle but difficult work is how culture changes.

author: Jeanette Winterson
text: People do go back, but they don't survive, because two realities are claiming them at the same time. Such things are too much. You can salt your heart, or kill your heart, or you choose between the two realities. There is so much pain here.

author: Seema Brain Openers
text: Obstacles are there to give you more opportunities to grow and excel in life.

author: Seema Brain Openers
text: Give to grow. Read to lead. Smile to celebrate.

author: Seema Brain Openers
text: The people who make you feel small, unworthy and valueless are toxic people. You can never expect to grow in life by being close to them. Leave them to grow in life.

author: Criss Jami
text: People assume that repetition is always a static thing, but I beg to differ. Repetition is just as often the complete opposite of that: or a sign of rapid personal growth. In this repetition manifests one's ability to go on experiencing again the very same thing from a different perspective and in a brand-new light.

author: Joan Walton Collaso
text: You go through so many changes as a child, then you grow up and discover that none of that stuff mattered, except for the impression it made on your mind.

author: Vatsal Surti
text: Maturity is the ability to see what is important and what is not.

author: Erica Alex
text: Reinvention is no rushed religion.

author: Brian Awehali
text: Rust may never sleep, but then, neither does moss.

author: Pete Waterman
text: What do you do if you've got everything?There's only one thing you can do. More.

author: Nan Shepherd
text: Knowing another is endless...The thing to be known grows with the knowing.

author: Richard Paul Evans
text: The thing is, the only real sign of life is growth. And growth requires pain. So to choose life is to accept pain. Some people go to such lengths to avoid pain that they give up on life. They bury their hearts, or they drug or drink themselves numb until they don’t’ feel anything anymore. The irony is, in the end their escape becomes more painful than what they’re avoiding.

author: Kevin J. Donaldson
text: Every setback is an opportunity to grow.

author: Rosette Mugidde Wamambe
text: Growth is the process of gradual increase towards living a fulfilled life

author: Now and Then
text: As we grow older, it becomes difficult to just believe. It's not that we don't want to, but too much has happened and we can't.

author: John Bruna
text: The only thing that separates the person you are from the person you want to be are the actions you take.

author: Ufuoma Apoki
text: When a situation becomes too uncomfortable for you, it's either it's way bigger than you can handle or you've become too big for it. The catch, though, is that you decide which is - To outgrow it or let it grow all over you.

author: Stephen Caldwell
text: Faith in Christ is a one-time decision that leads to a lifetime of growth.

author: Wordions
text: The seed must be buried, for the flower to bloom.

author: Parker J. Palmer
text: The people who help us grow toward true self offer unconditional love, neither judging us to be deficient nor trying to force us to change but accepting us exactly as we are. And yet this unconditional love does not lead us to rest on our laurels. Instead, it surrounds us with a charged force field that makes us want to grow from the inside out — a force field that is safe enough to take the risks and endure the failures that growth requires.

author: E. Obeng-Amoako Edmonds
text: If I knew what I know today, years ago, I wouldn’t change a thing about anything. I would not have appreciated what I know today if it hadn’t been for what I didn’t know.

author: Eileen Anglin
text: Everyday my life gets better and better. I make loving, life affirming choices daily to create an amazing life.

author: M. Scott Peck
text: The will to grow is in essence the same phenomenon as love. Love is the will to extend oneself for spiritual growth. Genuinely loving people are, by definition, growing people.

author: Heather Nova
text: If I flew for you, you would still be standing.

author: Angie karan
text: Good laughter, or even a smile. It makes everything grow. It makes people Love you.

author: Angie karan
text: Life has a way of forcing us to grow in one way or another, constantly. We sometimes try to stem the growth by being unbending..yet, look what happens to the branches of a tree, if they refuse to bend to whims of the weather? They snap and break...If one starts to learn to be flexible and not resist life.... one steps into the kind of Mastery that is able to walk on the waters of time

author: Aayush Jain
text: To present is to take a stand and being responsible.

author: Alper Durukan
text: Embrace the uncertainty; there is either a massive growth or catastrophic destruction for you lying underneath, there comes its joy.

author: Thich Nhat Hanh
text: We tend to think of nourishment only as what we take in through our mouths, but what we consume with our eyes, our ears, our noses, our tongues, and our bodies is also food. The conversations going on around us, and those we participate in, are also food. Are we consuming and creating the kind of food that is healthy for us and helps us grow?

author: Dionna L. Hayden
text: Your faith requires your action to back it up. Choose to see what part you must participate in to see your circumstance improve and personally grow and appreciate the victory because of it.

author: Dionna L. Hayden
text: The middle [those rough patches that come before the completion of our milestones] is only a temporal place, never settle there or cut corners to get out!

author: Asuni LadyZeal
text: Unsuccessful people think the end justifies the means. Successful people understand that the means justifies the end; if the means isn't available, the end can wait. Successful people simply cut their coat according to their size, then grow by increasing their size.

author: Sanjo Jendayi
text: A person can't heal as long as they are deflecting and blaming. One must accept responsibility for their own actions and make the shift necessary for growth.

author: Raewyn Connell and Nour Dados
text: ...distinction between growth and development. Aggregate growth in national economic indicators need not mean an improved life for the majority of the people.

author: Jessica Livingston
text: The really dramatic growth happens when a startup only has three of four people, so only three or four people see that, whereas tens of thousands see business as it's practiced by Boeing or Philip Morris.

author: Khang Kijarro Nguyen
text: Prune the ill branches so that a tree grows.Prune the dilapidated buildings so that a city flourishes.

author: Stacy A King
text: If we dismiss all of our hard work, including the very foundation we stand on, and its cracks, we won’t get very far because it takes a foundation from which to begin. Be proud, and embrace “your normal.

author: Jerrold Mundis
text: I heaved into being, came out of the stone, the bricks, and other elements, and took form. (Dark City Lights)

author: John Mark Green
text: Beautiful are those whose brokenness gives birth to transformation and wisdom.

author: Sam Raimi
text: When we read stories of heroes, we identify with them. We take the journey with them. We see how the obstacles almost overcome them. We see how they grow as human beings or gain qualities or show great qualities of strength and courage and with them, we grow in some small way

author: Amitava Chowdhury
text: Inability to accept positive change is a hindrance to growth.

author: James Emlund
text: Destroy yourself. Be on the edge of it all, and right before that weird place tells you to let it go completely; let the energy go in all directions. Falling on your face will never be fun, or purposeful. You don't own energy; you own the inertia!

author: Lemn Sissay
text: I do... to this day, think that success is being able to look in the mirror and know that I'm alright on that day. I don't believe I've made it–I believe that I'm making it. I believe that I've found my past so that I can live in the present, it's the most important thing to me. The books and the plays and the touring and the gigs and the speeches and the cash...it all pales into insignificance when compared with knowing that I didn't do anything wrong, and I'm going to be okay now.

author: Darmie O-Lujon
text: A person who faces unique miseries learns much. All time transports him rich insights.

author: Dave Shepp
text: No man has been able to do everything he wants without experiencing failures first.

author: Renee Cefalu
text: Every person, experience and circumstance are opportunities for spiritual growth and development. They are not coincidences… they are synchronicities.

author: Micheline Jean Louis
text: The universe begins in infinity and move in infinity, your soul is part of the universe you have no end; your soul will always thrive in eternal flame.

author: Alejandro Jodorowsky
text: You are engaging in madness. I feel obliged to accompany you.

author: April Mae Monterrosa
text: Powerful words, a soft embrace, & facial expression that can warm your heart. Growth shows you to appreciate what you didn't before.

author: Ed Catmull
text: Negative feedback may be fun, but it is far less brave than endorsing something unproven and providing room to grow.

author: Suzy Kassem
text: Whenever you should doubt your self-worth, remember the lotus flower.Even though it plunges to life from beneath the mud, it does not allow the dirt that surrounds it to affect its growth or beauty. Be that lotus flower always. Do not allow any negativity or ugliness in your surroundings destroy your confidence, affect your growth, or make you question your self-worth.

author: April Mae Monterrosa
text: Better to step out of your comfort zone, enjoy new experiences & not know what's coming your way, than stick to routines & be bored with the same end results.

author: Andrea Goeglein
text: So much of personal development and growth comes down to the decisions you make when you hit a wall. Do you spend your time feeling bad for yourself, or do you invest your time in continuing to build toward your dreams?

author: Evy Michaels
text: Like seeds we start small, grow together and stand tall

author: Fahad Rashiq
text: Generation is the Important factor,of the Growth of Ideas.

author: L.M. Montgomery
text: I ought to grow up successfully, and I'm sure it will be my own fault if I don't. I feel it's a great responsibility because I have only one chance. If I don't grow up right I can't go back and begin over again.

author: Kaitlin DS Cammie
text: I am a phoenix rising from the ashes of my pain and suffering. Today I am reborn, today begins my growth and change.

author: Banana Yoshimoto
text: I’ll never be able to be here again. As the minutes slide by, I move on. The flow of time is something I cannot stop. I haven’t a choice. I go. One caravan has stopped, another starts up. There are people I have yet to meet, others I’ll never see again. People who are gone before you know it, people who are just passing through. Even as we exchange hellos, they seem to grow transparent. I must keep living with the flowing river before my eyes.

author: Cheryl Strayed
text: You've earned the right to grow. You're going to have to carry the water yourself.

author: Boris Pasternak
text: I am weary of this notion of faithfulness to a point of view at all cost. Life around us is ever changing, and I believe that one should try to change one’s slant accordingly—at least once every ten years. The great heroic devotion to one point of view is very alien to me—it’s a lack of humility. Mayakovsky killed himself because his pride would not be reconciled with something new happening within himself—or around him.

author: Lois McMaster Bujold
text: You must learn to give, from sufficiency, not only take, from neediness.

author: Günter Grass
text: They swore by concrete. They built for eternity.

author: Erich Maria Remarque
text: I have awaited a storm that should deliver me, pluck me away and now it has come softly, even without my knowledge. But it is here. While I was despairing, thinking everything lost, it was already quietly growing. I had thought that division was always an end. Now I know that growth also is division. And growth means relinquishing. And growth has no end.

author: Chris Matakas
text: Jiu Jitsu is a vehicle for self-discovery and growth. It reminds me of my ego, of my insecurities, and of my shortcomings.

author: Chris Matakas
text: I train Jiu Jitsu because I recognize that I am a piece of the whole, and as I grow so does that which contains me. The whole of man advances with the growth of a single individual. Every life I influence is benefited from the fact that I have devoted such a large portion of my life to this pursuit. I will be a better husband, father, and whatever other future roles I may hold because of my time in this sport. In making me a better man, I know that society as a whole is improved.

author: Chris Matakas
text: Jiu Jitsu gives me an ideal to strive toward. Technical mastery lies on an infinite continuum and completion of this skill is impossible. Every time I train I have something that I can improve upon, and this will hold true for each and every training session that lies between me and my grave.

author: Paulo Coelho
text: She didn't struggle and so she didn't grow

author: Theodore Parker
text: Never violate the sacredness of your individual self-respect.

author: Carol S. Dweck
text: When you enter a mindset, you enter a new world. In one world--the world of fixed traits--success is about proving you're smart or talented. Validating yourself. In the other--the world of changing qualities--it's about stretching yourself to learn something new. Developing yourself.

author: John Coltrane
text: I believe that man is here to grow into the fullest, the best that he can be. At least this is what I want to do. As I am growing to become whatever I become, this will just come out on the horn. Whatever that's going to be, it will be. I am not so much interested in trying to say what it's going to be. I don't know. I just know that good can only bring good.

author: Richelle E. Goodrich
text: They say if you're a better person today than you were yesterday you're well on the road to perfection. So I figure if I'm a real snot today, tomorrow I should make huge progress.

author: John Patrick Hickey
text: Life is full of lessons for the success-minded person who keeps his/her eyes open to what is going on.

author: Alexandra Elle
text: we can only flourish when we are truly grounded in self. keep that in mind when journeying.

author: Thorstan Osborne
text: In the heart of every apple is an entire orchard waiting only to be planted.

author: Karen   Clark
text: Nothing is lost that cannot be refound" she says in a voice infused with otherworldly authority "this is the Dark Goddess's promise to guide you back to your deepest self and soul. If you choose this Sarah, so will it be.

author: Ann Marlowe
text: It was painful to contemplate the distance between the future of accomplishment I'd imagined for myself twenty years earlier, and the reality...it was painful to understand that the cushion of exceptionality invoked by the drug had made me oblivious to my inertia. And it was painful to have to define myself again, at an age when most people are happy in their own skins.

author: Karen   Clark
text: Your life is your teacher and whatever comes to you is the work of your soul. Things are never as they appear on the surface. Your lessons are woven into your losses and challenges and only you can figure out what they mean and allow them to change you.

author: Glenn A. Maltais
text: Of the obstacles we face while traversing life, the most challenging are often the ones we create from within and project onto our path.

author: Glenn A. Maltais
text: It’s sometimes difficult to align our wants with our needs, for old programing and new paradigms vibrate at very different levels.

author: Karen   Clark
text: You can no longer hide from me. I am your soul ache come to guide you home.

author: Alexandra Elle
text: we all get waves of regret sometimesbut instead of dwelling on what you can’t change,start focusing on what you can.

author: Aisha Mirza
text: Sometimes the best journeys are those, that start when we do not plan, continue how we do not expect and are taking us places we do not know.

author: honeya
text: One who is hungry for growth, doesn't requires motivation and training.. He just needs an opportunity...

author: Bimal Shah
text: Happiness is in all of us and it comes from progress. The root cause of a multiplier effect or a destroyer effect lies inside of us. The multiplication of the happiness in us on a daily basis makes us unique and powerful and gives us the reason for our existence." --Bimal Shah.

author: Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum
text: The ability to live in a stable, safe environment that gives us the opportunity to create, grow and nurture our talents is sadly denied to many in the world today. I am proud to be able to say – as a leader – I can offer this to my people.

author: Charles F. Glassman
text: Habits are familiar and comfortable, putting our reactions on autopilot and often leading us, instead, to great discomfort.

author: Paul Enenche
text: When you have a distaste for what is not yours, you have set the stage for what is yours.

author: Erin Kouvas
text: Life is funny. We all have periods of ups and downs. Of silence and discovery. And then we begin to know who we are. Like watching a rose opening. Ah, we say. And once we do, the love and the wonder truly begin.

author: Dawn Gluskin
text: When intent is rooted in pure love, you dreams will grown and manifest faster than you could ever imagine.

author: Bella Bloom
text: I have stretch marks on my heart.

author: Bruce Lee
text: Be like water making its way through cracks. Do not be assertive, but adjust to the object, and you shall find a way round or through it. If nothing within you stays rigid, outward things will disclose themselves.Empty your mind, be formless. Shapeless, like water. If you put water into a cup, it becomes the cup. You put water into a bottle and it becomes the bottle. You put it in a teapot it becomes the teapot. Now, water can flow or it can crash. Be water my friend.

author: Harvey MacKay
text: Even when change is elective, it will disorient you. You may go through anxiety. You will miss aspects of your former life. It doesn’t matter. The trick is to know in advance of making any big change that you’re going to be thrown off your feet by it. So you prepare for this inevitable disorientation and steady yourself to get through it. Then you take the challenge, make the change, and achieve your dream.

author: Anne Morrow Lindbergh
text: Only in growth, reform, and change, paradoxically enough, is true security to be found.

author: Mandy Hale
text: A girl who truly knows herself is a girl everybody else wants to know

author: Amy Layne Litzelman
text: God created all living things to bring forth seed, not reproduce shrines.

author: Thomas Narofsky
text: Purpose expresses most deeply what makes you a unique individual. Your purpose defines who you are, how you live your life and how you lead. Your purpose provides you with inner strength and drive to live and lead each day. It equips you with what you need to face the challenges of the day and of life. Your purpose provides context and meaning to your life.

author: Leigh Bardugo
text: I think we often hold heroines to an absurd standard. Be brave! Be wise! Always know what's in your heart and speak the truth of it! No and no and no. We fight to be brave. We learn to be wise. We struggle to know ourselves and voice what we want.

author: Martin Luther King Jr.
text: Even if I knew that tomorrow the world would go to pieces, I would still plant my apple tree

author: Xue Yun
text: Spirits arrive at this world in naked bodies, their purpose - to grow wings.

author: Hayley Williams
text: It's confusing when people who do not know me say they miss the old me. You know me merely through the lyrics I write and the pictures I've been in. There is no old or new Hayley. There is however an older Hayley. I'm 25 now. Good on me for living through all these years with a million people's judging eyes all over me and thinking they know me better.

author: A.C. Anderson
text: You are the only common denominator in everything that has happened to you in life, be it good or bad. To learn/grow from these experiences, you must accept the role you played in each of them.

author: Ray Kroc
text: Are you green and growing or ripe and rotting?

author: Mike Mentzer
text: It is only within the context of having properly developed your mind that you will be able to truly enjoy the achievement of your material values, including that of a more muscular body.

author: Rebecca O'Dwyer - Centred Woman
text: Our challenges will probably always be with us but, as we go on our journey of development, we become more aware of them, we come to accept them more, and they have less power over us.

author: Sascha Bosio
text: Know your purpose and you can climb any mountain.

author: Shellen Lubin
text: Nobody adores fertilizer. Nobody devotes their life to fertilizer (unless they own a fertilizer company). But, shit, you need it to grow the crops. The land is arid and dry without it, and trying to grow things is likely to be futile.

author: Kary Mullis
text: Science, like nothing else among the institutions of mankind, grows like a weed every year. Art is subject to arbitrary fashion, religion is inwardly focused and driven only to sustain itself, law shuttles between freeing us and enslaving us.

author: Henry Ward Beecher
text: It is a man's duty to have books. A library is not a luxury, but one of the necessaries in life.

author: Carl-Gustaf Rossby
text: Perhaps I occasionally sought to give, or inadvertently gave, to the student a sense of battle on the intellectual battlefield. If all you do is to give them a faultless and complete and uninhabited architectural masterpiece, then you do not help them to become builders of their own.

author: Brenda Ueland
text: When we are listened to, it creates us, makes us unfold and expand. Ideas actually begin to grow within us and come to life.

author: Innocent Mwatsikesimbe
text: Age doesn't determine maturity. It's the depth of life that does, not its duration.

author: L. Michelle
text: Get your "MENTAL" weight up, it stays FOREVER, money has no staying power!

author: J.W. Lord
text: Our failures make us who we are; they build our character, we are defined by what we do with them, and how we respond to adversity. Without failure there is no growth, no striving for better, no adjusting, or dusting yourself off to try again.

author: Sage Canny
text: The brain cannot learn without wondering, listening, and making connections while your myelin part of your brain develops and grows" ― Sage Canny

author: Robert E. Lee
text: Cadets can neither be treated as schoolboys or soldiers.

author: Stella Payton
text: Like the bud of a flower, change forces you to surrender to growth. It makes you vulnerable. It requires you to enlarge, expand and become bigger. Like the oxygen provided with each breath, we are denied its benefits until we relax and breathe in.

author: Jeff Bezos
text: No business can continue to shrink. That can only go on for so long before irrelevancy sets in.

author: Nkem Paul
text: Succeeding in life and business is like falling in love with your wife (for those of you that are married). You can’t leave your wife at the mercy of another man and feel safe.

author: Chukwudifu Oputa
text: Without education … what is man but a splendid slave, a reasoning savage vacillating between the dignity of an intelligence derived from God and the degradation of passion participated with brutes…

author: Simon Boylan
text: Every interaction presents an opportunity for growth, one of the keys to our limitless potential.

author: Takina Cupp
text: Usually when your imagination is bigger then one's comprehension, this normally means you've out grown the small circle. Get with like-mined people and go after your vision.By T-cupp

author: Terri Frey Maxwell
text: Inspiration is born when our passion becomes greater than our fear.

author: Emma Goldman
text: Consciously or unconsciously, most theists see in gods and devils, heaven and hell, reward and punishment, a whip to lash the people into obedience, meekness and contentment.... The philosophy of atheism expresses the expansion and growth of the human mind. The philosophy of theism, if we can call it a philosophy, is static and fixed.

author: Jay Perry

author: John C. Maxwell
text: If we're growing, we're always going to be out of our comfort zone.

author: Emily Carr

author: Lada Ray
text: Being present here and now is the highest compliment you can pay to a woman in your life.

author: Dejan Stojanovic
text: We grow from our dreams.

author: Phil Wohl
text: Growth occurs unabated free of obstacles.

author: Martin Suarez
text: Growth happens slowly, slow down today enjoy life without been in hurry

author: Iyanla Vanzant

author: Margaret Fuller

author: Henri J.M. Nouwen
text: First, silence makes us pilgrims. Secondly, silence guards the fire within. Thirdly, silence teaches us to speak.

author: Carl Rogers
text: Growth occurs when individuals confront problems, struggle to master them, and through that struggle develop new aspects of their skills, capacities, views about life.

author: Brenda Johnson Padgitt

author: Ashley Porter
text: Adapt to your surrounding but remain flexible for growing.

author: Sierra Lawrimore

author: E.A. Bucchianeri
text: A conscience without regrets ~ to live life without having to say you're sorry.

author: Svaradiva

author: Scott Joffe
text: When one door shuts... sometimes it's best to leave it shut, and move on...

author: Monika Zands

author: Monika Zands

author: Bob Proctor

author: Johnnie Dent Jr.
text: Live through it or grow from it.

author: Soul Dancer
text: Fear melts like ice when we allow love's divine light to shine upon our ignorance.

author: Runa Magnus
text: Embrace everything you put your hearts on... for you will surly achieve it

author: Silvia Hartmann
text: If you are HUMAN, then the limit of what you can do, what you learn, what you can experience HAS NOT YET BEEN REACHED.

text: People will kill you. Over time. They will shave out every last morsel of fun in you with little, harmless sounding phrases that people uses every day, like: 'Be realis

text: If you want to be a grocer, or a general, or a politician, or a judge, you will invariably become it; that is your punishment. If you never know what you want to be, if you live what some might call the dynamic life but what I will call the artistic life, if each day you are unsure of who you are and what you know you will never become anything, and that is your reward.

author: Robert Louis Stevenson
text: An aim in life is the only fortune worth finding.

author: Ashly Lorenzana
text: If you're going to do something, strive to do it better than anyone else. Do it all the way. If you're going to half-ass it, why bother?

author: Kelly Cutrone
text: If you don't have a well-thought out dream, you can start by figuring out where you want to go. If you cannot see yourself fairly or accurately represented in the community you live (from restaurants to department stores to clothing choices to conversations at the dinner table) and nothing there makes you feel awake or alive, I suggest you start doing some research on some other communities.

author: Bill Copeland
text: The trouble with not having a goal is that you can spend your life running up and down the field and never score.

author: Moonish Sood
text: Make a list of things you like doing and then do them

author: Ahtizaz Wani
text: Numbers are important to the life, you better stay good at arithmetics.

author: Renzo Dante (Saligiare)

author: Saad Salman
text: Sometimes in life, you have to take difficult steps and tough decisions, in order to achieve something bigger.

author: Asuni LadyZeal
text: Life is a chain of events; a journey. Tomorrow's opportunities are a reflection of today's decisions .The good thing is, tomorrow never ends. Every new day comes with a chance to secure tomorrow

author: C.S. Lewis
text: You are never too old to set another goal or to dream a new dream.

author: Fahad Rashiq
text: Struggle for Your Goals, because its too much better than Struggling for Your Life.

author: Marilyn L. Rice
text: Without goals we are nothing more than drifters, drifting where?

author: Blake L. Higginbotham
text: When you decide to be all you can be you will be better for it

author: Ricky Yousuf
text: the only realistic choice is to follow your dreams

author: Dean F. Wilson
text: There are always periodic opportunities to give up, while every single moment is an opportunity to persevere.

author: Jamie Valentin
text: Change words like difficult/impossible/unrealistic to words like challenging/fun/daring/exciting, and then get back to working/playing/competing/winning

author: Darnell Lamont Walker

author: Lolly Daskal
text: There is a big difference between being centered and being self-centered

author: G.G. Renee Hill

author: G.G. Renee Hill
text: Your definition of a good life does not have to look like everyone else thinks it should. Whatever feels right for you, whatever aligns your inside with your outside, that's what you should spend your time doing.

author: JohnA Passaro
text: Went to bed with a dream.Woke up with a purpose.

author: Turcois Ominek

author: Paradise Kiss
text: If I had a dream or a goal… then maybe I would be able to overcome the obstacles in my way.

author: Jennifer I. Lim
text: Intelligence is the key to achieve your dreams.

author: Derek Sivers

author: George Alexiou
text: When you wake up each morning with a burning passion to accomplish a goal, you've already won the day.

author: Cicely Tyson
