text: Paint your life and sketch your way

author: Malcolm Forbes
text: The biggest mistake people make in life is not trying to make a living at doing what they most enjoy.

author: 50 Cent
text: I've made so many mistakes, so many corrections. I'm so far from perfect so many imperfections. But I'm a go getta I get up and go get it, so if you preaching prosperity, i wanna hit it....

author: Jazz Feylynn
text: Teachers' favorite color ink, splashed and dripped down his face a grisly reminder of mistakes bruising his life.

author: HL Balcomb
text: Perfect people make for boring novels.

author: Ace Antonio Hall
text: Our worst can become our best if mistakes are gathered like twigs of a bird's nest, giving one true foundation, a spiritual home to build their life upon.

author: Harshit Walia
text: My approach is different. My mistakes are conscious mistakes. And I learn more than those I despise way too often than those I admire.

author: Piet Hein
text: VITA BREVIS A lifetimeis morethansufficiently longfor people to get what there is of itwrong.

author: Joe Hill
text: I think you must make a few [mistakes]. Of you don't, you're probably thinking too much. That's the worst mistake you can make.

author: Mansi Soni
text: What never stops amazing people is how they make a mistake and learn nothing sometimes. Mistakes happen how much ever you try and run from it. Make mistakes and know you have made them. Don't let the mistakes make you a joke in your own life. Regret nothing and let it go. After all who can stop the inevitable.

author: Roberto Llamas
text: Errors, failures, They are just experiences that will obligate you to evolve.

author: Stan Okunevic
text: I'm not afraid to make mistakes. I'm afraid of not learning from them.

author: Bayan Bahi
text: The more mistakes I make, the least I judge other people's mistakes

author: Sammy Toora
text: Everyone make mistakes and you learn a lesson from them. But, sometimes just one mistake made in influence of something can ruins your whole life.

author: Richard Bach
text: There are no mistakes. The events we bring upon ourselves, no matter how unpleasant, are necessary in order to learn what we need to learn; whatever steps we take, they're necessary to reach the places we've chosen to go....

author: Kimberly Giles
text: Failures, mistakes, and difficulties are just locations on your journey through life. They have nothing to do with who you are.

author: Anne Lamott
text: You have to make mistakes to find out who you aren't. You take the action, and the insight follows: You don't think your way into becoming yourself.

author: Sage Canny
text: Make up for every mistake you make in life. Some of us humans tend to learn from our mistakes and others tend to make the same false mistakes." ― Sage Canny

author: Rebecca McKinsey
text: There’s a difference between a mistake and a regret. Everything up to this moment has made this moment. If you can change a mistake, then go out and do what you can to change it. If you can’t change it, there’s no use regretting it because it will just make you miserable. Live right now, even if that involves dealing with the consequences of your actions. Time travel always ends badly.

author: Fernando Pessoa
text: No-one loves another More than he loves whatever another within may haveThat is part of one's self

author: Beverly S. Harless
text: Every life is a story. Every story has mistakes. If you focus too much on the mistakes, you will miss the story. In doing that, you are making a dreadful mistake yourself. Sometimes, it is the mistakes that enrich and give the story so much more meaning than it would have had otherwise.

author: A Gentlemen
text: I'll be quite for now because I make mistakes too... but once The Perfect Almighty One judges you, there are no excuses.

author: Idries Shah
text: When the Higher Man does something worthy of admiration, it is an evidence of his Mastership, not the object of it.

author: Don Roff
text: Regarding the creative: never assume you're the master, only the student. Your audience will determine if you're masterful.

author: Nikhil Yadav
text: Lying is an art, if you can convince yourself with lie, then you are a master.

author: Bruce R. McConkie
text: Before an empty tomb, we will come to know that Christ our Lord has burst the bands of death and stands forever triumphant over the grave.

author: Bruce R. McConkie
text: As Adam brought death, so Christ brought life; as Adam is the father of mortality, so Christ is the father of immortality.

author: Ron Brackin
text: Subjective truth is an oxymoron; objective truth is redundant. Subjective truth is feathers in a wind tunnel, blowing anywhere and everywhere. Objective truth is an anvil, bolted to the floor of the wind tunnel. Subjective truth is your truth and my truth; objective truth is Jesus Christ—immovable, immutable.

author: Tony Narams
text: We should live our lives Christ was coming this afternoon!

author: Karen Kingsbury
text: Lasting peace is only found through a lifesaving relationship wit Jesus Christ... knowing Christ means that all the world might be falling apart just outside your front door, maybe just inside it - yet that inner peace, that inner knowing, remains unshaken.

author: Evangelist Jordan Wells
text: Were Gods love is present there is always hope.

author: William P. Barker
text: The news that gives you a future with hope, in spite of your despair over the past, is realizing that Jesus has prayed for you and is praying for you now.

author: J.E.B. Spredemann
text: It’s been said that only the educated are free, but I contend. Only those who are educated with TRUTH can be inherently free. Otherwise, you are simply indoctrinated with error.

author: Ron Brackin
text: To hear a truth, we must first suspect that our present truth might not be. Like Alice’s White Queen, who often believed six impossible things before breakfast, I believed many things in my life, considering them to be true at any given time but suspecting that they might not be, until I met Jesus Christ. When we encounter The Truth, we know it and can only accept or reject it. Denial is not an option.

author: Pope Francis
text: Let us draw from the crib the joy and deep peace that Jesus comes to bring to the world.

author: David Holdsworth
text: Father, I serve the Messiah, the Christ. Not any Caesar. His kingdom is not of this world, and no man need fight for it. All empires will pass away, but Christ lives. He is love and peace, and his kingdom will last forever.

author: W. Ian Thomas
text: To so many people, the Lord is in danger of being no more than a patron saint of our systematic theology instead of the Christ Who is our life.

author: Dr Carla Cornelius
text: The best of a human being is still a human being.

author: C.S. Lewis
text: ...if you give such a creature two blows with a whip, there are, indeed, two pains: but there is no co-ordinating self which can recognise that 'I have had two pains'.

author: Peter Kreeft
text: Go back to Socrates: "Know thyself." For Socrates, there are only two kinds of people: the wise, who know they are fools; and fools, who think they are wise. Similarly, for Christ and all the prophets, there are only two kinds of people: saints, who know they are sinners; and sinners, who think they are saints. Which are you?

author: Dean Chavooshian
text: THESE ARE THE REASONS, THEN, FOR WHICH A MAN CAN BE CONFIDENT ABOUT THE FATE OF HIS SOUL – AS LONG AS IN LIFE HE HAS…DEVOTED HIMSELF TO THE PLEASURES OF AQUIRING KNOWLEDGE …WITH SELF CONTROL, AND GOODNESS, AND COURAGE, AND LIBERALITY, AND TRUTH…”SOCRATES’ LAST WORDS IN PLATO’S PHAEDO

author: Idries Shah
text: Angels are the powers hidden in the faculties and organs of man

author: Michael Ruse
text: The definition of a philosopher is a blind man in a dark room looking for a black hat, which isn’t really there. And the definition of a theologian is he’s somebody who finds it.

author: Augustine of Hippo
text: You are not blamed for your unwilling ignorance, but because you fail to ask about what you do not know.... For no one is prevented from leaving behind the disadvantage of ignorance and seeking the advantage of knowledge.

author: Holly Ordway
text: If we, who are finite, contingent, created beings, have got God completely figured out, it makes it seem likely that we invented him...If I am ever completely satisfied with my understanding of who God is and how he operates in the world, I am in danger of ceasing to seek Him.

author: Thomas Watson
text: The bare knowledge of God's will is inefficacious, it doth not better the heart. Knowledge alone is like a winter sun, which hath no heat or influence; it doth not warm the affections, or purify the conscience. Judas was a great luminary, he knew God's will, but he was a traitor.

author: Gore Vidal
text: Once people get hung up on theology, they've lost sanity forever. More people have been killed in the name of Jesus Christ than any other name in the history of the world.

author: John Ruskin
text: Modern science gives lectures on botany, to show there is no such thing as a flower; on humanity, to show there is no such thing as a man; and on theology, to show there is no such thing as a God. No such thing as a man, but only a mechanism, No such thing as a God, but only a series of forces.

author: Jim Walker
text: Everybody has theology whether they admit it or not.

author: Igor Stravinsky
text: I cannot now evaluate the events that, at the end of those thirty years, made me discover the necessity of religious belief. I was not reasoned into my disposition. Though I admire the structured thought of theology, it is to religion no more than counterpoint exercises are to music.

author: John K.  Brown
text: Metagapism is the belief that love is the ultimate reality, literally god and the one shared soul, and the source, nature and destiny of all.

author: John K.  Brown
text: Love isn’t self-centered, even at the supreme scale.

author: John K.  Brown
text: That which isn’t love, isn’t god.

author: Zach Weinersmith
text: When they realized they were in the desert, they built a religion to worship thirstiness.

author: George MacDonald
text: To cease to wonder is to fall plumb-down from the childlike to the commonplace—the most undivine of all moods intellectual. Our nature can never be at home among things that are not wonderful to us.

author: Therese Doucet
text: A Christian is supposed to be in the world, and yet not of the world--a Both/And as perplexing and demanding as the Either/Or that precedes the life of faith. I'm at once a pure, beautiful, genderless soul, but at the same time a gendered body full of flaws, sins, and wanting. This contradiction, the Both/And, is the Cross.

author: Gregory B. Sadler
text: The more rigid and exclusive one makes the border between philosophy and theology, the more that distinction itself has to fall on the side of theology, and the more inaccessible that very distinction becomes to philosophy

author: Jean Renoir
text: The real hell of life is everyone has his reasons.

author: Dante Alighieri
text: And he began, "What chance or destinyhas brought you here before your final day?And who is he who leads your pilgrimage?""Up there in life beneath the quiet starsI lost my way," I answered, "in a valley,before I'd reached the fullness of my age.I turned my shoulders on it yesterday:this soul appeared as I was falling back,and by the road through Hell he leads me home.""Follow your star and you will never fail to find your glorious port," he said to me

author: Elder Porphyrios
text: Somebody who is Christ's must love Christ, and when he loves Christ he is delivered from the Devil, from hell and from death.

author: Irfa Rahat
text: Life is constant, in losing one or another.

author: Tennessee Williams
text: We are all sentenced to solitary confinement inside our own skins, for life.

author: Katharine Graham
text: Left alone, no matter at what age or under what circumstance, you have to remake your life.

author: Dan Davin
text: The emptiness, the way his heels rang on the asphalt,was satisfying, emphasised his aloneness. A man alone, alone late at night with no one to say he should be home in bed.

author: Ahmed Alibage
text: I choose to be alone cause I wanted to experience freedom, but I realized that freedom needs a companionship

author: Thomas Wolfe
text: Lost. He understood that men were forever strangers to one another, that no one ever comes really to know any one, that imprisoned in the dark womb of our mother, we come to life without having seen her face, that we are given to her arms a stranger, and that, caught in that insoluble prison of being, we escape it never, no matter what arms may clasp us, what mouth may kiss us, what heart may warm us. Never, never, never, never, never.

author: Naomi Long Madgett
text: I wouldn't coax the plant if I were you.Such watchful nursing may do it harm.Let the soil rest from so much diggingAnd wait until it's dry before you water it.The leaf's inclined to find its own direction;Give it a chance to seek the sunlight for itself.Much growth is stunted by too careful prodding,Too eager tenderness.The things we love we have to learn to leave alone.

author: Ann Morrow Lindbergh
text: We must re-learn to be alone.

author: Sher E Yazdan
text: Sometimes you have to sit alone and enjoy the nature and try to see in the sky transparent faces.

author: Charles de Leusse
text: We knit alone our life, before seeing by it our shroud. (Nous tricotons notre vie seule, Avant d'y voir notre linceul)

author: Stephen King
text: Alone.Yes,that's the key word, the most awful word in the English tongue. Murder doesn't hold a candle to it and hell is only a poor synonym.

author: Introvertly Bubbly
text: My alone doesn't always feel good, but I'll only have you if you're sweeter than my solitude

author: Matt Maher
text: You are not alone if you are lonely,When you feel afraid, you're not the only.

author: Bernard Cornwell
text: Writing is a solitary occupation.

author: Ishmael Emmanuel Balfour
text: Sometime I wonder why I walk alone on this cold, windy road. Maybe I have no one to love or no one love me at all?

author: Orson Welles
text: We’re born alone, we live alone, we die alone. Only through our love and friendship can we create the illusion for a moment that we’re not alone.

author: pavankumar nagaraj
text: Time has no sense but it makes all the sense

author: Candace Bushnell
text: She didn't want to have anything to do with the party. She was tired of feeling like she didn't fit in, but she didn't want to go home, either, because she was a tired of being lonely and she was a little drunk.

author: Umar ibn Al-Khattab
text: No amount of guilt can change the past and no amount of worrying can change the future

author: William Nolan
text: Its better to regrets what you did, than regret what you didn't do.

author: Nobuyuki Fukumoto
text: At the crossroad in my life, I didn't know which way to go. I just mindlessly choose a random direction... then, after regretting my decision I tried to retrace my steps. However, without even realizing it the sun had already set.

author: Robin Dabhi
text: Live for the moments to die for

author: Ted Hughes
text: The only thing people regret is that they didn't live boldy enough, that they didn't invest enough heart, didn't love enough. Nothing else really counts at all.

author: Michael "Bommi" Baumann
text: I did it, and it's all right. Even the worst experiences were right in their time, because otherwise, it wouldn't have come to this point. That was your road, and you had to walk it.

author: Robin S. Sharma
text: Bravery is the solution to regret.

author: Japanese Proverb
text: What you don't sweat out when you're young will turn into tears when you're old.

author: Aryan Xebat‎
text: I don't fear death, I fear I haven't done enough before it happens

author: Paolo Giordano
text: All he did all afternoon was calculate again and again how many hours of study time he was losing. Thinking about it now, he felt stupid, as we all do when we remember all the time we waste wishing we were somewhere else.

author: A.C. Grayling
text: If there is anything worth fearing in the world, it is living in such a way that gives one cause for regret in the end.

author: Mansi Soni
text: It takes courage to own up your actions that hurt others, to look Into the eye and to mean the sorry, To accept the mistake and not deny, all of this needs courage.

author: Puerto Rican Princess
text: Sometimes it took death for me to see life, don't live with regrets keep your head high. In a world filled with beauty I don't want to blink twice; soak up every moment because you can't stop time.

author: Sue Monk Kidd
text: I'd chosen the regret I could live with best, that's all. I'd chosen the life I belonged to.

author: Sara Teasdale
text: It was a night of early spring,The winter-sleep was scarcely broken;Around us shadows and the windListened for what was never spoken.Though half a score of years are gone,Spring comes as sharply now as then—But if we had it all to doIt would be done the same again.It was a spring that never came;But we have lived enough to knowThat what we never have, remains;It is the things we have that go.

author: Édith Piaf
text: Every damn fool thing you do in this life you pay for.

author: Albert Besselaar
text: We find that one person in life that will stand by us through everything, support us, love us regardless of yourself. That one person that will stand by your side through everything. Grab onto that person with everything for if you don't then one day you will look to your side expecting him to be there and you will find that he is not. So don't take the one for granted that makes you his life. If you do then he will remove you from his...

author: Habeeb Akande
text: The real regrets in life are the risks you didn't take.

author: Leo Tolstoy
text: Happiness is pleasure without regret

author: Georgia O'Keeffe
text: I've been absolutely terrified every moment of my life—and I've never let it keep me from doing a single thing I wanted to do.

author: Thomas Aquinas
text: If the highest aim of a captain were to preserve his ship, he would keep it in port forever.

author: Margaret Peterson Haddix
text: We can hope.

author: Ameya Agrawal
text: Drop your weapons once and they will dig you in to the grave forever.

author: Imran Khan
text: Bravery is standing with the truth and right

author: dhaniRT
text: The truth will be never shared to anyone. They have no bravery to know the truth. You will help us. We will help you.

author: I Heard God Laughing: Poems of Hope and Joy
text: Come in, my dearFrom that harsh worldThat has rained elements of stoneUpon your tender face.Every soulShould receive a toast from usFor bravery!

author: Elmer Davis
text: This nation will remain the land of the free only so long as it is the home of the brave.

author: Kreator
text: Those who serve and those who ruleLepers, kings and mindless foolsEmpire leaders, tyrant's toolsAll will fade with timeHail the cowards, brave at heartThe ugly and the beautifulThose who never felt their soulsAll live transient lives

author: Guster
text: Be calm, be brave, it'll be okay.

author: Horace Bushnell
text: The more difficulties one has to encounter, within and without, the more significant and the higher in inspiration his life will be.

author: Alex Staniforth
text: I had long believed adversity was the greatest teacher, but I learnt that nothing teaches you more about life than death.

author: Carolyn Wells
text: Adversity is neither friend nor foe. It is a common acquaintance that is desired less and rewarded most when embraced.

author: Jeffrey Lewis
text: Life's a story don't you doubt. Bad times give you something to talk about.

author: Nomzamo Nhlumayo
text: And in the face of adversity always remember your light shines brightest in the dark

author: Andrea Walker
text: Life lessons build strength, and life is truly A Beautiful Struggle

author: Colleen Hoover
text: You told me once that too much good in a person's life will stunt their growth. You said pain is necessary, because in order for a person to succeed, they must first learn to conquer adversity. And that's what you do... you deliver adversity where you see fit.

author: E.B. White
text: Hope is the thing that is left to us, in a bad time.

author: Leslie G Nelson
text: When in pain and sorrow, you ask why God allows bad things to happen to good people, remember God allowed His Son, the best of us, to suffer the most so that Christ would have the ability to heal us.

author: Chris Vonada
text: We can't always take the higher road when faced with adversity. Sometimes for the sake of restoration, peace and sharing the love of Jesus, we have to walk through the tribulation.

author: Jonathan Ryan Batson
text: The road to success has many paths. Do not become boggled down on what is out of your control, but be determined to push yourself to adapt to what is in your way so that you can get closer to your dreams. Be inspired in the face of adversity, gracious and humbled in the face of triumph, and fearless in the unknown.

author: the TV show "Gilmore Girls"
text: Life is a battle, and you either enter it armed, or surrender immediately.

author: Garrett Fredlund
text: The devil will never rest, nor sleep, nor turn his head from you. He will find every fault, every weakness, every discrepancy he can magnify, expand and contort every sin to cause you to abort your mission here; to cause you to feel like a worthless, ignoble, useless, piece of garbage to get you to fail in your task that God has for you. So what are you going to do about it?

author: Theodore Roosevelt
text: We Americans have many grave problems to solve, many threatening evils to fight, and many deeds to do, if, as we hope and believe, we have the wisdom, the strength, and the courage and the virtue to do them. But we must face facts as they are. We must neither surrender ourselves to a foolish optimism, nor succumb to a timid and ignoble pessimism.

author: Prophetess Dina Rolle
text: Adversity is not a bad thing~It's a God thing!

author: Sabrina Vourvoulias
text: So, with my knees pierced by needles and my shoulder sewn together by the slender thread of endorphins, I keep to my genuflection and end my story the only way that really fits. As a prayer that seals surrender. World without end. Amen.

author: Anthony T.Hinks
text: Your eyes tell me everything about you.Your words only confirm it.

author: Unsure of Author
text: Every next level of your life will demand a different version of you.

author: Rohan Kulkarni
text: Sometimes it is important to sit back and think about your life. Then you realize how awesome you are.

author: Authur Rubinstein
text: I have found that if you love life, life will love you back.

author: pavankumar nagaraj
text: All the times are best whenever you are with me.

author: Nutan Bajracharya
text: You made me to think of others, by thinking others I may forget you... Be Aware

author: Sanjo Jendayi
text: Everything needs love… and everything you do or don’t do is a reflection of how you love you!

author: Menachem Mendel
text: If you are you because you are you, and I am I because I am I, then you are you and I am I.If you are you because I am I, and I am I because you are you, then you and I are not.

author: Zac Efron Seventeen Again
text: I felt so peaceful and safe because I knew that no matter what happened, from that day on, nothing can ever be that bad..because I had you.

author: Idries Shah
text: When you get a principle on which everyone is agreed, you get the beginning of complacency and deterioration.

author: Idries Shah
text: Understanding and knowledge are completely different sensations in the realm of Truth than they are in the realm of society.

author: Idries Shah
text: If the father cannot, the son will finish the task.

author: Idries Shah
text: Sufism is, in fact, not a mystical system, not a religion, but a body of knowledge.

author: Idries Shah
text: THE BIRD AND THE WATERA bird which has not heard of fresh waterDips his beak in salt-water year after year.(Anwar-i-Suhaili)

author: Idries Shah
text: Knowledge. How curious that a man who closes his hand upon air so often thinks that he has a ruby within his grasp.

author: Idries Shah
text: No surgeon can treat the wounds of the tongue.

author: Idries Shah
text: None meets harm who knows his capacity.

author: Idries Shah
text: Now that I have found thee, I know that in the first step I took, I moved away from thee.

author: Idries Shah
text: Hazrat Ali, in a saying attributed to him, says: ‘Man is in disguise, covered by his tongue’.

author: Idries Shah
text: A short time in the presence of the Friends (the Sufis) is better than a hundred years’ sincere, obedient dedication.

author: Idries Shah
text: Better to quarrel with a friend than to support enemies.

author: Idries Shah
text: The mine is always bigger than the gem.

author: Idries Shah
text: Whoever gives knowledge to a fool loses itAnd who keeps it from the deserving does wrong.

author: Idries Shah
text: Generosity is also marked by doing what one says one will do.

author: Idries Shah
text: Sufism is therefore not 'Do as I say and not as I do', or even 'Do as I do', but 'Experience and you will know'.

author: Idries Shah
text: Sufism is experiential

author: Idries Shah
text: The people of the world have a fixed destiny. But the spiritually developed receive what is “not” in their destiny.

author: Sara Barnard
text: I was sixteen, and I honestly believed that I was due a love story.

author: Alex Guidroz
text: Maybe in the future when life sees that we are ready for love we will meet up or stumble upon each other and it will ignite the light inside of us that we are craving right now.

author: David Nicholls
text: Generally speaking, I resolve to change my life on average maybe thirty to forty times a week, usually at about two a.m, drunk, ore early the next morning, hungover.

author: B.C. Yaras
text: Sometimes or most of the time, we need to remind ourselves that we're not a KID anymore.

author: George R.R. Martin
text: It is said with truth that every building is constructed stone by stone, and the same may be said of knowledge, extracted and compiled by many learned men, each of whom builds upon the works of those who proceeded him.

author: Kate Jacobs
text: You'll have lots of questions to answer as you get older. Who you are. Who you want to be. What you think about things. Like politics. And romances. And whether you'll be able to speak out or keep your mouth shut. It's always a challenge to work out the best way to live your life, and as much as everyone tells you what to do, ultimately how you do things is up to you.

author: Stuart McLean
text: He considered the hard times in his life. All the things he had been afraid of. All those years wasted, he told himself, because I was terrified of being different. That's why all us fifty-four-year-olds end up looking so much alike. All of us are terrified of being different.

author: Richard Linklater
text: At some point, you're no longer growing up, you're aging. But no one can pinpoint that moment exactly.

author: Julie   Murphy
text: I don't really enjoy it, Mom.""And you've always felt this way?""I don't know. I guess I want a break.

author: Charlotte Eriksson
text: He left that morning, the last words still echoing in my head, and though he said he’d come back one day I know a broken promise from a right one for I have used them myself and there is no coming back. Minds like ours are can’t be tamed and the price for freedom is the price we pay.

author: S.A.R.K.
text: nobody tells us as little girls that we may fall in love and have moments of hating our beloved, or have ridiculous arguments at 2 AM over something that neither person understands.

author: L.M. Montgomery
text: She told herself that she longed greatly to go back to those dear merry days when life was seen through a rosy mist of hope and illusion, and possessed an indefinable something that had passed away forever. Where was it now--the glory and the dream?

author: Mary Ann Shaffer
text: Visitors offering their condolences, thinking to comfort me, said "Life goes on." What nonsense, I thought, of course it doesn't. It's death that goes on; Ian is dead now and will be dead tomorrow and next year and forever. There's no end to that. But perhaps there will be an end to the sorrow of it.

author: Jonathan Heatt
text: If a man can't learn from sorrow he can't learn from anything.

author: Kahlil Gibran
text: Life kisses our faces every morning. Yet, between morning and evening, she laughs at our sorrows.

author: Agha Kousar
text: I am being adult day by day but the first sorrow of my life is still fresh as warm ash.

author: Kjiva
text: Dealing with pain for surviving on this thirsty concrete

author: Saru Singhal
text: When sorrow knocks at your door, tell it you're busy finding happiness.

author: Jane Finn
text: Putting into words what exactly was off is not easy. I myself don’t even understand it. It was like a replica of my best friend was sitting in front of me, saying well-rehearsed lines at the wrong cues whilst I struggled to remember my dialogues. It was as if you had talked to me in some other language, a vernacular I used to be fluent in; but now, although the words sounded familiar, I really had no idea what you meant.

author: Raaz Ojha
text: It depends on you whether you want wrinkles or dimples on your face.

author: Alice Munro
text: Doing this was likewading and then throwing yourself into the lake for the first icy swim, in June. A sickening shock at first, then amazement thatyou were still moving, lifted up on a stream of steely devotion—calm above the surface of your life, surviving, though the pain ofthe cold continued to wash into your body.

author: Buddhadeva Bose
text: No time for happiness, no time for sorrow. Work is the best of physicians.

author: Srinivas Shenoy
text: I may no explain you much about myself but we both have one thing in common & its tears.

author: Marianne
text: First we are tested on our strengths, then we our strengths are tested

author: Darnell Lamont Walker
text: The saddest thing about death, whether it's our own or someone we care for, is when the world doesn't stop when we do.

author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
text: To laugh often and much,to win the respect of the intelligent peopleand the affection of children; to earn the appreciation of honest criticsand endure the betrayal of false friends;to appreciate beauty;to find the best in others; to leave the world.

author: Jack Gilbert
text: To hear the faint sound of oars in the silence as a rowboatcomes slowly out and then goes back is truly worthall the years of sorrow that are to come.

author: Herman Melville
text: That mortal man who hath more of joy than sorrow in him, that mortal man cannot be true — not true, or undeveloped. With books the same. The truest of all men was the Man of Sorrows, and the truest of all books is Solomon’s, and Ecclesiastes is the fine hammered steel of woe. “All is vanity.” ALL. This wilful world hath not got hold of unchristian Solomon’s wisdom yet.

author: ShinigamiGew
text: Happiness is an illusion

author: Zora Neale Hurston
text: Perhaps I am just a coward who loves to laugh at life better than I do cry with it. But when I do get to crying, boy, I can roll a mean tear.

author: W. Waldemar W. Argow
text: Wherefore is there ice and snow, chilling winds and bitter nights? Is it to mock the earth for its sunshine? No, not so! We forget that sunlight is impossible without shadows; that for every day there is a night; that for every joy there is a pain; that for every laugh there is a sob. Progress is never a straight line upward; always it is down and then around.

author: Turcois Ominek
text: Don't date anyone you can't see yourself marrying.

author: Sam Winters
text: To achieve something is better than not achieving.

author: M. J. Carter
text: The advantage of living is not measured by length, but by use; some men have lived long, and lived little. You've done well, and honourably.

author: Saim Cheeda
text: If you list down whatever you didn’t get to do, then whatever you did won’t feel like it mattered.

author: Ashok  Kallarakkal
text: Life should be like a good Tweet - short, pithy, convey a message and inspire others to follow.

author: Dr. Vivencio Ballano
text: What you think can determine what you can achieve! So think big to achieve great things!

author: Ashok Kallarakkal
text: Perfecting is a journey...There is no destination called perfection.

author: Milind K
text: Achievement is not important, attempt is...!

author: Denis Waitley
text: Failures do what is tension relieving while winners do what is goal achieving.

author: Mitch Album
text: Love each other or perish

author: Tadeusz Pankiewicz
text: Not everyone is capable of sacrificing his own life. So it is, always has been and always will be.

author: Thomas Merton The Seven Storey Mountain
text: How deluded we sometimes are by the clear notions we get out of books.

author: Lizelle DuPlessis
text: Sex is not love and love is not sex

author: J.A. ANUM
text: He walked out the door and with each step my heart breaks.He'd be gone for days with long silences between each breath.I know I'm his one of many and he knows he's my one of one. The only one who holds him down.Yet, he still leaves.He walks through the door and with each step my heart leaps.He crumbles to the ground in tears telling me he's sorry.He says he needs me and he's nothing without me.How can he be so attached and detached at the same time?I swear, this man loves to see me in pain.

author: J.A. ANUM
text: The first time I saw your face, my lips said, "hello" and my heart said, "that's your wife.

author: J.A. ANUM
text: I tasted danger on his lips and became an addict.A slave to adrenaline and irrational behaviour.We lived recklessly in a dramatic whirl;Clubbing and Cutting,Drinking and Driving,Fighting and Fucking,Smoking and Snorting,Overdoing and Overdosing. I tasted danger on his lips and lost my way.

author: J.A. ANUM
text: There's something about her.It's not her smile or grace,It's not her beauty or race,It's not her scent or warm embrace,Maybe it's her laugh or the shape of her face.No, that's not the case.It's just her.

author: Phar West Nagle
text: Following dark winter's strife, a warm air rises, teemed with life. Birth, rebirth, as the waiting die. Old love, new love sprouts wings to fly.

author: H W Leggett
text: The intention (of an artist) is (the same as a scientist)...to discover and reveal what is unsuspected but significant in life.

author: John Mark Green
text: You are the artist, and your days the canvas. Will you create an original masterpiece, or live a paint-by-numbers kind of life?

author: Leon Trotsky
text: The artist can not serve his struggle for freedom unless he subjectively assimilates the social content, unless he feels in his very nerves its meaning and drama and freely seeks to give his own inner world incarnation in his art.

author: Iain Pears
text: I learned that I' have to be detached if I was ever to achieve anything at all.

author: Amen Muffler
text: If an artist is not only he who sings or paints, but he who express himself by words or drawing then I can consider myself as one.

author: Henri Matisse
text: From the moment I held the box of colors in my hands, I knew this was my life. I threw myself into it like a beast that plunges towards the thing it loves.

author: Hiroko Sakai
text: I am living breathing freedom

author: Alice Neel
text: Whether I'm painting or not, I have this overweening interest in humanity. Even if I'm not working, I'm still analyzing people.

author: Hiroko Sakai
text: Wherever I wander off to, when I draw, when I paint, I get my life back. I am lucky that I am an Artist.

author: Hiroko Sakai
text: The privilege of struggling artists is ... the life being buried in what we can't really afford of* what a gorgeous life!!

author: Richard Linklater
text: I've always liked the minds of criminals, they seem similar to artists.

author: Ron Brackin
text: Capitalism—trade and industry controlled by people instead of a state—is a fine notion. Sadly, it has devolved into a culture in which tradesmen and industrialists lie, cheat, and sacrifice themselves and others for money to buy stuff that doesn’t work, doesn’t last, and doesn’t matter. And after they’re dead, their lives haven’t mattered. Even if they built a city, others will tear it down one day to build a park. Successful capitalists invest themselves in the lives of others.

author: Ludwig von Mises
text: The central element in the economic problem of money is the objective exchange-value of money, popularly called its purchasing power.

author: William Gaddis
text: All we’ve got left to protect here is a system that’s set up to promote the meanest possibilities in human nature and make them look good.

author: Robert Peate
text: They support freedom for themselves and slavery for everyone else, and they use the freedom of the market to disguise this fact. Economic coercion is just a different form of force, which they couple with the fraud of calling it freedom. I was like them, but I will never be like them again.

author: Alexis de Tocqueville
text: These diverse effects of slavery and freedom are easily understood: … the men in Kentucky [neither] have zeal nor enlightenment … cross over into Ohio in order to utilize their industry and to be able to exercise it without shame … in Kentucky, masters make slaves work without being obliged to pay them, but they receive little fruit from their efforts, while the money that they would give to free workers would be recovered with interest from the value of their labors.

author: Native American Saying
text: When the last tree has been cut down, the last fish caught, the last river poisoned, only then will we realize that one cannot eat money.

author: Robert Peate
text: Work or die’—this is the essence of slavery, of compulsion. And yet this is our world. Most of our world is enslaved but does not know it. Only the homeless are free, and for their freedom we sentence them to death. To refuse compulsion is to earn death, suffering, and calumny. It is not to refuse work—the homeless work very hard, endure many hardships we cannot imagine in our comfortable slavery. And yet we call our slavery freedom. We do not know what freedom means, yet.

author: Michelle Templet
text: The United States has never done away with slavery; we just stopped calling it such. These days, we call it free-market capitalism.

author: Leslie T. Chang
text: Workers were required to stay six months, and even then permission to quit was not always granted. The factory held the first two months of every worker's pay; leaving without approval meant losing that money and starting over somewhere else. That was a fact of factory life you couldn't know from the outside: Getting into a factory was easy. The hard part was getting out.

author: Terence McKenna
text: We tend to disempower ourselves. We tend to believe that we don’t matter. And in the act of taking that idea to ourselves we give everything away to somebody else, to something else.

author: Seal the Smile
text: Disability is not what we see or appear, it is all about not doing what one really wanted to do...

author: Renee D. Cefalu
text: Letting go of resentment or hurt allows you to take your power back. Forgiveness isn't about saying what happened to you is okay. It is about living your life in the present and letting go of the past.

author: Erin Fall Haskell
text: Be the woman who falls so deeply in love with herself that nothing can stop her from loving all of life!

author: Damond Jiniya
text: The Illusion of Truth Gives Us the Delusion of Power

author: Walter Dean Myers
text: ...when we feel powerless, we stop trying to find a better way.

author: Eleesha
text: Allow yourself to be freed from the constraints of what the mind knows, believes & thinks.

author: Sheila Renee Parker
text: Diversity is wisdom.

author: Nadège Richards
text: Never limit yourself to what you can't do, but to what you have the power to do with what you have.

author: Michele Knight
text: If only you knew who you really were you would be fearless and love yourself with a grand passion! You are a unique shard of God, the Universe, the whole or whatever label you would like to call it. No one can take your place and without you endless synchronicity and evolution would not happen. You are so powerful that just by walking down the street you can change someone's life forever.

author: PrasannaNPK
text: It isn't an idea until it’s created irrespective of its result

author: Victor Manan Nyambala
text: Not once not twice but at least a dozen times i have advanced an idea to people who thought i was either dreaming , imagining the impossible or just in over my head. When the birth of a rare idea lives to see the light of day it is astounding . I have some ideas am now advancing and i am watching closely the discomfort change presents. To achieve different results we have to change how we do things , we must slay lunacy

author: Tim Minchin
text: I don't go in for ancient wisdomI don't believe just 'cos ideas are tenacious it means they're worthy

author: Paul Pavlo Shiller
text: Ideas are universal, the names and titles we give them are not.

author: Sandra Chami Kassis
text: Just because it's something original, eccentric or you're not used to it; doesn't mean it's wrong.

author: Zohaib Naseer
text: You Believe what you see, You Perceive what you do.

author: Ingrid
text: An idea can destroy the mind of a human being, twist it into a dark path of destruction and illness. But only the human can destroy the mind with a bullet to the soul. Ideas do not kill people; they ruin them. People kill people.

author: Ronald Peret
text: Life is a precious gift, but we realize this only when we are in the end. Change it.

author: Aristotle
text: I count him braver who overcomes his desires than him who conquers his enemies, for the hardest victory is over self.

author: Albert Camus
text: If there were a party of those who aren't sure they're right, I'd belong t

author: Neel Burton
text: Man cannot bear to be in the wrong. As soon as he feels guilt or remorse, he bends his ethics to suit himself. Actions do not flow from ethics, but ethics from actions, and it is by refining our actions that we refine our ethics.

author: Leon R. Kass
text: In some crucial cases ... repugnance is the emotional expression of deep wisdom, beyond reason’s power completely to articulate it.

author: John F. Kennedy
text: Peace is a process - a way of solving problems.

author: S. Michael Wilcox
text: Of one thing I am certain: No single people, tradition, religion, governmental form, ethical program, moral code, or civilization has had sufficient wisdom and goodness to set the pattern and govern he world in the was of peace, decency and mutual respect. I do not believe God ever intended it to be that way. He wants us to reach out and learn from the wisdom he has given to humanity over broad sweeps of time and place and personality.

author: Carl Sagan
text: Could we possible manage the next phase of human history without first dealing with this penchant for dehumanizing the adversary?

author: Venugopal Gupta
text: We often confuse determination with its evil twin: fixation. While determination is our ability to stand our ground while pursuing our goals. Fixation, on the other hand, is an unhealthy attachment to an ideal.

author: Joe Prophet
text: Swag is my ethic, s/o to my bitches

author: John K.  Brown
text: Everything good is good because of the love it contains.

author: Aristotle
text: It is impossible, or not easy, to alter by argument what has long been absorbed by habit

author: K.L. Toth
text: If you witness evil men committing evil deeds and do nothing, what does that make you?

author: Tyler J. Hebert
text: The sun rises each morning to shed light on the things we may have overlooked the day before.

author: Molly Friedenfeld
text: Life is about enjoying the journey, not the end destination.

author: Kendal Rob
text: Nobel intentions have no real meaning to them if you don't do it solely for you. Do it to satisfy your soul, not theirs. Don't do it in hope that it earns you a reward at the end, instead let the reward be the beauty created as a result of your actions.

author: Erin Fall Haskell
text: Love has no contingencies, no expectations, no ideals. Love is a gift to thyself, the experience of divinity in full expression.

author: Joe Campos
text: You can seek out good fortune, authority (power), and even a righteous life-partner...and find them all. But when all of this is gone...which it will be eventually, I wish you Peace, which is only found through Christ our Lord.

author: Elder Porphyrios
text: ...Love Christ and put nothing before His Love. He is joy, He is life, He is light. Christ is Everything. He is the ultimate desire, He is everything. Everything beautiful is in Christ.

author: Elder Porphyrios
text: ...This is the way we should see Christ. He is our friend, our brother; He is whatever is good and beautiful. He is everything. Yet, He is still a friend and He shouts it out, "You're my friends, don't you understand that? We're brothers. I'm not...I don't hold hell in my hands. I am not threatening you. I love you. I want you to enjoy life together with me.

author: Jibankrishna
text: After attainment of Supreme knowledge a man lives but he does not lead an ordinary man’s life. He lives, he eats, he sleeps and by God’s commandment he becomes a ‘man-catcher’ as Christ told Peter.

author: Markus W. Lunner
text: The phrase "I dont know" is the most honest thing anyone could ever say.

author: Karl Marx
text: The philosophers have only interpreted the world, in various ways; the point is to change it.

author: Nikki Giovanni
text: His headstone saidFREE AT LAST, FREE AT LASTBut death is a slave's freedomWe seek the freedom of free menAnd the construction of a world Where Martin Luther King could have lived and preached non-violence

author: Victor Hugo
text: At the side of Enjolras, who represented the logic of revolution, was Combeferre, representing its philosophy. The difference between logic and philosophy is that one can decide upon war, whereas the other can only be fulfilled by peace.

author: Michelle Cliff
text: Freedom without the means to be self-supporting is a one-armed triumph.

author: عبير المعداوي
text: I wonder Why we make huge revolutions and then the result is zero of hopes,freedom or even to find the food !

author: Frank Watson Dyson
text: The effect of a concept-driven revolution is to explain old things in new ways. The effect of a tool-driven revolution is to discover new things that have to be explained.

author: Baruch Spinoza
text: I do not know how to teach philosophy without becoming a disturber of established religion.

author: Rachel Higginson
text: We will remember the way things used to be, and teach our children to be better than us. The generations that follow will remember with us. In that day, we will all be free

author: Lailah  Gifty  Akita
text: If you find wisdom, you will discover the light of bright path.

author: Alex Gaskarth
text: There is no correct path. We pave our own roads. Don't be afraid to find your own way. ...I hate to see people hung up on "what they're supposed to do". Decide for yourself. There is no other way

author: Saahil Prem
text: Whenever new shorts cuts open the old roads get freer

author: Lucas Scott
text: If you could go back and change just one thing about your life, would you? and if you did, would that change make your life better? Or would that change ultimately break your heart? or break the heart of another? would you choose an entirely different path? or would you change just one thing? just one moment. one moment that you always wanted back.

author: Unknown.
text: I love books because I don't have to wait for the commercials to be over to find out what happens.

author: Morgan Chabane
text: Surely you may happen to get loston the way, but naturally that issimply how you find your self.

author: Pedro Okoro
text: Knowledge comes by revelation through the study of the Scriptures

author: J. Jefferson Farson
text: The death of a dog may not by some be regarded as a tragedy, but some dogs are more worthy than some men, and can be more justly mourned.

author: Gregory Lovvorn
text: Humans are the most inhumane of all creatures.

author: Helen Freeman
text: If you are a kind person and love animals, you may be lucky enough to find the Magic Valley. There you will discover a land where snow leopards play and mountains smile. I should tell you, though, that it will be a very hard journey. But I should also tell you that it is well worth the effort.

author: Carrie Latet
text: Our behavior is human with a sliver of animal, our souls animal with a sliver of human.

author: Linda Bender
text: To be sure, there are human abilities that other animals lack, but the more we learn about animals, the more abilities we discover that humans lack. Obviously, if animals were included in the Olympics, humans wouldn’t take home any gold medals. We can’t run as fast as a cheetah, swim as well as a fish, or lift as much weight as an elephant.

author: Ammiel Josiah Monterde.
text: Dogs are the best example of a being who doesn't need to lie to protect someone's pride.

author: Rebecca Ashe
text: The creatures I have sent to their God are not men. They abdicated the right to the name by committing acts of inhuman savagery so that they cannot even count themselves among God's beasts. For even the beasts have better reason for what they do- and so have I. If those be men, I rank myself gladly with the animals. There are places in this world where the force of law holds sway; it is a great pity that Larissa is not one of them.

author: Marcello Malpighi
text: For Nature is accustomed to rehearse with certain large, perhaps baser, and all classes of wild (animals), and to place in the imperfect the rudiments of the perfect animals.

author: Charles Manson
text: Animals shouldn’t be hunted and nature shouldn’t be disturbed, even destroyed, to benefit the whims of mankind

author: Elizabeth Eiler
text: There are mystical, unbreakable bonds between all members of the natural world including humans and animals. Whether or not we remember or acknowledge this relatedness, it still exists.

author: Douglas Tallamy
text: One of the maxims of the new field of conservation biological control is that to control insect herbivores, you must maintain populations of insect herbivores.

author: GE Paulus
text: All humans have five things in common. They want good health, they want economic opportunities ( to work), they want to love and be loved, (family and friendships) they want hope in their life, hope that tomorrow will be better than today, and they want to be part of something greater than themselves.

author: Taylor Swift
text: I don’t compare myself to anyone else; I don’t make comments about anyone else because they do what feels right for them, and that’s okay by me.

author: Mouloud Benzadi
text: Humans without humanity, A world of dread and fear for eternity.

author: FM-2030
text: I am a 21st century person who was accidentally launched in the 20th. I have a deep nostalgia for the future

author: Patricia Reilly Giff
text: If someone looks into your eyes, I read in a book one time, he'll see right into your soul. I didn't want anyone to see into my soul.

author: Hideki Yukawa
text: Nature creates curved lines while humans create straight lines.

author: Aniruddha Sastikar
text: Tea carries within itself; knowledge, wisdom, and wellness; for the sake of giving.

author: Nagaru Tanigawa
text: On the surface, humans appear to hate conflict, but in reality, they seek it.

author: Saleem Sharma
text: You sip the water from the same ocean in which all the hope was lost. Us

author: Evy Michaels
text: My life has become like a bus, and I'm just watching it pass by

author: Ursula K. Le Guin
text: What you love, you will love. What you undertake you will complete. You are a fulfiller of hope; you are to be relied on. But seventeen years give little armor against despair…Consider, Arren. To refuse death is to refuse life.

author: Eric Garcia
text: There’s no hope for someone who doesn’t even know what hope is

author: Rachel Joyce
text: The sky and the sun are always there. It's the clouds that come and go.

author: Albert Einstein
text: We cannot despair of humanity, since we ourselves are human beings.

author: Mrs. Charles E. Cowman
text: Yes, one whose faith is continually stimulated by the upward look gives no ground to the attempted encroachment of despair. No matter how great the trouble or how dark the outlook, a quick lifting of the heart to God in a moment of real actual faith in him will completely alter any situation and turn the darkness of midnight into glorious sunrise.

author: Mandeep Singh Randhawa
text: No loss is big enough to lose hope for tommorrow.

author: Leila Aboulela
text: I wanted to be good but I wasn't sure if I was prepared

author: Anonymus Autor
text: He gasped in despair while he wrote to her knowing everything is going to end.He: Why did you ruin my image in front of your mother and family though I wasn't the bad guy?She replied Coldly: I acted childish and took revenge, I wanted to end this relation.He kept asking all that she accused him of.She kept admitting false allegations, something kept breaking inside him.Silence kept creeping into him, sorrow enveloped his soul and tears fell of his eyes for he knew all had ended.

author: LeeAnn Taylor
text: Our measure of hope is in direct proportion to our ability to conquer hopelessness.

author: Elie Wiesel
text: We have to go into the despair and go beyond it, by working and doing for somebody else, by using it for something else.

author: Phyllis McGinley
text: A mother's hardest to forgive.Life is the fruit she longs to hand youRipe on a plate. And while you live,Relentlessly she understands you.

author: Khalid Masood
text: Time is the mother of truth.

author: Imran Khan
text: Mothers train your children to only Speak Truth

author: Arlin Sailesh Kapadia
text: Mother nature pushes you back the faster you go, same way people will full you back, the faster you succeed.

author: Nic Sheff
text: It was like being in a car with the gas pedal slammed down to the floor and nothing to do but hold on and pretend to have some semblance of control. But control was something I'd lost a long time ago.

author: Mike Dolce
text: If you can control what you eat, you can control all other aspects in you life.

author: Sara Secora
text: Relinquish your ideology of control, for it is merely a mirage anyway.

author: Bethany Morrell
text: Life is many things, but if you don't try to control it, it will take hold of you and ruin you.

author: Viktor E. Frankl
text: We have absolutely no control over what happens to us in life but what we have paramount control over is how we respond to those events.

author: David W. Earle
text: To be free to roam our own consciousness and be responsible for ourselves, a letting go process is required. We have to let go of how others define us; what damaging messages remain from childhood; how others define our relationship with the creator; and what expectations they may have for us.

author: Eveth N Colley
text: So there are many things outside of your control. Why not create positive control over the other things and add greater value to those?

author: Suraj Rajput
text: In dreams begins responsibility in life

author: Alfusainey jallow
text: I will always be confident in the direction of my dreams because that's the life I wish to live.

author: Rashmit Kalra
text: Equality is humanity.

author: Nurudeen Ushawu
text: All my intention, is to treat everyone right.

author: Christian Ekström
text: A person who has the power to take a life, should have the intelligence to choose not to.

author: Anthony   Pan
text: The fundamental Law of The Universe states that all human beings are fundamentally the same and therefore have an equal right to live in equality.

author: Frederick Douglass
text: Right is of no sex, Truth is of no color, God is the Father of us all, and we are all Brethren

author: David Wishengrad
text: Life is Most Important in Life is The Most important Truth in Life. Any word, thought, or action that disagrees must be a lie.

author: Topsy Gift
text: Life is a school, be opened to learn from it, but sometimes it might teach you through the hard way

author: Lavon Curtis
text: For almost 18 years you’re taught to sit down, shut up, and raise your hand. Then you have to decide what you’re going to do for the rest of your life.

author: Osunsakin Adewale
text: A school bell that sounds annoying at 8:00am sounds exciting at 4:00pm ....it is a matter of time , you will get there.

author: Bruce Springsteen
text: One problem with the way the educational system is set up is that it only recognizes a certain type of intelligence, and it’s incredibly restrictive - very, very restrictive. There’s so many types of intelligence, and people who would be at their best outside of that structure get lost.

author: Neel Burton
text: I can't believe I spent 13 years at school and never got taught cooking, gardening, conversation, massage, Latin, or philosophy. What were they thinking? That I would somehow live off inorganic chemistry?

author: Vijay Dhameliya
text: I was born scientist but my school turned me into just student

author: John le Carré
text: You should have died when I killed you.

author: Jennifer duBois
text: It was bewildering, the way that reality could be overtaken, wrestled down, and murdered by the sheer weight of possibility.

author: Darnell Lamont Walker
text: Tell me what you’re looking for and i will become that for you. I can sacrifice my inner freedoms for you without looking twice at my old journals and solid promises I made to myself about such things. But you must be prepared to kill me when the smiles are no longer frequent. Do it while I sleep. While I hold your hand. Do it fast, baby. Do it fast.

author: Jonathan Heatt
text: Be the person you are, not the one others try to create.

author: Solitude's Friend
text: Be what you are, but be careful in what you're doing.

author: A.E. van Vogt
text: If I believe the same things today I did yesterday I've learned nothing.

author: Harold Bloom
text: We read deeply for varied reasons, most of them familiar: that we cannot know enough people profoundly enough; that we need to know ourselves better; that we require knowledge, not just of self and others, but of the way things are.

author: Shivanee Harshey
text: It’s important to know that you're behind, to be able to convince yourself to make sacrifices that get you ahead.

author: Mary Ann Brantley
text: Christian Fiction is like a parable. The story is made up, but the truth is brought to life. Enjoy the story, but savor the truth.

author: Elizabeth George
text: If you want to grow spiritually, the place to start is with God.

author: Elizabeth George
text: God’s Word transforms you into someone who reflects His glory.

author: Jim Wallis
text: Two of the greatest hungers in our world today are the hunger for spirituality and the hunger for social change. The connection between the two is the one the world is waiting for, especially the new generation. And the first hunger will empower the second.

author: Thomas Osbert Mordaunt
text: One crowded hour of glorious life is worth an age without a name.

author: Nicole Kidman
text: Even from a very early age, I knew I didn't want to miss out on anything life had to offer just because it might be considered dangerous.

author: Kira Jeffries
text: Life is all but a dream we will soon wake up to and be 7 years old again

author: Björk
text: I am half child, half ancient.

author: Nagendra Kumar Y
text: Adventures are important things in our life, to forget about our aging.

author: Ashay Abbhi
text: I went closer this time and touched him. He let out a deafening shriek, as if something had pierced into his heart. I held his hand and sat there, admiring the intricate network of life on them. The creases and folds in his body were testament to the cruelty that he had been subjected to in this world. The watery eyes screamed of the pain, the agonising wait to leave this godforsaken place forever, that had given him nothing but pleadings for mercy.

author: James Pedigo
text: Age does not mean wisdom, Do not follow the old man off the cliff.

author: Sandra Cisneros
text: What they don't understand about birthdays and what they never tell you is that when you're eleven, you're also ten, and nine, and eight, and seven, and six, and five, and four, and three, and two, and one.

author: Tammy-Louise Wilkins
text: As age changes with each moment, we become that little bit more of a distant memory to the person we are currently.

author: James A. Murphy
text: The older I get the more I realize how simple life is and how complicated we make it...

author: Vimal Athithan
text: Age brings maturity, experience ripens it.

author: Anne Gracie
text: Prettiness fades after a few years, but elegance only increases with age.

author: George Foreman
text: I hope to have one more boxing match at the age of 55. Given that demographic at the age of 55 to 65, you've got to make a statement with your life. Otherwise, you are just existing.

author: Candice Favilla
text: The soul is not a bird, is not a tree, but a restraining wire of light wrapped around the other we most desire. We can't even give them away, these souls, their encumbrances not ours alone.

author: T.Taylor
text: My sexuality hasn't offended you. Me being me without your permission did.

author: Patrick Rothfuss
text: I was in my early twenties and I was, to be quite honest, a bit of a punk. A swaggering entitled straight white guy who hadn't but a lot of thought into what it might be like to be anything other than a straight white guy. Because when you're a straight white guy, you don't *have* to think about that....

author: TheKatAttack

Mostly, philosophically challenged and scant respect for natural way of life is making us irrelevant.

Life is long enough, and it has been given in sufficiently generous measure to allow the accomplishment of the very greatest things if the whole of it is well invested. But when it is squandered in luxury and carelessness, when it is devoted to no good end, forced at last by the ultimate necessity we perceive that it has passed away before we were aware that it was passing.

That which came together can easily dissolve if conditions become unfavorable. That which has dissolved may come together again if circumstances are appropriate. Therefore, who is to say that there is a beginning and an end?

Nature in its raw, unpredictable state – at an entirely different end of the spectrum from the confines of a test tube or comfort of a biotech lab.
