text: Each of us has about 40 chances to accomplish our goals in life. I learned this first through agriculture, because all farmers can expect to have about 40 growing seasons, giving them just 40 chances to improve on every harvest.

author: Michelle Obama
text: I want a president with a record of public service, someone whose life's work shows our children that we don't chase fame and fortune for ourselves: we fight to give everyone a chance to succeed.

author: Bear Grylls
text: You only get one chance at life and you have to grab it boldly.

author: Steve Jobs
text: We don't get a chance to do that many things, and every one should be really excellent. Because this is our life. Life is brief, and then you die, you know? So this is what we've chosen to do with our life.

author: Tom Hodgkinson
text: Being lazy does not mean that you do not create. In fact, lying around doing nothing is an important, nay crucial, part of the creative process. It is meaningless bustle that actually gets in the way of productivity. All we are really saying is, give peace a chance.

author: Michael Chabon
text: Louis Pasteur said, 'Chance favors the prepared mind.' If you're really engaged in the writing, you'll work yourself out of whatever jam you find yourself in.

author: Henry Wadsworth Longfellow
text: There are moments in life, when the heart is so full of emotion That if by chance it be shaken, or into its depths like a pebble Drops some careless word, it overflows, and its secret, Spilt on the ground like water, can never be gathered together.

author: Yitzhak Rabin
text: Give peace a chance.

author: Joel Burns
text: Give yourself a chance to see how much better life will get. And it will get better.

author: Ai Weiwei
text: I call on people to be 'obsessed citizens,' forever questioning and asking for accountability. That's the only chance we have today of a healthy and happy life.

author: Robert Collier
text: Your chances of success in any undertaking can always be measured by your belief in yourself.

author: Robert Redford
text: I have the freedom to take chances, to say no. I have the freedom to be who I really want to be, rather than have to conform to this or that just to stay alive.

author: Walter Scott
text: One hour of life, crowded to the full with glorious action, and filled with noble risks, is worth whole years of those mean observances of paltry decorum, in which men steal through existence, like sluggish waters through a marsh, without either honor or observation.

author: Kevin Costner
text: I haven't lived a perfect life. I have regrets. But that's from a lifetime of taking chances, making decisions, and trying not to be frozen. The only thing that I can do with my regrets is understand them.

author: Corazon Aquino
text: I just do whatever it is that I believe I should do, regardless of the risks to my life.

author: Daniel Day-Lewis
text: At some point in your life, if you're lucky, you get to design the way in which things evolve.

author: Gene Robinson
text: Sometimes there are things worth risking your life for. It was Jesus who said if you want to save your life, you have to lose it.

author: Andrew Gross
text: 'Eyes Wide Open' took shape from two real life events straight from my own past. One was the sad suicide of my young nephew, a troubled kid, who was found at the bottom of a landmark cliff in central California. The second was a chance encounter forty years ago with none other than, ahem, Charles Manson!

author: T. E. Hulme
text: Here is the root of all romanticism: that man, the individual, is an infinite reservoir of possibilities, and if you can so rearrange society by the destruction of oppressive order, then these possibilities will have a chance, and you will get Progress.

author: Mignon McLaughlin
text: For the happiest life, days should be rigorously planned, nights left open to chance.

author: Lucius Annaeus Seneca
text: No man was ever wise by chance.

author: Ansel Adams
text: In my mind's eye, I visualize how a particular... sight and feeling will appear on a print. If it excites me, there is a good chance it will make a good photograph. It is an intuitive sense, an ability that comes from a lot of practice.

author: Condoleezza Rice
text: Success is not assured, but America is resolute: this is the best chance for peace we are likely to see for some years to come - and we are acting to help Israelis and Palestinians seize this chance.

author: Don Rickles
text: To me, the stand up part in my life is great. I know I can do that. When I get an acting chance, I'm really thrilled.

author: Thich Nhat Hanh
text: When we have peace, then we have a chance to save the planet. But if we are not united in peace, if we do not practice mindful consumption, we cannot save our planet.

author: Andrea Bocelli
text: My life experience has taught me nothing happens by chance. Even the idea of the ball in a roulette game: it's not chance it ends up in a certain place. It's forces that are at play.

author: Mary Quant
text: Risk it; go for it. Life always gives you another chance, another go at it. It's very important to take enormous risks.

author: Mark Ruffalo
text: I'd never taken a job purely for money - I felt that would kill me - but I was afraid that I was heading that way. Then, my brother passing away was the final thing that kicked me over. It reminded me that life is short, and you'd better do what you want while you have a chance.

author: Amy Purdy
text: I got this second chance at life, and I live it.

author: Alexis de Tocqueville
text: The whole life of an American is passed like a game of chance, a revolutionary crisis, or a battle.

author: Benjamin Disraeli
text: A consistent soul believes in destiny, a capricious one in chance.

author: Julian Castro
text: My grandmother spent her whole life working as a maid, a cook and a babysitter, barely scraping by, but still working hard to give my mother, her only child, a chance in life, so that my mother could give my brother and me an even better one.

author: Mikhail Baryshnikov
text: Dances have a second and third life. You feel they are never ready. They always have a chance for another life.

author: Lesli Linka Glatter
text: We've heard the excuses from those responsible for hiring that they don't want to take a chance on a new director. But the truth is that the industry hires new directors all the time it's just that most of them are white males.

author: Katarina Johnson-Thompson
text: I actually hated dancing. My mum used to have to bribe me to go by buying me things. A year before I stopped going, I was going to go for an audition with the Royal Ballet. It turned out I was a year too young. Because I was tall, they thought I was older. But before I had the chance to go back, I quit.

author: Billy Crystal
text: When you're the host of the Academy Awards, and you grew up watching Bob Hope and Johnny Carson, and now it's your turn, and you get a chance to run with the baton on the relay for a while, I really embraced it and just really loved being there.

author: Dwyane Wade
text: At 9 years old, I moved in with my father because my mother could no longer care for me. Looking back, I now see so many similarities between my own childhood and that of my sons. My father stepped in when I needed him, and that gave me the chance for a better life. That's what I'm doing for my boys now.

author: Tiger Woods
text: If you are given a chance to be a role model, I think you should always take it because you can influence a person's life in a positive light, and that's what I want to do. That's what it's all about.

author: Richard Burton
text: If I had a chance for another life, I would certainly choose a better complexion.

author: Ayaan Hirsi Ali
text: They decided to let immigrants in and I am an immigrant. They gave us a chance to participate in this country's life and I took it.

author: J. R. Martinez
text: I'm going to write a book, continue acting, continue motivational speaking and just share with people who I am and what I've learned in my second chance of life and pass it on to people in their first chance of life.

author: Michelle Obama
text: I want a president with a record of public service: someone whose life's work shows our children that we don't chase form and fortune for ourselves we fight to give everyone a chance to succeed.

author: Michael Jordan
text: In college I never realized the opportunities available to a pro athlete. I've been given the chance to meet all kinds of people, to travel and expand my financial capabilities, to get ideas and learn about life, to create a world apart from basketball.

author: Xenophanes
text: No human being will ever know the Truth, for even if they happen to say it by chance, they would not even known they had done so.

author: Marjane Satrapi
text: If people are given the chance to experience life in more than one country, they will hate a little less. It's not a miracle potion, but little by little you can solve problems in the basement of a country, not on the surface.

author: Louis Tomlinson
text: You can lay in bed and think you don't stand a chance, that's what all of us thought, and here we are. We ended up doing all right.

author: Cynthia Ozick
text: In books, as in life, there are no second chances. On second thought: it's the next work, still to be written, that offers the second chance.

author: John Burnside
text: This is a truth that should be repeated like a mantra: to have any chance of a ful - filling life, we require not only clean air and a steady climate, but also an abundance of meadows and woodlands, rivers and oceans, teeming with life and the mass existence of other living creatures.

author: Future
text: You got to make the most of your second life. I was born Nayvadius, but now I'm Future. Should I dwell on what Nayvadius was supposed to be? I get a chance to experience life as something else. I wasn't supposed to be like this.

author: Jacques Derrida
text: The circle of the return to birth can only remain open, but this is a chance, a sign of life, and a wound.

author: Tracy Chapman
text: If you are living a life that feels right to you, if you're willing to take creative chances or a creative path that feels like it's mostly in keeping with your sensibilities, you know, aesthetic and artistic, then that's what matters.

author: Denis Leary
text: My biggest regret in life is that I didn't hit John Denver in the mouth while I has the chance.

author: Luis Bunuel
text: Fortunately, somewhere between chance and mystery lies imagination, the only thing that protects our freedom, despite the fact that people keep trying to reduce it or kill it off altogether.

author: Pauline Hanson
text: Governments must give to all those who have hit life's hurdles the chance to rebuild and have a future.

author: Henry Kravis
text: So I picked a field where I had a little exposure. Where I thought I could have an enormous challenge, and have a chance to really do some good, to be a pioneer in an area, and not just be like everyone else.

author: Friedrich Nietzsche
text: There are people who want to make men's lives more difficult for no other reason than the chance it provides them afterwards to offer their prescription for alleviating life; their Christianity, for instance.

author: Maya Rudolph
text: I never thought I'd get a chance to do what I'm doing. It's such a dream.

author: John Perez
text: When my father passed away, he had his organs donated. In that painful moment, I was deeply comforted knowing that my father would be able to give others a second chance at life. That is why I encourage everyone to sign up to be a donor.

author: Patrick Rothfuss
text: You've got a great chance in college to do all sorts of terrible irresponsible things, and you should totally do them. I mean, make huge mistakes. This is the time in your life if you screw up, it's okay because you can bounce back from it.

author: Dax Shepard
text: You only get one chance at your life so why not jump cars?

author: V. S. Naipaul
text: What I felt was, if you spend your life just writing fiction, you are going to falsify your material. And the fictional form was going to force you to do things with the material, to dramatize it in a certain way. I thought nonfiction gave one a chance to explore the world, the other world, the world that one didn't know fully.

author: Charles M. Schwab
text: Money is often a matter of chance or good fortune and is not the mark of a successful life. It is not the thing that brings a throb of pleasure or a thrill into my life. And I would not pose as a successful man if that were to be the measure.

author: Robert J. Fisher
text: In many museums, you see one of this and one of that. You gain an understanding of what Abstract Expressionism or Minimalism is, but you aren't given the chance to appreciate the mind of an artist.

author: Bill Goldberg
text: If I wasn't prepared knowing every year there is a huge chance of a fire that will require me to evacuate my property, then I'm an ignoramus. If people at this point don't see that terrorism is a reality, and don't take steps to prepare themselves a little more than they were the day before, then they are also an irresponsible ignoramus.

author: Neil Gorsuch
text: When Justice White retired, he gave me the chance to work for Justice Kennedy, as well. Justice Kennedy was incredibly welcoming and gracious, and like Justice White, he taught me so much. I am forever grateful. And if you've ever met Judge David Sentelle, you'll know just how lucky I was to land a clerkship with him right out of school.

author: Nick Saban
text: The thing I like about college football so much is you can affect these guys a lot more when they are 18-22, 23 years old in terms of people and having a chance to be more successful. They are still a value type development, where you have a chance to help them mature a bit and help them be a little more successful in life.

author: Lewis Howes
text: Entrepreneurs spend an inordinate amount of time inside of our own heads - thinking, analyzing, agonizing and obsessing over every little detail of our business. Sometimes, we need a break from ourselves. Meditation is a chance to let the thinking mind rest.

author: Gladys Knight
text: We all have a responsibility, and since I've been so wonderfully blessed, I really want to share and to make life at least a little better. So every chance I get to share the gospel or uplift people, I will take full advantage of that opportunity.

author: Neale Donald Walsch
text: A life lived of choice is a life of conscious action. A life lived of chance is a life of unconscious creation.

author: Warren Bennis
text: I've become more and more aware of the promise and struggle to teach the global mind nowadays because I use every chance I get to ask faculty and administrators of management education programs why we don't offer at least one course - not even required, just an elective - on the world's religions.

author: Alice Walker
text: As long as the people don't fear the truth, there is hope. For once they fear it, the one who tells it doesn't stand a chance. And today, truth is still beautiful... but so frightening.

author: Kenneth Branagh
text: Variety is very, very good. Going from medium to medium, if you get the chance to do it, from theater to television to film, which are all distinctly different, keeps me sharp. What works in one doesn't work in the other, and you have to be looking for the truth of the performance, whatever way that medium might demand.

author: Barack Obama
text: You can choose a future where more Americans have the chance to gain the skills they need to compete, no matter how old they are or how much money they have. Education was the gateway to opportunity for me. It was the gateway for Michelle. And now more than ever, it is the gateway to a middle-class life.

author: Francois de La Rochefoucauld
text: Though men are apt to flatter and exalt themselves with their great achievements, yet these are, in truth, very often owing not so much to design as chance.

author: Chuck Palahniuk
text: If you knew that your life was merely a phase or short, short segment of your entire existence, how would you live? Knowing nothing 'real' was at risk, what would you do? You'd live a gigantic, bold, fun, dazzling life. You know you would. That's what the ghosts want us to do - all the exciting things they no longer can.

author: Katy Perry
text: I have a second chance on life.

author: Cate Blanchett
text: If I had my way, if I was lucky enough, if I could be on the brink my entire life - that great sense of expectation and excitement without the disappointment - that would be the perfect state.

author: Ezra Taft Benson
text: A woman whose life is involved in the righteous rearing of her children has a better chance of keeping up her spirits than the woman whose total concern is centered in her own personal problems.

author: Peter Diamandis
text: When I was a grad student at MIT, I had a chance to become friends with the Viking Mission's chief scientist, Dr. Gerald Soffen. Viking was the first Mars lander looking for signs of life on Mars.

author: Nicolas Cage
text: I think it's no secret that I've tried to take chances in my career and also in my life, and I believe to not live in fear.

author: Brad Paisley
text: If you're somebody that gets a chance to go somewhere... that has to work somewhere or go to another city, then do your best to see it. Because I just think that's the best way to have an interesting life.

author: Vivienne Westwood
text: Everybody should have a fair deal; everybody should have the chance to life in this world. If we were evolved as human beings, we would hopefully be able to alleviate suffering in the world.

author: Dick Van Dyke
text: I don't think we've got much of a chance to tell you the truth. But our main problem is our audience skews a little older than most shows, and I don't think our people can stay up that late. I certainly can't.

author: Christina Aguilera
text: I want to be a poet and have a chance to explore that and let people know what's really on my mind.

author: Arthur Schopenhauer
text: Suffering by nature or chance never seems so painful as suffering inflicted on us by the arbitrary will of another.

author: Mark Cuban
text: I liked Trump's honesty because it was different and had a chance to change the business of politics. What I didn't realize he was missing at the time was a complete and utter lack of preparation, knowledge, and common sense.

author: Evangeline Lilly
text: I definitely come down on the spiritual side. I think very few things in life happen by chance.

author: Joyce Carol Oates
text: The worst cynicism: a belief in luck.

author: Jeb Bush
text: I had the chance to be governor for eight years and I took a year to transition out and a year to transition in, so that's a decade of my life where I pursued my own ambitions and I thought it was time to rearrange my life to focus on other things.

author: Mahershala Ali
text: At graduate school in 1999, I finally had the chance to examine why I believe what I believe. I realised that I'd had no period in my life where I'd consciously tried to develop my own theology.

author: Ang Lee
text: I hope people don't compare 2D and 3D because 3D's new, it's unfair to compare to 2D which is really sophisticated, even when we're jaded about it. 3D just began, give it a chance, let the equipment and projection system catch up and be better, let the price go down, let more filmmakers get a hold of it more easily.

author: Mike Pompeo
text: I'd start a business again in a heartbeat. Indeed, I hope that one day I may get the chance to do so when my mission here in Washington, D.C. is complete.

author: Gisele Bundchen
text: I believe in taking chances and living your life. Sometimes doors open and others close and you have to figure out which one you're going to take. I'm always for the one that's challenging.

author: Lindsey Vonn
text: I take risks - that's my life on the slopes and off.

author: Khaled Hosseini
text: In my 20s, life seemed endless. At 49, I've had a chance to see how dark life can be, and I am far more aware of the constraints of time than when I wrote 'The Kite Runner.' I realise there is only a limited number of things I can do.

author: Nancy Pelosi
text: When I first ran for Congress, I went to my daughter Alexandra, who was going to be a senior in high school, and said: 'I have a chance to run. I may not win, but I'd be gone three nights a week. So, if you want me to stay, I'll be happy to.' And do you know what she said to me? 'Mother, get a life!'

author: James Arthur
text: I wasn't a happy kid. I felt like my mum ruined our chance of a better life, because when she remarried, we went to live in Bahrain, on a compound with a swimming pool, and she ruined it all.

author: Stipe Miocic
text: I understand it's promotion, but no one ever gave me a chance. No one ever thought I'd be the champ, and look where I'm at now.

author: Nia Vardalos
text: Our daughter was not damaged or hurt in any way. She was simply relinquished to foster care by two people who were not ready to be parents. I admire them for giving her the chance for a better life. And I am grateful they gave my husband and me the opportunity to be parents.

author: Kawhi Leonard
text: It's an honor to have been considered for the team, and I hope that in the future I will have the chance to represent my country by playing for U.S.A. Basketball.

author: Rick Riordan
text: I think children love reading, and they will make time for it if we put the right books into their hands. And I hope I get the chance to keep being one of the people that writes them.

author: Havelock Ellis
text: However well organized the foundations of life may be, life must always be full of risks.

author: Kyle MacLachlan
text: The fact 'Twin Peaks' had a life at all took most of us in the cast by surprise. We thought it would be too unusual for network television. The original intention was that it would be a two-hour movie. If the network didn't want to pick it up as a series, it could just show that. But ABC took a chance.

author: Tom Hiddleston
text: I thought theater people wouldn't see me if I hadn't trained. I didn't want to just be the Brideshead guy, to spend the rest of my life wearing waistcoats. I got the chance to try everything. Not just Romeos, but pimps and grandfathers and even one role as a woman in a Naomi Wallace play called Slaughter City.

author: Sophia Loren
text: No press conference announcing a last film. I'd just steal away. Best way because, if by chance after two or three years something interesting comes up, I would not - like Sinatra - have to say: 'Well, I've thought it over and decided to come back.'

author: Preity Zinta
text: Luck always favours the brave. And you must remember that brave are the people who follow their heart brave are the people who take chances in life. Which also means you have to say no sometimes. I believe the power of no is greater than yes.

author: Andrew Bird
text: You travel with the hope that something unexpected will happen. It has to do with enjoying being lost and figuring it out and the satisfaction. I always get a little disappointed when I know too well where I'm going, or when I've lived in a place so long that there's no chance I could possibly get lost.

author: Christopher Morley
text: From now until the end of time no one else will ever see life with my eyes, and I mean to make the best of my chance.

author: Ivana Trump
text: When I was doing poorly at school, my father yanked me out and got me a job in a shoe factory. After three weeks, I begged him to give me another chance at doing well in school. I learned that discipline is necessary to accomplish anything in life.

author: Kevin James
text: Teachers have a chance to mold someone, inspire them. I hope all teachers realize that.

author: Cat Cora
text: Even when you have doubts, take that step. Take chances. Mistakes are never a failure - they can be turned into wisdom.

author: Odette Annable
text: I think everyone should live in New York City if they ever get the chance at least once in their life. It's such a great place to live there's a different energy about living in the city.

author: Hugh Mackay
text: Perhaps it's the people whose lives have taken sudden new twists - people who have learned to embrace the creative possibilities of change - who stand the best chance of penetrating life's mysteries.

author: Picabo Street
text: I want kids to have a chance to dream of becoming something like I did in my life, and when you're living in a home that's dysfunctional and unhealthy that way, you don't dream like that.

author: Merce Cunningham
text: In using chance operations, the mind is enriched.

author: Krzysztof Kieslowski
text: I like chance meetings - life is full of them. Every day, without realising it, I pass people whom I should know.

author: Chad Michael Murray
text: I want to get to a point in my career where I can be a role model. A good one. I want to say, 'I got here without drugs, and I got here without drinking or smoking. If I can do it, you can do it. I have no doubt.' I really want kids to have a chance in life.

author: Maurice Maeterlinck
text: Many a happiness in life, as many a disaster, can be due to chance, but the peace within us can never be governed by chance.

author: W. G. Sebald
text: The moral backbone of literature is about that whole question of memory. To my mind it seems clear that those who have no memory have the much greater chance to lead happy lives.

author: W. G. Sebald
text: To my mind, it seems clear that those who have no memory have the much greater chance to lead happy lives. But it is something you cannot possibly escape: your psychological make-up is such that you are inclined to look back over your shoulder.

author: Dinah Shore
text: Trouble is part of your life - if you don't share it, you don't give the person who loves you a chance to love you enough.

author: Wendy O. Williams
text: It's not that I don't value my life. It's just that I love taking chances, testing myself, stepping over the line.

author: Michael J. Massimino
text: I saw this movie 'The Right Stuff' when I was in college, and it really rekindled my interest in being an astronaut. I started taking those steps, and then I realized it would be the chance of a lifetime. It would be a dream life: not just a job, but the whole life.

author: Michael Masser
text: Somehow, people get very nervous about leaving the comfortable life of rules behind and never take the chance to develop their own internal voice, to listen to their own consciousness.

author: David Lee
text: I look back upon graduate school as being a very happy period in my life. The chance to be thoroughly immersed in physics and to be surrounded by friends pursuing similar goals was a marvelous experience.

author: Nalo Hopkinson
text: I figure this current era of history is the one with the best chance of quality of life for a black, female, disabled, middle-aged, queer person who's most comfortable not fitting in. The odds still aren't great, mind you. But I'll take my chances with the 21st century.

author: Thomas Keating
text: One of the values of centering prayer is that you are not thinking about God during the time of centering prayer so you are giving God a chance to manifest. In centering prayer there are moments of peace that give the psyche a chance to realize that God may not be so bad after all. God has a chance to be himself for a change.

author: Stanislaw Lem
text: A dream will always triumph over reality, once it is given the chance.

author: Robert Doisneau
text: Chance is the one thing you can't buy. You have to pay for it and you have to pay for it with your life, spending a lot of time, you pay for it with time, not the wasting of time but the spending of time.

author: Melody Beattie
text: Gratitude makes sense of our past, brings peace for today, and creates a vision for tomorrow.

author: Melody Beattie
text: Gratitude unlocks the fullness of life. It turns what we have into enough, and more. It turns denial into acceptance, chaos to order, confusion to clarity. It can turn a meal into a feast, a house into a home, a stranger into a friend.

author: Ralph Marston
text: Make it a habit to tell people thank you. To express your appreciation, sincerely and without the expectation of anything in return. Truly appreciate those around you, and you'll soon find many others around you. Truly appreciate life, and you'll find that you have more of it.

author: Meister Eckhart
text: If the only prayer you ever say in your entire life is thank you, it will be enough.

author: Victoria Osteen
text: Let me encourage you to get up every day and focus on what you do have in life. Be thankful for the blessings of the little things, even when you don't get what you expect.

author: Sarah Ban Breathnach
text: Whatever we are waiting for - peace of mind, contentment, grace, the inner awareness of simple abundance - it will surely come to us, but only when we are ready to receive it with an open and grateful heart.

author: Travis Barker
text: Thank you for life, and all the little ups and downs that make it worth living.

author: Willie Nelson
text: When I started counting my blessings, my whole life turned around.

author: Henry Ward Beecher
text: Gratitude is the fairest blossom which springs from the soul.

author: Suze Orman
text: When you are grateful - when you can see what you have - you unlock blessings to flow in your life.

author: Harvey Mackay
text: Talent is God-given be humble. Fame is man-given be thankful. Conceit is self-given be careful.

author: Robert Louis Stevenson
text: Keep your eyes open to your mercies. The man who forgets to be thankful has fallen asleep in life.

author: Adam Grant
text: It's ironic that when you go through a tragedy, you appreciate more. You realize how fragile life is and that there are so many things to still be thankful for.

author: Tory Lanez
text: I'm thankful to God that my life changed, but I'm also still on my grind.

author: Charles Spurgeon
text: We are in a wrong state of mind if we are not in a thankful state of mind.

author: Jackie Joyner-Kersee
text: All I ever wanted really, and continue to want out of life, is to give 100 percent to whatever I'm doing and to be committed to whatever I'm doing and then let the results speak for themselves. Also to never take myself or people for granted and always be thankful and grateful to the people who helped me.

author: Aristotle
text: It is just that we should be grateful, not only to those with whose views we may agree, but also to those who have expressed more superficial views; for these also contributed something, by developing before us the powers of thought.

author: Tom Felton
text: Whatever life throws at me I'll take it and be grateful for it as well.

author: Joseph Gordon-Levitt
text: Every day I've got to be thankful that I am alive, and you never know - the cliche is, I guess, you could get hit by a bus tomorrow, so you'd better be at peace with whatever you got going at the moment.

author: LL Cool J
text: I am what I am, I'm doing very well in my life, and I'm thankful to God for that.

author: Lucius Annaeus Seneca
text: We can be thankful to a friend for a few acres, or a little money; and yet for the freedom and command of the whole earth, and for the great benefits of our being, our life, health, and reason, we look upon ourselves as under no obligation.

author: Dennis Prager
text: Of all the characteristics needed for both a happy and morally decent life, none surpasses gratitude. Grateful people are happier, and grateful people are more morally decent.

author: Hakeem Olajuwon
text: I was successful materially, but I know life is much more than worldly success. I saw all these blessings God had given me. The way to give thanks is obedience to God.

author: Helen Hunt Jackson
text: If I could write a story that would do for the Indian one-hundredth part what 'Uncle Tom's Cabin' did for the Negro, I would be thankful the rest of my life.

author: Amitabh Bachchan
text: I'm very thankful to directors and filmmakers who consider me in their films, and I hope I'm able to do justice to their films.

author: America Ferrera
text: As a child, I didn't know what I didn't have. I'm thankful for the challenges early on in my life because now I have a perspective on the world and kind of know what's important.

author: Elie Wiesel
text: When a person doesn't have gratitude, something is missing in his or her humanity.

author: Marie Corelli
text: Such lovely warmth of thought and delicacy of colour are beyond all praise, and equally beyond all thanks!

author: Charlie Dent
text: We in the United States should be all the more thankful for the freedom and religious tolerance we enjoy. And we should always remember the lessons learned from the Holocaust, in hopes we stay vigilant against such inhumanity now and in the future.

author: Gotthold Ephraim Lessing
text: A single grateful thought toward heaven is the most perfect prayer.

author: Richard Pryor
text: I realized this is what God has dealt me, and I should be thankful considering all that's happened to me in my life, but MS caused the movies to stop - stop dead - and I miss it.

author: Neymar
text: I'm very happy that major players are always giving their opinions about my life, my game. I am very thankful for that.

author: Chris Stapleton
text: Anytime that another artist or a critic that is well-respected says something nice about you, you're always thankful and hope that you can live up to that.

author: James McAvoy
text: When I started acting, I thought if I got one or two jobs a year I'd be lucky. So yeah, my career has gone so much farther than I ever suspected it would, and as such I feel lucky for everything I get. I feel thankful and grateful.

author: Mohit Chauhan
text: I am really thankful to the audiences that they have appreciated all my songs and I have managed to touch their soul.

author: Shawn Michaels
text: That's what I love about my faith and Christianity. It's the polar opposite of darn near everything I experienced in the wrestling business. I still love the business, and I'm thankful for everything that it's provided, but the idea that it deals in the truth is the furthest thing from reality.

author: Vanessa Hudgens
text: I want to let my fans get to know a little about me. I'm very thankful for everything they've done for me so, of course, I'm going to let them into my world a bit. But I really am a very private person, and I love kepping my life to myself - that's how I've always been.

author: Gene Simmons
text: The only jobs kids have are to do well in school, to be charming and polite, and be thankful. That's it. I'll house you, protect you, I'll even give my life for you, and in return, you will behave.

author: Barbara Kingsolver
text: Readers of fiction read, I think, for a deeper embrace of the world, of reality. And that's brave. I never get over being thankful for that - for the courage of my readers.

author: Rick Springfield
text: I'm thankful for serendipitous moments in my life, where things could've gone the other way.

author: Lake Bell
text: 'In A World...' changed my life a thousand per cent. I feel thankful that something I believed in so much - I love dialect, so I dedicated five years of my life to making a film about it - yielded such rewards. It led to 'Man Up,' as well as 'No Escape,' which comes out later this year... two movies where I am the female lead.

author: Lily Tomlin
text: Many times I sit back and say, 'I can't believe that this is my life!' Other times, I feel self-satisfied. I mean, there's a lot to be proud and thankful for but, nonetheless, it's just a life!

author: Laurie Graham
text: I'm thankful my parents obliged me to live with the unvarnished truth: I might not have been a looker, but I was a better speller than the prettiest girl in my class, and I was funnier, too.

author: Ai Weiwei
text: China has not established the rule of law and if there is a power above the law there is no social justice. Everybody can be subjected to harm. I'm just a citizen: my life is equal in value to any other. But I'm thankful that when I lost my freedom so many people shared feelings and put such touching effort into helping me.

author: Nick Jonas
text: I've gone to normal clubs, straight clubs, and I've gone to gay clubs to party with my friends and fans. There's no difference. I have nothing to prove. I'm very comfortable in my own skin, and I'm thankful to have as many close gay friends as I have, people who have been so supportive in my life and have always been there for me.

author: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan
text: What's blessed about my life is that I have been able to connect with the global audience on a regular basis. I am thankful for everybody's love, and I reciprocate that, but I also have to deliver on every occasion.

author: Madhuri Dixit
text: I am thankful to whatever I have got in my life, but one thing which is always at the back of my mind is my dance academy. I would love to see my dance academy growing.

author: Dominick Cruz
text: At a certain point, when I let go and was done - when I stopped and could say I was blessed and thankful to be a champion, when I finally enjoyed life from this different perspective - that's when I healed. Letting go healed me.

author: Jacob deGrom
text: This is something I've wanted to do my whole life is play baseball, and I think just the opportunity to put on a big-league uniform every day is just... you know, people dream of it, but not everybody gets to do it. I'm thankful every day I get to do it.

author: Kenny Leon
text: As an artist, you're thankful to get a shot at a story more than once, because it doesn't happen all the time. Whether you talk about 'Hamlet' or 'Death of a Salesman,' you always want to see what the next group of actors will do.

author: Gail Devers
text: I am very thankful that I have lived the life I have lived. I am thankful for my Graves' disease, and I tell people, if I had my whole life to live over, I would have it, because it has really made me into the person that I am.

author: Hilary Swank
text: The truth is, after Boys Don't Cry, I realized how few and far between the great roles are. I am beyond thankful for finding Million Dollar Baby.

author: Denis McDonough
text: As a husband, father and public servant, I'm thankful for the counsel and wisdom of my older brothers - Bill, who was a priest, and Kevin, who is a priest.

author: Laura Marano
text: I'm so thankful for my family and friends - they're really supportive. Everyone I work with on 'Austin & Ally;' the cast and crew are like my family now. We have so much fun, and I'm so happy they're in my life!

author: Taylor Hicks
text: 'Idol' was groundbreaking television. I am very fortunate to have won the show at the time. 'Idol' changed my life, and I am thankful.

author: Tim Hudson
text: The Atlanta Braves are really all that our children know about this crazy baseball life, and we are so thankful for this upbringing for them.

author: Mark Harmon
text: I'm thankful to get the opportunity to direct. I hope I don't mess it up.

author: Robin Hayes
text: As we look forward to freedom, the shining city on the hill and the best days of America lying ahead, it is the men and women in uniform who protect, defend and make us proud to whom we should look and give thanks every night.

author: Mara Brock Akil
text: I think pregnancy, like life, is what you make it. I received a good hand. I'm thankful and blessed and so peaceful and can't wait to welcome my son.

author: Ralph Stanley
text: I've done it all. I'm thankful and proud of what I've accomplished in my life. I hope to keep doing it.

author: Ralph Stanley
text: I'm thankful that I have lived long enough to become a legend, and I hope I deserve it.

author: Susan Dey
text: This little kid pointed at me and said, 'You look disgusting!' That was the first time I thought maybe I did. I decided I'd better start eating. I'm just thankful that I made it through with relatively few scars.

author: Voltaire
text: God gave us the gift of life it is up to us to give ourselves the gift of living well.

author: John Wooden
text: Talent is God given. Be humble. Fame is man-given. Be grateful. Conceit is self-given. Be careful.

author: Robert Baden-Powell
text: I believe that God put us in this jolly world to be happy and enjoy life.

author: Reinhold Niebuhr
text: God grant me the serenity to accept the things I cannot change, the courage to change the things I can, and the wisdom to know the difference.

author: Teena Marie
text: It's just a whole different thing, and it's just that my life has been a blessing, and I thank god every day for the gifts that he has given me and for my daughter and to be able to watch her grow and be a part of her joys and her excitement and what she wants to do in life.

author: Martin Luther
text: Faith is a living, daring confidence in God's grace, so sure and certain that a man could stake his life on it a thousand times.

author: Stephen Curry
text: It doesn't matter where you come from, what you have or don't have, what you lack, or what you have too much of. But all you need to have is faith in God, an undying passion for what you do and what you choose to do in this life, and a relentless drive and the will to do whatever it takes to be successful in whatever you put your mind to.

author: Bob Marley
text: If you're white and you're wrong, then you're wrong; if you're black and you're wrong, you're wrong. People are people. Black, blue, pink, green - God make no rules about color; only society make rules where my people suffer, and that why we must have redemption and redemption now.

author: William Shakespeare
text: Ignorance is the curse of God knowledge is the wing wherewith we fly to heaven.

author: Carl Sandburg
text: A baby is God's opinion that life should go on.

author: Christopher McCandless
text: I have had a happy life and thank the Lord. Goodbye and may God bless all!

author: John Calvin
text: A dog barks when his master is attacked. I would be a coward if I saw that God's truth is attacked and yet would remain silent.

author: Charles Stanley
text: Our heavenly Father understands our disappointment, suffering, pain, fear, and doubt. He is always there to encourage our hearts and help us understand that He's sufficient for all of our needs. When I accepted this as an absolute truth in my life, I found that my worrying stopped.

author: Mario Teguh
text: I am a person who always tries not to be easily influenced by position or achievement. I thank God for the fact that I can share more kindness and a good quality of life through the popularity. Not for the popularity itself.

author: Muhammad Ali
text: The word 'Islam' means 'peace.' The word 'Muslim' means 'one who surrenders to God.' But the press makes us seem like haters.

author: Henri Nouwen
text: Perhaps nothing helps us make the movement from our little selves to a larger world than remembering God in gratitude. Such a perspective puts God in view in all of life, not just in the moments we set aside for worship or spiritual disciplines. Not just in the moments when life seems easy.

author: Billy Graham
text: The Christian life is not a constant high. I have my moments of deep discouragement. I have to go to God in prayer with tears in my eyes, and say, 'O God, forgive me,' or 'Help me.'

author: Aeschylus
text: He who learns must suffer. And even in our sleep pain that cannot forget falls drop by drop upon the heart, and in our own despair, against our will, comes wisdom to us by the awful grace of God.

author: Thomas Jefferson
text: I tremble for my country when I reflect that God is just that his justice cannot sleep forever.

author: John F. Kelly
text: We Marines believe that God gave America the greatest gift He could bestow to man while he lived on this earth -freedom. We also believe He gave us another gift nearly as precious - our soldiers, sailors, airmen, Coast Guardsmen, and Marines - to safeguard that gift and guarantee no force on this earth can ever steal it away.

author: Florence Nightingale
text: If I could give you information of my life, it would be to show how a woman of very ordinary ability has been led by God in strange and unaccustomed paths to do In His service what He has done in her. And if I could tell you all, you would see how God has done all, and I nothing.

author: Pat Buckley
text: I believe that life is a journey towards God, and that no one has the right to insist that you go a certain road.

author: Nancy Reagan
text: To my young friends out there: Life can be great, but not when you can't see it. So, open your eyes to life: to see it in the vivid colors that God gave us as a precious gift to His children, to enjoy life to the fullest, and to make it count. Say yes to your life.

author: John Locke
text: The Bible is one of the greatest blessings bestowed by God on the children of men. It has God for its author; salvation for its end, and truth without any mixture for its matter. It is all pure.

author: Guru Nanak
text: There is but One God. His name is Truth He is the Creator. He fears none he is without hate. He never dies He is beyond the cycle of births and death. He is self-illuminated. He is realized by the kindness of the True Guru. He was True in the beginning He was True when the ages commenced and has ever been True. He is also True now.

author: Ravi Zacharias
text: When you find your definitions in God, you find the very purpose for which you were created. Put your hand into God's hand, know His absolutes, demonstrate His love, present His truth, and the message of redemption and transformation will take hold.

author: Abraham Lincoln
text: Those who deny freedom to others deserve it not for themselves; and under the rule of a just God, cannot long retain it.

author: Mother Angelica
text: Salvation brings the soul a deep awareness of God's love. Life takes on more meaning, for it now has a purpose.

author: Reinhold Niebuhr
text: God, give us grace to accept with serenity the things that cannot be changed, courage to change the things which should be changed and the wisdom to distinguish the one from the other.

author: Mother Teresa
text: Let us more and more insist on raising funds of love, of kindness, of understanding, of peace. Money will come if we seek first the Kingdom of God - the rest will be given.

author: Andrae Crouch
text: The message is that I was reminding myself and informing others of the fact that God has always been good to me. No matter what you're going through, God is always with us. Life is a journey.

author: Leland Ryken
text: The Puritans' sense of priorities in life was one of their greatest strengths. Putting God first and valuing everything else in relation to God was a recurrent Puritan theme.

author: Saint Teresa of Avila
text: The custom of speaking to God Almighty as freely as with a slave - caring nothing whether the words are suitable or not, but simply saying the first thing that comes to mind from being learnt by rote by frequent repetition - cannot be called prayer: God grant that no Christian may address Him in this manner.

author: John Wesley
text: As for reputation, though it be a glorious instrument of advancing our Master's service, yet there is a better than that: a clean heart, a single eye, and a soul full of God. A fair exchange if, by the loss of reputation, we can purchase the lowest degree of purity of heart.

author: Armstrong Williams
text: Even during the worst hardships, when the other things in our lives seem to fall apart, we can still find peace in the eternal love of God.

author: Ravi Zacharias
text: The assurance of Heaven is never given to the person. And that's why at the core of the Christian faith is the grace of God. If there's one word I would grab from all of that, it's forgiveness - that you can be forgiven. I can be forgiven, and it is of the grace of God. But once you understand that, I think the ramifications are worldwide.

author: Edna St. Vincent Millay
text: The soul can split the sky in two and let the face of God shine through.

author: Elie Wiesel
text: Mankind must remember that peace is not God's gift to his creatures peace is our gift to each other.

author: Max Lucado
text: The meaning of life. The wasted years of life. The poor choices of life. God answers the mess of life with one word: 'grace.'

author: Mark Twain
text: It is by the goodness of God that in our country we have those three unspeakably precious things: freedom of speech, freedom of conscience, and the prudence never to practice either of them.

author: Mother Teresa
text: Our life of poverty is as necessary as the work itself. Only in heaven will we see how much we owe to the poor for helping us to love God better because of them.

author: Mahatma Gandhi
text: God is, even though the whole world deny him. Truth stands, even if there be no public support. It is self-sustained.

author: Elizabeth I
text: I pray to God that I shall not live one hour after I have thought of using deception.

author: Helen Mirren
text: When you're young, you wonder what all these old people are droning on about, trying to impart their wisdom. It's not relevant to you because being young is such a specific thing. Thank God for that. Thank God for the young people who go out and demonstrate against rampant capitalism or whatever.

author: Kanye West
text: I am God's vessel. But my greatest pain in life is that I will never be able to see myself perform live.

author: Victoria Osteen
text: When you receive God's love and encouragement, it will empower you to do more than you ever thought possible.

author: Meister Eckhart
text: The knower and the known are one. Simple people imagine that they should see God as if he stood there and they here. This is not so. God and I, we are one in knowledge.

author: Jiddu Krishnamurti
text: The question of whether or not there is a God or truth or reality or whatever you like to call it, can never be answered by books, by priests, philosopher's or saviours. Nobody and nothing can answer the question but you yourself, and that is why you must know yourself - Immaturity lies only in total ignorance of self.

author: Howard Dean
text: From a religious point of view, if God had thought homosexuality is a sin, he would not have created gay people.

author: Teena Marie
text: I have enough love to last me a lifetime! Thank God I'll never lose my imagination and my passion. That's really what it is. I'm still passionate about what I do.

author: Gilbert K. Chesterton
text: Men always talk about the most important things to perfect strangers. In the perfect stranger we perceive man himself the image of a God is not disguised by resemblances to an uncle or doubts of wisdom of a mustache.

author: Michelangelo
text: I am a poor man and of little worth, who is laboring in that art that God has given me in order to extend my life as long as possible.

author: Mike Epps
text: I'm a survivor of life. I try to give the glory to God and appreciate what's happening to me.

author: Billy Tauzin
text: The question is what I wanted to do with the new life God has given me. This is the mission I want to take on.

author: Abu Bakr
text: There is greatness in the fear of God, contentment in faith of God, and honour in humility.

author: Socrates
text: The end of life is to be like God, and the soul following God will be like Him.

author: Wendell Berry
text: We cannot know the whole truth, which belongs to God alone, but our task nevertheless is to seek to know what is true. And if we offend gravely enough against what we know to be true, as by failing badly enough to deal affectionately and responsibly with our land and our neighbors, truth will retaliate with ugliness, poverty, and disease.

author: Johnny Cash
text: God gives us life and takes us away as He sees fit.

author: Billy Graham
text: Our society strives to avoid any possibility of offending anyone - except God.

author: Ben Carson
text: My strong belief is that God created human beings and therefore he knows about every aspect of the human body. So if I want to fix it, I just need to stay in harmony with Him.

author: Lech Walesa
text: I'm a man of faith. I only fear God, and my wife - sometimes.

author: Miley Cyrus
text: God wants my life to be about being successful and being happy and blessing other people and being blessed.

author: Isaac Newton
text: I have a fundamental belief in the Bible as the Word of God, written by those who were inspired. I study the Bible daily.

author: Margaret D. Nadauld
text: The divine light which you carry within your soul is inherited from God because you are His daughter. Part of the light which makes you so magnificent is the blessing of womanhood.

author: Mahatma Gandhi
text: There is nothing that wastes the body like worry, and one who has any faith in God should be ashamed to worry about anything whatsoever.

author: Joyce Meyer
text: When you focus on how wonderful God is and all the great things He's done... is doing... and even will do in your life, your natural response will be praise, adoration and awe. Don't let yourself ever get used to it... stay amazed!

author: Charles Spurgeon
text: After many years of great mercy, after tasting of the powers of the world to come, we still are so weak, so foolish; but, oh! when we get away from self to God, there all is truth and purity and holiness, and our heart finds peace, wisdom, completeness, delight, joy, victory.

author: Pope Benedict XVI
text: The wrath of God is a way of saying that I have been living in a way that is contrary to the love that is God. Anyone who begins to live and grow away from God, who lives away from what is good, is turning his life toward wrath.

author: Alfred Adler
text: God who is eternally complete, who directs the stars, who is the master of fates, who elevates man from his lowliness to Himself, who speaks from the cosmos to every single human soul, is the most brilliant manifestation of the goal of perfection.

author: Christopher McCandless
text: It is the experiences, the great triumphant joy of living to the fullest extent in which real meaning is found. God it's great to be alive!

author: William Wilberforce
text: Life as we know it, with all its ups and downs, will soon be over. We all will give an accounting to God of how we have lived.

author: Robert Jeffress
text: The fact that what we believe about marriage - that it should be between a man and a woman - and that we're pro-life, somehow that becomes radical? Why is that? It's because our culture has changed. But the truth is, culture may change, people change, but the Word of God never changes, and that's what we rest our belief system on.

author: Arthur Ashe
text: If I were to say, 'God, why me?' about the bad things, then I should have said, 'God, why me?' about the good things that happened in my life.

author: Mattie Stepanek
text: If it came to a magic genie, I would ask him for two extra wishes. One would be that no one would have to live with the muscular dystrophy disease or any disease. And the second one would be world peace, that we just stop fighting, talk about things, and we could live in harmony once again, like God intended us to do.

author: Tom Landry
text: As a Christian, I know my life is in God's hands. He has a plan for me. Therefore, I never worry about tomorrow or never worry about winning or losing football games. That knowledge gives me a lot of composure in tough situations.

author: Simone Weil
text: Every perfect life is a parable invented by God.

author: Charlie Chaplin
text: I am at peace with God. My conflict is with Man.

author: Trevor Huddleston
text: God bless Africa, Guard her people, Guide her leaders, And give her peace.

author: Jose Bergamin
text: To light one candle to God and another to the Devil is the principle of wisdom.

author: Joseph Prince
text: As you walk in God's divine wisdom, you will surely begin to see a greater measure of victory and good success in your life.

author: Thomas Jefferson
text: I have sworn upon the altar of God, eternal hostility against every form of tyranny over the mind of man.

author: Edwin Louis Cole
text: Knowledge of God's Word is a bulwark against deception, temptation, accusation, even persecution.

author: Amy Tan
text: God, life changes faster than you think.

author: Bobby Darin
text: Any fool knows that bravado is always a cover-up for insecurity. That's the truth. And on that note, I'll say goodnight. God love you.

author: Aldous Huxley
text: There's only one effectively redemptive sacrifice, the sacrifice of self-will to make room for the knowledge of God.

author: Isaac Bashevis Singer
text: Life is God's novel. Let him write it.

author: Jean Paul
text: God is an unutterable sigh, planted in the depths of the soul.

author: Aiden Wilson Tozer
text: In almost everything that touches our everyday life on earth, God is pleased when we're pleased. He wills that we be as free as birds to soar and sing our maker's praise without anxiety.

author: Dietrich Bonhoeffer
text: God's truth judges created things out of love, and Satan's truth judges them out of envy and hatred.

author: Jose Rizal
text: To doubt God is to doubt one's own conscience, and in consequence, it would be to doubt everything; and then what is life for?

author: Hugh Ross
text: God put the human race in charge of managing the resources of the entire planet for the benefit of all life. Therefore, we, of all people on this planet, should be concerned about environmental issues and doing what we can to enhance the beauty and productivity of the natural realm.

author: Tim Wise
text: Here's the reality. The image of a white Jesus has been used to justify enslavement, conquest, colonialism, the genocide of indigenous peoples. There are literally millions of human beings whose lives have been snuffed out by people who conquered under the banner of a white god.

author: Dorothea Dix
text: We are not sent into this world mainly to enjoy the loveliness therein, nor to sit us down in passive ease; no, we were sent here for action. The soul that seeks to do the will of God with a pure heart, fervently, does not yield to the lethargy of ease.

author: William Barclay
text: When we believe that God is Father, we also believe that such a father's hand will never cause his child a needless tear. We may not understand life any better, but we will not resent life any longer.

author: Rowan Williams
text: The Church is the new creation, it is life and joy, it is the sacramental fellowship in which we share the ultimate purpose of God, made real for us now in our hearing the Word and sharing the Sacrament.

author: David Brainerd
text: The all-seeing eye of God beheld our deplorable state infinite pity touched the heart of the Father of mercies and infinite wisdom laid the plan of our recovery.

author: Joyce Meyer
text: The only answer to fear is faith in God, knowing He loves you unconditionally and individually.

author: Aristotle
text: He who is unable to live in society, or who has no need because he is sufficient for himself, must be either a beast or a god.

author: Nellie Bly
text: I always had a desire to know asylum life more thoroughly - a desire to be convinced that the most helpless of God's creatures, the insane, were cared for kindly and properly.

author: Charles Stanley
text: Basically, there are two paths you can walk: faith or fear. It's impossible to simultaneously trust God and not trust God.

author: William Barclay
text: The tragedy of life and of the world is not that men do not know God; the tragedy is that, knowing Him, they still insist on going their own way.

author: William Lloyd Garrison
text: I do not believe that God has created us under this dire necessity to toil, like beasts, to sustain life. I believe it is his will that we should hold absolute mastery over time, so as to devote it mainly to intellectual and moral improvement, domestic enjoyment, and social intercourse.

author: Charles R. Swindoll
text: It is easy for Christians to have the false impression that once we have established a relationship with Christ, which we believe sets us right with God, the problems of life will somehow scoot away or they will slowly be removed from our lives.

author: Henry B. Eyring
text: The feeling of longing for home is born into us. That wonderful dream cannot become real without great faith - enough for the Holy Ghost to lead us to repentance, baptism, and the making and keeping of sacred covenants with God. This faith requires enduring bravely the trials of mortal life.

author: Pope Paul VI
text: The Eucharistic mystery stands at the heart and center of the liturgy since it is the fount of life by which we are cleansed and strengthened to live not for ourselves but for God and to be united in love among ourselves.

author: Ravi Zacharias
text: You can only learn so much from books. You can only learn so much from education. Ultimately, it is the wisdom of God that will carry you through in the toughest situations of life.

author: DJ Khaled
text: I wake up every day inspiring myself, because God gave me life.

author: Victoria Osteen
text: Bitterness and unforgiveness block the flow of God's blessing in your life and actually hinder your prayers.

author: Saint Ignatius
text: Man was created to praise, reverence, and serve God our Lord and in this way to save his soul. The other things on Earth were created for man's use, to help him reach the end for which he was created.

author: Ellen G. White
text: As we lay hold upon the truth of God, its influence must affect us. It must elevate us. It must remove from us every imperfection.

author: Mikhail Bakunin
text: He who desires to worship God must harbor no childish illusions about the matter but bravely renounce his liberty and humanity.

author: Aeschylus
text: God's most lordly gift to man is decency of mind.

author: Malcolm Muggeridge
text: One of the peculiar sins of the twentieth century which we've developed to a very high level is the sin of credulity. It has been said that when human beings stop believing in God they believe in nothing. The truth is much worse: they believe in anything.

author: Olivier Messiaen
text: My faith is the grand drama of my life. I'm a believer, so I sing words of God to those who have no faith.

author: George Berkeley
text: From my own being, and from the dependency I find in myself and my ideas, I do, by an act of reason, necessarily infer the existence of a God, and of all created things in the mind of God.

author: Elisabeth Kubler-Ross
text: Live, so you do not have to look back and say: 'God, how I have wasted my life.'

author: Elie Wiesel
text: I was very, very religious. And of course I wrote about it in 'Night.' I questioned God's silence. So I questioned. I don't have an answer for that. Does it mean that I stopped having faith? No. I have faith, but I question it.

author: Jim Elliot
text: Most laws condemn the soul and pronounce sentence. The result of the law of my God is perfect. It condemns but forgives. It restores - more than abundantly - what it takes away.

author: Blaise Pascal
text: The finite is annihilated in the presence of the infinite, and becomes a pure nothing. So our spirit before God, so our justice before divine justice.

author: John Nelson Darby
text: Among the children of God, it was they who were most able to rightly divide the word of truth.

author: Roy Moore
text: The point is that knowledge of God is not prohibited under the First Amendment.

author: Imelda Marcos
text: I always say you can never be extravagant with beauty. Beauty is God made real. Beauty is life.

author: Pat Robertson
text: I thought that communism, the tyranny of communism, was an abomination and I beseeched God to bring that terrible evil down and he did. It was a great triumph, it took awhile, but it happened.

author: Jupiter Hammon
text: The Bible is a revelation of the mind and will of God to men. Therein we may learn, what God is.

author: Mahatma Gandhi
text: God, as Truth, has been for me a treasure beyond price. May He be so to every one of us.

author: Voltaire
text: All men are born with a nose and five fingers, but no one is born with a knowledge of God.

author: Stevie Wonder
text: God gave me life to continue to do things that I would never have done.

author: Ramakrishna
text: One must be very particular about telling the truth. Through truth one can realize God.

author: Johannes Tauler
text: God in His wisdom has decided that He will reward no works but His own.

author: Evelyn Underhill
text: There is no place in my soul, no corner of my character, where God is not.

author: Xenophanes
text: God is one, greatest of gods and men, not like mortals in body or thought.

author: Shakuntala Devi
text: Education is not just about going to school and getting a degree. It's about widening your knowledge and absorbing the truth about life.

author: Anton Chekhov
text: Knowledge is of no value unless you put it into practice.

author: George Bernard Shaw
text: Beware of false knowledge it is more dangerous than ignorance.

author: John F. Kennedy
text: The goal of education is the advancement of knowledge and the dissemination of truth.

author: John Adams
text: Liberty cannot be preserved without general knowledge among the people.

author: James A. Forbes
text: When people rely on surface appearances and false racial stereotypes, rather than in-depth knowledge of others at the level of the heart, mind and spirit, their ability to assess and understand people accurately is compromised.

author: Paul Rand
text: Design is a way of life, a point of view. It involves the whole complex of visual communications: talent, creative ability, manual skill, and technical knowledge. Aesthetics and economics, technology and psychology are intrinsically related to the process.

author: Albert Einstein
text: Imagination is more important than knowledge.

author: Marilyn vos Savant
text: To acquire knowledge, one must study; but to acquire wisdom, one must observe.

author: Dave Ramsey
text: I believe that through knowledge and discipline, financial peace is possible for all of us.

author: A. P. J. Abdul Kalam
text: Ultimately, education in its real sense is the pursuit of truth. It is an endless journey through knowledge and enlightenment.

author: Malcolm X
text: Despite my firm convictions, I have always been a man who tries to face facts, and to accept the reality of life as new experience and new knowledge unfolds. I have always kept an open mind, a flexibility that must go hand in hand with every form of the intelligent search for truth.

author: Charles Spurgeon
text: Wisdom is the right use of knowledge. To know is not to be wise. Many men know a great deal, and are all the greater fools for it. There is no fool so great a fool as a knowing fool. But to know how to use knowledge is to have wisdom.

author: Brian O'Driscoll
text: Knowledge is knowing that a tomato is a fruit. Wisdom is knowing not to put it in a fruit salad.

author: Khalil Gibran
text: A little knowledge that acts is worth infinitely more than much knowledge that is idle.

author: Daniel J. Boorstin
text: The greatest obstacle to discovery is not ignorance - it is the illusion of knowledge.

author: D. H. Lawrence
text: Life is a travelling to the edge of knowledge, then a leap taken.

author: Ramana Maharshi
text: Time is only an idea. There is only the Reality. Whatever you think it is, it looks like that. If you call it time, it is time. If you call it existence, it is existence, and so on. After calling it time, you divide it into days and nights, months, years, hours, minutes, etc. Time is immaterial for the Path of Knowledge.

author: John F. Kennedy
text: The greater our knowledge increases the more our ignorance unfolds.

author: Thich Nhat Hanh
text: We fear that this moment will end, that we won't get what we need, that we will lose what we love, or that we will not be safe. Often, our biggest fear is the knowledge that one day our bodies will cease functioning. So even when we are surrounded by all the conditions for happiness, our joy is not complete.

author: Plato
text: Knowledge without justice ought to be called cunning rather than wisdom.

author: Bertrand Russell
text: Three passions, simple but overwhelmingly strong, have governed my life: the longing for love, the search for knowledge, and unbearable pity for the suffering of mankind.

author: Alexander the Great
text: For my own part, I would rather excel in knowledge of the highest secrets of philosophy than in arms.

author: John Locke
text: Reading furnishes the mind only with materials of knowledge it is thinking that makes what we read ours.

author: Ray Bradbury
text: Collecting facts is important. Knowledge is important. But if you don't have an imagination to use the knowledge, civilization is nowhere.

author: Tavis Smiley
text: We give you the facts. I told you information is power - knowledge is power. We can't be in an ideological battle to redeem the soul of this country if we don't have the facts.

author: Will Durant
text: Knowledge is the eye of desire and can become the pilot of the soul.

author: Pope Francis
text: Grace is not part of consciousness; it is the amount of light in our souls, not knowledge nor reason.

author: Khalil Gibran
text: I wash my hands of those who imagine chattering to be knowledge, silence to be ignorance, and affection to be art.

author: Mark Pocan
text: More than ever, a college diploma unlocks economic opportunity, provides students with a wealth of new skills and knowledge, and encourages innovation and growth. But more than ever, it also comes with a mountain of student loan debt.

author: Hermann Hesse
text: Knowledge can be communicated, but not wisdom. One can find it, live it, be fortified by it, do wonders through it, but one cannot communicate and teach it.

author: Plato
text: Knowledge which is acquired under compulsion obtains no hold on the mind.

author: Archibald Hill
text: The pursuit of natural knowledge, the investigation of the world - mental and material - in which we live, is not a dull and spiritless affair: rather is it a voyage of adventure of the human mind, a holiday for reckless and imaginative souls.

author: Sally Ride
text: Studying whether there's life on Mars or studying how the universe began, there's something magical about pushing back the frontiers of knowledge. That's something that is almost part of being human, and I'm certain that will continue.

author: Matt Blunt
text: We stand in the shadow of Jefferson who believed that a society founded upon the rule of law and liberty was dependent upon public education and the diffusion of knowledge.

author: Saint Bernard
text: In truth, opinion may be taken for understanding; understanding cannot be taken for opinion. How so? Surely because opinion may be deceived; understanding cannot be. If it could, it would not be understanding but opinion. For true understanding has not only certain truth, but the knowledge of truth.

author: Clifford Stoll
text: Data is not information, information is not knowledge, knowledge is not understanding, understanding is not wisdom.

author: Abigail Adams
text: Well, knowledge is a fine thing, and mother Eve thought so; but she smarted so severely for hers, that most of her daughters have been afraid of it since.

author: Lord Byron
text: Sorrow is knowledge, those that know the most must mourn the deepest, the tree of knowledge is not the tree of life.

author: A. R. Rahman
text: Wisdom comes from within. Knowledge is acquired and can sometimes put a screen on your wisdom.

author: Viktor E. Frankl
text: There is nothing in the world, I venture to say, that would so effectively help one to survive even the worst conditions as the knowledge that there is a meaning in one's life.

author: Michel Foucault
text: The history of thought, of knowledge, of philosophy, of literature seems to be seeking, and discovering, more and more discontinuities, whereas history itself appears to be abandoning the irruption of events in favor of stable structures.

author: David Ben-Gurion
text: Courage is a special kind of knowledge: the knowledge of how to fear what ought to be feared and how not to fear what ought not to be feared.

author: Walt Disney
text: We did it Disneyland, in the knowledge that most of the people I talked to thought it would be a financial disaster - closed and forgotten within the first year.

author: Avery Brooks
text: Knowledge is going to make you stronger. Knowledge is going to let you control your life. Knowledge is going to give you the wisdom to teach their children. Knowledge is the thing that makes you smile in the face of disaster.

author: Thich Nhat Hanh
text: We have to continue to learn. We have to be open. And we have to be ready to release our knowledge in order to come to a higher understanding of reality.

author: Muhammad Yunus
text: By simply capitalizing on core strengths and knowledge, companies and entrepreneurs can engage in an emerging business model that will enable them to create - and demonstrate - real, sustainable social impact in society.

author: Shari Arison
text: I have recently been able to see the new world - the quiet, the tranquility and the freedom it will bring with it. This is very comforting knowledge for me because I already know that what I envision eventually becomes a reality.

author: Said Nursi
text: Creation's highest aim and most sublime result is belief in God. The most exalted rank of humanity is knowledge of God.

author: Alan Lightman
text: As both a scientist and a humanist myself, I have struggled to understand different claims to knowledge, and I have eventually come to a formulation of the kind of religious belief that would, in my view, be compatible with science.

author: Ben Zobrist
text: I still have a lot to learn about what the love of Christ is like - that it's not just knowledge... but it's allowing the truth to change you - allowing Christ's message of grace and hope and love through the cross, that that message is the message that changes the way we look at everything in our lives.

author: Bertrand Russell
text: Dogmatism and skepticism are both, in a sense, absolute philosophies; one is certain of knowing, the other of not knowing. What philosophy should dissipate is certainty, whether of knowledge or ignorance.

author: Tom Stoppard
text: For me, human rights simply endorse a view of life and a set of moral values that are perfectly clear to an eight-year-old child. A child knows what is fair and isn't fair, and justice derives from that knowledge.

author: Susan Howatch
text: I am a lover of truth; and if you think of truth as being multifaceted and so huge that we human beings can't fully comprehend it, then obviously it makes sense to put all the facts together - to compare disciplines and try to advance the sum of knowledge by exploration and examination.

author: Venerable Bede
text: And I pray thee, loving Jesus, that as Thou hast graciously given me to drink in with delight the words of Thy knowledge, so Thou wouldst mercifully grant me to attain one day to Thee, the fountain of all wisdom and to appear forever before Thy face.

author: Carl Jung
text: Knowledge rests not upon truth alone, but upon error also.

author: Khalil Gibran
text: Pain and foolishness lead to great bliss and complete knowledge, for Eternal Wisdom created nothing under the sun in vain.

author: Carl Jung
text: Just as we might take Darwin as an example of the normal extraverted thinking type, the normal introverted thinking type could be represented by Kant. The one speaks with facts, the other relies on the subjective factor. Darwin ranges over the wide field of objective reality, Kant restricts himself to a critique of knowledge.

author: William Cowper
text: Knowledge is proud that it knows so much wisdom is humble that it knows no more.

author: Janet Jackson
text: In complete darkness we are all the same, it is only our knowledge and wisdom that separates us, don't let your eyes deceive you.

author: Franz Kafka
text: We are sinful not only because we have eaten of the Tree of Knowledge, but also because we have not yet eaten of the Tree of Life. The state in which we are is sinful, irrespective of guilt.

author: Marcus Tullius Cicero
text: Knowledge which is divorced from justice, may be called cunning rather than wisdom.

author: Maria Mitchell
text: We have a hunger of the mind which asks for knowledge of all around us, and the more we gain, the more is our desire; the more we see, the more we are capable of seeing.

author: Jean-Francois Lyotard
text: If we wish to discuss knowledge in the most highly developed contemporary society, we must answer the preliminary question of what methodological representation to apply to that society.

author: Randi Weingarten
text: A high-quality public education can build much-needed skills and knowledge. It can help children reach their God-given potential. It can stabilize communities and democracies. It can strengthen economies. It can combat the kind of fear and despair that evolves into hatred.

author: Gerard De Nerval
text: The tree of knowledge is not the tree of life! And yet can we cast out of our spirits all the good or evil poured into them by so many learned generations? Ignorance cannot be learned.

author: George Boole
text: To unfold the secret laws and relations of those high faculties of thought by which all beyond the merely perceptive knowledge of the world and of ourselves is attained or matured, is a object which does not stand in need of commendation to a rational mind.

author: Lafcadio Hearn
text: A great many things which in times of lesser knowledge we imagined to be superstitious or useless, prove today on examination to have been of immense value to mankind.

author: A. E. Waite
text: Behind the man is the Tree of Life, bearing twelve fruits, and the Tree of the Knowledge of Good and Evil is behind the woman; the serpent is twining round it.

author: Emmitt Smith
text: Always, through my whole life, I've had a thirst for knowledge.

author: Georg C. Lichtenberg
text: The Greeks possessed a knowledge of human nature we seem hardly able to attain to without passing through the strengthening hibernation of a new barbarism.

author: Nate Silver
text: Distinguishing the signal from the noise requires both scientific knowledge and self-knowledge.

author: Moza bint Nasser
text: We believe... that by encouraging critical thinking and processing of knowledge we are creating full, well-rounded human beings... that will enable Qatar to build up its society. You cannot build a healthy society without giving your citizens a sense of ownership. Otherwise, they will not share with you the responsibilities.

author: Jeff Greenfield
text: This is part of the involuntary bargain we make with the world just by being alive. We get to experiences the splendor of nature, the beauty of art, the balm of love and the sheer joy of existence, always with the knowledge that illness, injury, natural disaster, or pure evil can end it in an instant for ourselves or someone we love.

author: Chuck Berry
text: Of the five most important things in life, health is first, education or knowledge is second, and wealth is third. I forget the other two.

author: Derek Bok
