text: Caresses, expressions of one sort or another, are necessary to the life of the affections as leaves are to the life of a tree. If they are wholly restrained, love will die at the roots.

author: Amy Grant
text: Real relationship is gritty and earthy, the stuff that life is made of.

author: Chelsea Peretti
text: I would say that I have a love-hate relationship with almost everything in my life, including stand-up.

author: Charlotte Perkins Gilman
text: The first duty of a human being is to assume the right functional relationship to society - more briefly, to find your real job, and do it.

author: Joyce Meyer
text: In my relationship with God, I've learned that if I follow a 'formula' for how I spend my time with Him, then I'm just accomplishing a checklist of things I feel obligated to do to please Him. This makes my spiritual life more about doing what I need to do to fulfill an obligation than something meaningful.

author: Tony Kushner
text: I feel there's a power in theatre, but it's an indirect power. It's like the relationship of the sleeper to the unconscious. You discover things you can't afford to countenance in waking life. You can forget them, remember them a day later or not have any idea what they are about.

author: Langston Hughes
text: Very early in life, it seemed to me that there was a relationship between the problems of the Negro people in America and the Jewish people in Russia, and that the Jewish people's problems were worse than ours.

author: Jean-Claude Van Damme
text: I don't have a bad relationship. I'm 48 years old. I think life is too short for that. To me, life is... you open the shutters, you see the dogs outside, you look left, you look right, in, what, a second and a half? And that's a life.

author: Lynn Coady
text: We live in a society that celebrates familial connection above any other kind of relationship. We are shown photos of our great-grandparents and encouraged to marvel over facial similarities. We are told to take pride in our bloodlines, celebrate our ancestry.

author: Moon Unit Zappa
text: I've got a new relationship and I'm trapped in this old life.

author: Scott Stapp
text: I always believed in God and Christ, but I was in rebellion - trying to make my relationship with God fit into my life instead of making my life fit in with him. I was stubborn.

author: Jeff Bridges
text: If you change partners every time it gets tough or you get a little dissatisfied, then I don't think you get the richness that's available in a long-term relationship.

author: Richard Foster
text: Spiritual direction is an interpersonal relationship in which we learn how to grow, live, and love in the spiritual life.

author: James E. Faust
text: The depth of the love of parents for their children cannot be measured. It is like no other relationship. It exceeds concern for life itself. The love of a parent for a child is continuous and transcends heartbreak and disappointment.

author: Nick Vujicic
text: The greatest news that I could ever say is that Jesus is Lord and Savior of my life. He is my friend. He is with me wherever I go. I'm so delighted to continue to grow in my relationship to Jesus.

author: Natalie Zea
text: My parents divorced when I was very, very young, but they maintained an incredibly amicable relationship. They were great partners, they were great parents, and they were great friends throughout my whole life until I was about 25, at which point they realized that they could relinquish; they could call it and move on.

author: Ella Henderson
text: I have never been in a serious relationship and never had a break-up, so I can't tug on my heartstrings that way. But whenever I experience a strong emotion in life, I definitely have to throw myself into my songwriting. It is very therapeutic.

author: Hans Adolf Krebs
text: The existence of common features in different forms of life indicates some relationship between the different organisms, and according to the concept of evolution, these relations stem from the circumstance that the higher organisms, in the course of millions of years, have gradually evolved from simpler ones.

author: Robert Kennedy
text: The ultimate relationship between justice and law will be an eternal subject for speculation and analysis. But it may be said that in a democratic society, law is the form which free men give to justice.

author: Jiddu Krishnamurti
text: Life is relationship, living is relationship. We cannot live if you and I have built a wall around ourselves and just peep over that wall occasionally. Unconsciously, deeply, under the wall, we are related.

author: Rudolf Steiner
text: You can get an idea of human nature only when you can see the relationship of the individual human being to the whole cosmos.

author: Amy Adams
text: Being pregnant finally helped me understand what my true relationship was with my body - meaning that it wasn't put on this earth to look good in a swimsuit.

author: Mitt Romney
text: American official policy is that Egypt is an ally of the United States. Of course, we recognize that Egypt has gone through a dramatic change in government. And what their status will be going forward in terms of the relationship with our nation is something which which I'm sure will be developing over time.

author: Taylor Swift
text: I don't know how to have a normal relationship because I try to act normal and love from a normal place and live a normal life, but there is sort of an abnormal magnifying glass, like telescope lens, on everything that happens.

author: Taylor Swift
text: The drama and the trauma of the relationship you have when you're 16 can mirror the one you have when you're 26. Life repeats itself.

author: Joyce Meyer
text: Prayer is such a basic foundation of a Christian's relationship with God. It's how we communicate and fellowship with Him. But a surprising number of people, young and old, new and even long-time Christians, say they're not satisfied with their prayer life.

author: Joyce Meyer
text: The truth is God created us to have relationship with us. He wants to love us and take care of us, and He wants us to love Him. That's where our walk with Christ has to start.

author: Joyce Meyer
text: Real life is the life that's in you, not your circumstances, like where you live or what job you have or who you're in relationship with.

author: Lady Gaga
text: History shows us that in times of people feeling like they are in need of some sort of rebellion or protests, the artists rise because the poetry we create about pain and its relationship to culture in the world begins to soothe and heal people who are feeling confused or afraid.

author: Kate Winslet
text: There were nineteen years between my grandparents, and I was in a relationship for five years from the age of fifteen to twenty with a man who was thirteen years older than me who remains one of the loves of my life, and he passed away when I was twenty years old.

author: Marine Le Pen
text: I am well placed to know that Le Pen is not an anti-Semite. If one considers his life seriously... a man who went to fight with the Israelis in '56! Many times, he tried to better the party's relationship with the Jewish community, even though I do not like the term.

author: Pope Benedict XVI
text: How much we need, in the church and in society, witnesses of the beauty of holiness, witnesses of the splendour of truth, witnesses of the joy and freedom born of a living relationship with Christ!

author: Tim Tebow
text: If you're married, and you have a wife, and you really love your wife, is it good enough to only say to your wife 'I love her' the day you get married? Or should you tell her every single day when you wake up and every opportunity? And that's how I feel about my relationship with Jesus Christ is that it is the most important thing in my life.

author: Tim Tebow
text: It's pretty easy for me to say that the most important thing in my life is my relationship with Jesus Christ, followed by my relationship with family. And football's later on down the line.

author: Kourtney Kardashian
text: My entire life changed when I became a mother - my priorities, my understanding, appreciation of life, and my relationship with God.

author: Victoria Osteen
text: Remember, if you want to love your life and live it to the fullest, don't let the sun go down on your anger. If you don't have a solution to the issue, agree to disagree and focus on the importance of the relationship.

author: Penelope Cruz
text: I have stepped off the relationship scene to come to terms with myself. I have spent most of my adult life being 'someone's girlfriend', and now I am happy being single.

author: Marjane Satrapi
text: Anything that has a relationship with pleasure, we reject it. Eating, they talk about cholesterol; making love, they talk about AIDS; you talk about smoking, they talk about cancer. It's a very sick society that rejects pleasure.

author: Adam Sandler
text: I'm 31 now. I think I'm beginning to understand what life is, what romance is, and what a relationship means.

author: Laura Linney
text: I hope that anyone I worked with wouldn't exploit our relationship.

author: Tom Rath
text: When we look at what has the strongest statistical relationship to overall evaluation of your life, the first one is your career well-being, or the mission, purpose and meaning of what you're doing when you wake up each day.

author: Jack Canfield
text: I used to define success as being able to produce any result you wanted, whether it was a relationship, weight-loss, being a millionaire, impacting the culture, changing society, whatever it might be - it might be homelessness, whatever - and lately, I've redefined success as 'fulfilling your soul's purpose.'

author: Vir Das
text: I'm kind of a rebound junkie. So. when a relationship goes sour, I look at the sweetness in life elsewhere. So, I date a bit. The best catharsis is to write jokes and tell 4,000 people about it.

author: David Whyte
text: Honesty lies in understanding our close and necessary relationship with not wanting to hear the truth.

author: Lorde
text: I curate my life in a way. It's always playing on my mind, kind of a love-hate relationship. I'm not one of those people who's, like, 'I wish Facebook wasn't around,' because, you know, it is what it is.

author: Tom Landry
text: I know that life is really finding the right relationship between yourself and God.

author: Pat Conroy
text: I think I learned about the relationship between books and life from Margaret Mitchell.

author: Giuliana Rancic
text: If you are strong enough as a couple, reality shows can be a good thing for the relationship.

author: David D. Burns
text: Therapy is not to 'talk about' things, but to change the person's life, and to relieve suffering, such as depression, anxiety, or relationship problems.

author: Kenny Loggins
text: I couldn't be in a relationship and behave like somebody else or pretend I felt something I didn't feel. And that includes saying things I thought might jeopardize the relationship.

author: Keri Hilson
text: We all have something about ourselves that we'd change if we could in a perfect world, be it our body image, our financial status, our relationship, whatever. I wanted to talk about how nobody's exempted from the realities of life and all those things.

author: Jean Hanff Korelitz
text: The Thames could be thought of as England's longest archaeological site, and no fewer than 90,000 objects recovered from its foreshore are in the collection of the Museum of London, whose 30-year relationship with London mudlarks is both committed and highly regulated.

author: Jacques Audiard
text: Cinema for me only has meaning when it has a relationship with what I see outside on the street.

author: Candice Accola
text: When you're watching television, you don't want to watch a show where everything just works out. You don't want to see a relationship that's just blossoming and everyone's happy and sunshine and roses all the time. That's also not true in life.

author: Keith Sweat
text: You can't stop loving or wanting to love because when its right it's the best thing in the world. When you're in a relationship and its good, even if nothing else in your life is right, you feel like your whole world is complete.

author: Catherine Opie
text: Nature is a dream state at this point, that we almost don't have a real relationship to it unless it's people living off the land and killing our own food and going for it.

author: Susan Griffin
text: I think we actually punish children out of their relationship with their bodies... we categorically separate mind and body and emotion and intellect.

author: Cliff Sloan
text: There is no more moving a professional relationship than that between a law clerk and a Supreme Court justice. As a place to work, the court is unique in its intimacy and intensity.

author: Benjamin Franklin
text: Without continual growth and progress, such words as improvement, achievement, and success have no meaning.

author: Abraham Lincoln
text: Always bear in mind that your own resolution to succeed is more important than any other.

author: Josh Turner
text: Life is a series of punches. It presents a lot of challenges. It presents a lot of hardship, but the people that are able to take those punches and able to move forward are the ones that really do have a lot of success and have a lot of joy in their life and have a lot of stories to tell, too.

author: Conor McGregor
text: My success isn't a result of arrogance - it's a result of belief.

author: Al Yankovic
text: As my father used to tell me, the only true sign of success in life is being able to do for a living that which makes you happy.

author: Booker T. Washington
text: Success in life is founded upon attention to the small things rather than to the large things to the every day things nearest to us rather than to the things that are remote and uncommon.

author: Britney Spears
text: For me, success is a state of mind. I feel like success isn't about conquering something; it's being happy with who you are.

author: Peter James
text: There are people who can achieve huge success in life, while adding a bit of fun and a splash of colour to this increasingly grey world.

author: Kendrick Lamar
text: I look at where I'm at today and realize that most of my success is owed to the mentors that was in my life.

author: Josh McDaniels
text: Of all the things people have taught me regarding life lessons or anything that would benefit me, I don't think anything helped me learn more about life than football. You go through so many different things: adversity, how to handle adversity, how to handle success, how to lead, how to be a teammate, how to communicate.

author: George Washington
text: Discipline is the soul of an army. It makes small numbers formidable; procures success to the weak, and esteem to all.

author: Gustave Flaubert
text: The most glorious moments in your life are not the so-called days of success, but rather those days when out of dejection and despair you feel rise in you a challenge to life, and the promise of future accomplishments.

author: Marvin Sapp
text: A friend of mine said something powerful at his grandfather's funeral. He said that the greatest lesson from his grandfather's life was that he died empty, because he accomplished everything he wanted, with no regrets. I think that, along with leaving a legacy, would be the greatest sign of success.

author: Patrick Henry
text: Do you remember any instance where tyranny was destroyed and freedom established on its ruins, among a people possessing so small a share of virtue and public spirit? I recollect none, and this more than the British arms makes me fearful of final success, without a reform.

author: Rafe Spall
text: Being kind is the most important thing I've ever been taught. That's what my parents always told me - more important than ambition or success is being kind to people. The cornerstone of my life. What I aspire to is to be kind.

author: Myles Munroe
text: You weren't born just to live a life and to die; you were born to accomplish something specifically. Matter of fact, success is making it to the end of your purpose; that is success... Success is not just existing. Success is making it to the end of why you were born.

author: Johnny Depp
text: You grow up a bit damaged or broken then you have some success but you don't know how to feel good about the work you're doing or the life you're leading.

author: River Phoenix
text: We are taught to consume. And that's what we do. But if we realized that there really is no reason to consume, that it's just a mind set, that it's just an addiction, then we wouldn't be out there stepping on people's hands climbing the corporate ladder of success.

author: Cyril Connolly
text: The secret of success is to be in harmony with existence, to be always calm to let each wave of life wash us a little farther up the shore.

author: Ben Stein
text: Personal relationships are the fertile soil from which all advancement, all success, all achievement in real life grows.

author: Walter Scott
text: Success - keeping your mind awake and your desire asleep.

author: Denis Waitley
text: Our limitations and success will be based, most often, on your own expectations for ourselves. What the mind dwells upon, the body acts upon.

author: Marcus Garvey
text: There is no force like success, and that is why the individual makes all effort to surround himself throughout life with the evidence of it; as of the individual, so should it be of the nation.

author: Benjamin Disraeli
text: One secret of success in life is for a man to be ready for his opportunity when it comes.

author: Booker T. Washington
text: I have learned that success is to be measured not so much by the position that one has reached in life as by the obstacles which he has had to overcome while trying to succeed.

author: Christopher Morley
text: There is only one success - to be able to spend your life in your own way.

author: Lydia M. Child
text: Belief in oneself is one of the most important bricks in building any successful venture.

author: Sigmund Freud
text: If a man has been his mother's undisputed darling he retains throughout life the triumphant feeling, the confidence in success, which not seldom brings actual success along with it.

author: Ricky Williams
text: There's more to life than success, and if you can try to be more well-rounded, you'll be able to enjoy your success more. It won't own you or control you.

author: Yann Arthus-Bertrand
text: To have success in your professional life is not so hard. To succeed as a man is more difficult.

author: Celine Dion
text: The hardest thing to find in life is balance - especially, the more success you have, the more you look to the other side of the gate.

author: Henry Cloud
text: We know from research that growth is actually contagious, so if you want to reach your goals, you've got to get around people that are going in the same direction you want to be going, and you will catch the success.

author: Walter Pater
text: To burn always with this hard, gem-like flame, to maintain this ecstasy, is success in life.

author: Democritus
text: Raising children is an uncertain thing success is reached only after a life of battle and worry.

author: William J. H. Boetcker
text: Never mind what others do; do better than yourself, beat your own record from day to day, and you are a success.

author: Meg Whitman
text: You look at the tremendous success of Facebook. To my mind there is not a lot of commerce going on in these social networking sites. eBay is a community anchored in commerce. It is a commerce site that built a community around it. What has not been proven is if the reverse can happen and people will go to community sites to do commerce.

author: Bob Riley
text: No skill shapes a child's future success in school or in life more than the ability to read.

author: Herbert Spencer
text: People are beginning to see that the first requisite to success in life is to be a good animal.

author: Danny Thomas
text: Success has nothing to do with what you gain in life or accomplish for yourself. It's what you do for others.

author: Lindsey Wixson
text: Real success is not, like, materialistic. It's being where you want to be when you want to be; just living your life how you feel; having an ultimate goal and being able to accomplish it.

author: Jean-Claude Van Damme
text: I came to America with a dream and I made it. The dream became reality. America is built for success.

author: Alex Noble
text: Success is a process, a quality of mind and way of being, an outgoing affirmation of life.

author: Ewan McGregor
text: Success is tricky to deal with, both professionally and in your personal life.

author: Sting
text: One of the rewards of success is freedom, the ability to do whatever you like.

author: Edward de Bono
text: To be successful you have to be lucky, or a little mad, or very talented, or find yourself in a rapid growth field.

author: Celine Dion
text: The hardest thing to find in life is balance - especially the more success you have, the more you look to the other side of the gate. What do I need to stay grounded, in touch, in love, connected, emotionally balanced? Look within yourself.

author: Henry Wadsworth Longfellow
text: The talent of success is nothing more than doing what you can do well, and doing well whatever you do without thought of fame. If it comes at all it will come because it is deserved, not because it is sought after.

author: Richard Lugar
text: If I could offer but one helpful hint to young Hoosiers hoping to better their odds for success in life, I would simply note the importance of thoughtful reading.

author: John Madden
text: The only yardstick for success our society has is being a champion. No one remembers anything else.

author: Treat Williams
text: I define success as being comfortable with yourself and your life. And that is about as good as it gets, really.

author: Don Johnson
text: I am stable when my private life is a success.

author: Charles J. Givens
text: Achieve success in any area of life by identifying the optimum strategies and repeating them until they become habits.

author: Al Capp
text: Success is following the pattern of life one enjoys most.

author: Oprah Winfrey
text: What material success does is provide you with the ability to concentrate on other things that really matter. And that is being able to make a difference, not only in your own life, but in other people's lives.

author: Knute Rockne
text: Four years of football are calculated to breed in the average man more of the ingredients of success in life than almost any academic course he takes.

author: Danny Thomas
text: All of us are born for a reason, but all of us don't discover why. Success in life has nothing to do with what you gain in life or accomplish for yourself. It's what you do for others.

author: Jessica Savitch
text: I worked half my life to be an overnight success, and still it took me by surprise.

author: Andrew Carnegie
text: Think of yourself as on the threshold of unparalleled success. A whole, clear, glorious life lies before you. Achieve! Achieve!

author: Allan Houston
text: Success isn't always going to be a huge contract success is going to be if you just live out your purpose in life.

author: Elizabeth Gilbert
text: My career started young and I was really ambitious, and then I had success and I hung out with people who were much older. I think I might have been temporally misplaced, so I thought I was 40. It was a premature midlife crisis.

author: Mitt Romney
text: Our worldly successes cannot be guaranteed, but our ability to achieve spiritual success is entirely up to us, thanks to the grace of God. The best advice I know is to give is to give those worldly things your best but never your all - reserve the ultimate hope for the only one who can grant it.

author: Bruce Springsteen
text: Your success story is a bigger story than whatever you're trying to say on stage. Success makes life easier. It doesn't make living easier.

author: Juliana Hatfield
text: If you want to achieve things in life, you've just got to do them, and if you're talented and smart, you'll succeed.

author: Albert Schweitzer
text: A great secret of success is to go through life as a man who never gets used up.

author: Jada Pinkett Smith
text: I'm extremely ambitious. I don't know why people are afraid to say that. I won't sell my soul to the devil, but I do want success and I don't think that's bad.

author: Logan Pearsall Smith
text: How can they say my life is not a success? Have I not for more than sixty years got enough to eat and escaped being eaten?

author: Carrot Top
text: It's our nature: Human beings like success but they hate successful people.

author: Andrew Stanton
text: I'm still craving approval from my parents. It took a lot of success for me to realize it was never coming. It's just not in their nature.

author: Bill Kurtis
text: Choose something you like to do. I know it's a cliche, and you've heard it over and over. But the reason is, you're going to have to work long and hard to achieve any success. You better like it or life is going to be terrible.

author: Danny Glover
text: Every day of my life I walk with the idea that I am black, no matter how successful I am. And our success is tempered by that; you're successful in this way given the fact you are black, and most blacks don't get to that point.

author: Robert Frost
text: Poetry is when an emotion has found its thought and the thought has found words.

author: T. S. Eliot
text: As things are, and as fundamentally they must always be, poetry is not a career, but a mug's game. No honest poet can ever feel quite sure of the permanent value of what he has written: He may have wasted his time and messed up his life for nothing.

author: Carol Ann Duffy
text: You can find poetry in your everyday life, your memory, in what people say on the bus, in the news, or just what's in your heart.

author: Rainer Maria Rilke
text: If your daily life seems poor, do not blame it; blame yourself that you are not poet enough to call forth its riches; for the Creator, there is no poverty.

author: Steven Wright
text: I was reading the dictionary. I thought it was a poem about everything.

author: B. B. King
text: Cotton was a force of nature. There's a poetry to it, hoeing and growing cotton.

author: Edward Hirsch
text: Daydreaming is one of the key sources of poetry - a poem often starts as a daydream that finds its way into language - and walking seems to bring a different sort of alertness, an associative kind of thinking, a drifting state of mind.

author: Allen Ginsberg
text: Poetry is the one place where people can speak their original human mind. It is the outlet for people to say in public what is known in private.

author: Edmund Burke
text: Poetry is the art of substantiating shadows, and of lending existence to nothing.

author: Wislawa Szymborska
text: I cannot speak for more than an hour exclusively about poetry. At that point, life itself takes over again.

author: William Rose Benet
text: Who writes poetry imbibes honey from the poisoned lips of life.

author: George Sand
text: He who draws noble delights from sentiments of poetry is a true poet, though he has never written a line in all his life.

author: Eavan Boland
text: Poetry begins where language starts: in the shadows and accidents of one person's life.

author: John Singer Sargent
text: It is certain that at certain times talent entirely overcomes thought or poetry.

author: Alice Oswald
text: I think it's often assumed that the role of poetry is to comfort, but for me, poetry is the great unsettler. It questions the established order of the mind. It is radical, by which I don't mean that it is either leftwing or rightwing, but that it works at the roots of thinking.

author: Seamus Heaney
text: If poetry and the arts do anything, they can fortify your inner life, your inwardness.

author: Jim Harrison
text: Poetry, at its best, is the language your soul would speak if you could teach your soul to speak.

author: William Hazlitt
text: Poetry is the universal language which the heart holds with nature and itself. He who has a contempt for poetry, cannot have much respect for himself, or for anything else.

author: Charles Bukowski
text: What my character is or how many jails I have lounged in, or wards or walls or wassails, how many lonely-heart poetry readings I have dodged, is beside the point. A man's soul or lack of it will be evident with what he can carve upon a white sheet of paper.

author: Mary Oliver
text: Poetry isn't a profession, it's a way of life. It's an empty basket; you put your life into it and make something out of that.

author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
text: Superstition is the poetry of life.

author: George Will
text: There may be more poetry than justice in poetic justice.

author: Robert Hass
text: I think that the job of poetry, its political job, is to refresh the idea of justice, which is going dead in us all the time.

author: James Laughlin
text: Of course a poem is a two-way street. No poem is any good if it doesn't suggest to the reader things from his own mind and recollection that he will read into it, and will add to what the poet has suggested. But I do think poetry readings are very important.

author: Azar Nafisi
text: I see people who talk about America, and then undermine it by not paying attention to its soul, to its poetry. I see polarization, reductionism and superficiality.

author: Aristotle
text: Hence poetry is something more philosophic and of graver import than history, since its statements are rather of the nature of universals, whereas those of history are singulars.

author: Richard Dawkins
text: The Bible should be taught, but emphatically not as reality. It is fiction, myth, poetry, anything but reality. As such it needs to be taught because it underlies so much of our literature and our culture.

author: Victor Hugo
text: Verse in itself does not constitute poetry. Verse is only an elegant vestment for a beautiful form. Poetry can express itself in prose, but it does so more perfectly under the grace and majesty of verse. It is poetry of soul that inspires noble sentiments and noble actions as well as noble writings.

author: Billy Collins
text: Often people, when they're confronted with a poem, it's like someone who keep saying 'what is the meaning of this? What is the meaning of this?' And that dulls us to the other pleasures poetry offers.

author: Henry David Thoreau
text: I think that there is nothing, not even crime, more opposed to poetry, to philosophy, ay, to life itself than this incessant business.

author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
text: Science arose from poetry... when times change the two can meet again on a higher level as friends.

author: Patti Smith
text: When I was younger, I felt it was my duty to wake people up. I thought poetry was asleep. I thought rock 'n' roll was asleep.

author: Cory Booker
text: The fact that Newark is having poetry festivals and peace conferences - all of these things are building an undeniable thesis that our city is making incredible strides forward.

author: Michael Leunig
text: Existential philosophy, poetry and art - just like sadness - were all unavoidable to a tender young man in the meat works.

author: Margaret Atwood
text: I don't think of poetry as a 'rational' activity but as an aural one. My poems usually begin with words or phrases which appeal more because of their sound than their meaning, and the movement and phrasing of a poem are very important to me.

author: Joseph Brodsky
text: Poetry is rather an approach to things, to life, than it is typographical production.

author: Joseph Brodsky
text: The charge frequently leveled against poetry - that it is difficult, obscure, hermetic and whatnot - indicates not the state of poetry but, frankly, the rung of the evolutionary ladder on which society is stuck.

author: Sebastian Thrun
text: In much of computer science, I can easily 'auto-grade' your work and give you an instant meaningful feedback. I can't do this when it comes to the subtlety of human thought, language, poetry, philosophy.

author: William Hazlitt
text: Poetry is all that is worth remembering in life.

author: John Ruskin
text: The greatest thing a human soul ever does in this world... to see clearly is poetry, prophecy and religion all in one.

author: Seamus Heaney
text: The fact of the matter is that the most unexpected and miraculous thing in my life was the arrival in it of poetry itself - as a vocation and an elevation almost.

author: Francois Nars
text: It's more fun to have a name rather than a number. I think this gives our products a personality. I get the names from literature, movies, opera, traveling, nature, poetry, sometimes even the street. I keep a small book that I write in. I wake up in the middle of the night and jot down a name for a lipstick or an eyeshadow.

author: Leonard Cohen
text: I always thought that poetry is the verdict that others give to a certain kind of writing. So to call yourself a poet is a kind of dangerous description. It's for others it's for others to use.

author: Paul Auster
text: I started out in life as a poet; I was only writing poetry all through my 20s. It wasn't until I was about 30 that I got serious about writing prose. While I was writing poems, I would often divert myself by reading detective novels; I liked them.

author: Jewel
text: I've always had a love for poetry and when I got signed to a record label I thought, 'How odd that I'm doing a record before a book of poetry,'

author: Michael Franti
text: Every single soul is a poem.

author: Karl Wilhelm Friedrich Schlegel
text: One has only as much morality as one has philosophy and poetry.

author: Karl Wilhelm Friedrich Schlegel
text: Women are treated as unjustly in poetry as in life. The feminine ones are not idealistic, and the idealistic not feminine.

author: Felix Dennis
text: I am absolutely convinced that my life was redeemed by poetry.

author: Octavio Paz
text: Poetry is not a genre in harmony with the modern world; its innermost nature is hostile or indifferent to the dogmas of modern times, progress and the cult of the future.

author: Octavio Paz
text: Poetry, whatever the manifest content of the poem, is always a violation of the rationalism and morality of bourgeois society.

author: Octavio Paz
text: Any reflection about poetry should begin, or end, with this question: who and how many read poetry books?

author: Mohsin Hamid
text: Sufi poetry is, in a sense, self-help poetry about how to live a decent life, how to deal with your mortality.

author: Ellen Key
text: For thousands of years, poetry has been picturing love as a mysterious and tragic power. But when anyone says the same thing in plain prose, and adds that life would be colourless and poor without the great passions, then this is called immorality!

author: Erica Jong
text: Poetry is what we turn to in the most emotional moments of our life - when a beloved friend dies, when a baby is born or when we fall in love.

author: Erica Jong
text: I thought to spend my declining years writing poetry and teaching - but that won't pay the Bergdorf's bill. I think I'll move to somewhere life is cheaper.

author: Erica Jong
text: Often I find that poems predict what I'm going to do later in my own writing, and often I find that poems predict my life. So I think poetry is the most intense expression of feeling that we have.

author: Edward Hirsch
text: I'm a poet, and I spent my life in poetry.

author: Edward Hirsch
text: Someone who's awake in the middle of the night is a soul consciousness when everyone else is asleep, and that creates a feeling of solitude in poetry that I very much like.

author: Edward Hirsch
text: The idea of how to read a poem is based on the idea that poetry needs you as a reader. That the experience of poetry, the meaning in poetry, is a kind of circuit that takes place between a poet, a poem and a reader, and that meaning doesn't exist or inhere in poems alone.

author: Edward Hirsch
text: I had feelings that I didn't know what to do with, and I felt better when I started writing them. I thought of it as poetry. I did notice girls really liked it. Better than football. They liked the combination.

author: Edward Hirsch
text: I didn't read poetry seriously until college, when I really began to devour it in a very intense way. I also discovered that a poet is a maker. Before that, I thought a poet was someone who wrote about his own experiences.

author: Edward Hirsch
text: Writing poetry is such an intense experience that it helps to start the process in a casual or wayward frame of mind.

author: James Russell Lowell
text: Poetry is something to make us wiser and better, by continually revealing those types of beauty and truth, which God has set in all men's souls.

author: Claire Tomalin
text: Poetry was one of the things that interested me most as I was growing up. I used to write it in my head all the time. I still think the very greatest pleasure in life is to write a poem.

author: Donald Hall
text: For better or worse, poetry is my life.

author: Donald Hall
text: Poetry is what I've done my whole life. And every important thing in my life had found itself into poems.

author: Donald Hall
text: In my life, I've seen enormous increase in the consumption of poetry. When I was young, there were virtually no poetry readings.

author: Simon Schama
text: History gives you insight of the same quality of truth as poetry or philosophy or a novel.

author: Simon Schama
text: Somehow, the words don't have any vitality, any life to them, unless I can feel it marking on a paper. That's how I start. Once I'm off, then I switch to the laptop. I think it would all just be prose if it started on a laptop - not that what I do is poetry.

author: Simon Schama
text: The difficulty with poetry is that it doesn't have the life that Shakespeare or Jane Austen have beyond the page. You can't make a costume drama out of it. There's no place for it to go except trapped inside its little book.

author: Rita Dove
text: I think one of the things that people tend to forget is that poets do write out of life. It isn't some set piece that then gets put up on the shelf, but that the impetus, the real instigation for poetry is everything that's happening around us.

author: W. Bruce Cameron
text: Not too many people know it, but when I was in junior high, I was a pretty tough kid and was the leader of a street gang. Well, OK, it was less a street gang than an Ecology Club. We were pretty intimidating, though, and had our own meeting room until we got run out of there by a bunch of thugs from the Poetry Society.

author: Natasha Trethewey
text: Even though I am the daughter of a poet, and my stepmother is also a poet, growing up, I didn't think I could understand poetry; I didn't think that it had any relevance to my life, the feelings that I endured on a day-to-day basis, until I was introduced to the right poem.

author: Vikram Seth
text: I spent many years of my life as an economist and demographer. I was finally distracted by writing my novels and poetry. I'm enormously happy that was the case. I feel that with writing I have found my metier.

author: Vikram Seth
text: Everyone sort of sees his own life and times as being ephemeral. One thinks that everything good or important that happened, happened in the past. But I think that seeing scenes that you are used to, but with the heightening effects of poetry, perhaps makes you value your life and times more than you might otherwise do.

author: Mary Quant
text: The Lord's Prayer is the most perfect piece of poetry. I always feel at peace and moved when I recite it.

author: Eileen Myles
text: In Arlington, people would laugh at you if you tried to get people to look at your drawings or listen to your poetry. It was like you thought you were special.

author: Pawel Pawlikowski
text: I lived a pretty chaotic life. I went to England, and I moved around, and there were a lot of things that I was interested in. I wrote poetry. I took photographs. I was a musician and all sorts of things. Nothing brilliant, but I did all these different things.

author: Thomas Babington Macaulay
text: Perhaps no person can be a poet, or even enjoy poetry, without a certain unsoundness of mind.

author: David Whyte
text: Poetry is often the art of overhearing yourself say things you didn't know you knew. It is a learned skill to force yourself to articulate your life, your present world or your possibilities for the future.

author: David Whyte
text: By definition, poetry works with qualities and dynamics that mainstream society is reluctant to face head-on. It's an interesting phenomenon that by necessity, poetry is just below the radar.

author: David Whyte
text: It is the province of poetry to be more realistic and present than the artificial narratives of an outer discourse, and not afraid of the truthful difficulty of the average human life.

author: David Whyte
text: Poetry carries the imagery which is large enough for the kind of life we want for ourselves.

author: Feisal Abdul Rauf
text: I read, read enormously on all different fields of Islamic thought, from philosophy to Islamic literature, poetry, exegeses, knowledge of the Hadith, the teachings of the prophet. That's how I trained myself. And then I was appointed imam by a Sufi master from Istanbul, Turkey.

author: Ben Okri
text: I'm conscious of a series of circles working its way through my life. And at this particular moment I have come round to the beginning of my writing cycle. It begins with poetry. There's hardly a day that goes past on which I don't write poetry.

author: Ben Okri
text: I began my writing life as a poet, so poetry has always been fundamental. I evolved from poetry to journalism to stories to novels. But poetry was always there.

author: Jonathan Galassi
text: Poetry is not mainstream, but then neither is serious fiction, really. But I don't think there's a lot to worry about in this particular 'problem'. Why does art have to be mainstream to be significant?

author: Tahar Ben Jelloun
text: For me, poetry is a situation - a state of being, a way of facing life and facing history.

author: Andrew Motion
text: Poetry is at the centre of my life, too, emotionally speaking, and intellectually speaking - it's just that I'm one of those people who enjoy doing other stuff as well.

author: Andrew Motion
text: I wish I'd been better able to resist the sense of obligation to write some of the poems I did. It's in the nature of commissioned work to be written too much from the side of your mind that knows what it's doing, which dries up the poetry.

author: Judith Viorst
text: I always credited my mother with inspiring me to be a writer because she was such a passionate reader. She read poetry to me as a child. But rather late in life, I've come to appreciate my father, the accountant. He was a solid, organized, get-the-job-done kind of person-and you need that piece of it to be a writer, too.

author: Bernardo Bertolucci
text: I accept all interpretations of my films. The only reality is before the camera. Each film I make is kind of a return to poetry for me, or at least an attempt to create a poem.

author: Wallace Stevens
text: Everything is complicated; if that were not so, life and poetry and everything else would be a bore.

author: Susan Vreeland
text: To me, art begets art. Painting feeds the eye just as poetry feeds the ear, which is to say that both feed the soul.

author: Saul Williams
text: I was always making up rhymes. But I never thought that poetry would become my life.

author: Walter Pater
text: That sense of a life in natural objects, which in most poetry is but a rhetorical artifice, was, then, in Wordsworth the assertion of what was for him almost literal fact.

author: Eavan Boland
text: I didn't know how to weigh ideas about poetry. Nothing in the life I lived as a student - and later as wife and mother at the suburban edge of Dublin - suggested I had the wherewithal to do so. But I did have a unit of measurement. It was the measure of my own life.

author: Mark Strand
text: Usually a life turned into a poem is misrepresented.

author: Charles Olson
text: You don't help people in your poems. I've been trying to help people all my life - that's my trouble.

author: June Jordan
text: The first function of poetry is to tell the truth, to learn how to do that, to find out what you really feel and what you really think.

author: John Ciardi
text: Poetry lies its way to the truth.

author: A. E. Housman
text: Even when poetry has a meaning, as it usually has, it may be inadvisable to draw it out... Perfect understanding will sometimes almost extinguish pleasure.

author: Edith Sitwell
text: Poetry is the deification of reality.

author: Laura Riding
text: To a poet the mere making of a poem can seem to solve the problem of truth, but only a problem of art is solved in poetry.

author: Laura Riding
text: The end of poetry is not to create a physical condition which shall give pleasure to the mind... The end of poetry is not an after-effect, not a pleasurable memory of itself, but an immediate, constant and even unpleasant insistence upon itself.

author: Tomas Transtromer
text: Society's dark hull drifts further and further away. It is this place - the place of our separation, our distinction - that much of his poetry occupies.

author: Francisco Goya
text: Painting (like poetry) chooses from universals what is most apposite. It brings together, in a single imaginary being, circumstances and characteristics which occur in nature in many different persons.

author: Georges Braque
text: Reality only reveals itself when it is illuminated by a ray of poetry.

author: Robert Penn Warren
text: How do poems grow? They grow out of your life.

author: Robert Penn Warren
text: The poem is a little myth of man's capacity of making life meaningful. And in the end, the poem is not a thing we see-it is, rather, a light by which we may see-and what we see is life.

author: Norman O. Brown
text: Freedom is poetry, taking liberties with words, breaking the rules of normal speech, violating common sense. Freedom is violence.

author: John Ashbery
text: There is the view that poetry should improve your life. I think people confuse it with the Salvation Army.

author: Frederick Douglass
text: Those who profess to favor freedom, and yet depreciate agitation, are men who want crops without plowing up the ground.

author: Felix Adler
text: The hero is one who kindles a great light in the world, who sets up blazing torches in the dark streets of life for men to see by.

author: Samuel Adams
text: It does not take a majority to prevail... but rather an irate, tireless minority, keen on setting brushfires of freedom in the minds of men.

author: Ayn Rand
text: Civilization is the progress toward a society of privacy. The savage's whole existence is public, ruled by the laws of his tribe. Civilization is the process of setting man free from men.

author: Henry David Thoreau
text: Every creature is better alive than dead, men and moose and pine trees, and he who understands it aright will rather preserve its life than destroy it.

author: Thomas Paine
text: Those who expect to reap the blessings of freedom must, like men, undergo the fatigue of supporting it.

author: Bayard Rustin
text: If we desire a society in which men are brothers, then we must act towards one another with brotherhood. If we can build such a society, then we would have achieved the ultimate goal of human freedom.

author: John F. Kennedy
text: All free men, wherever they may live, are citizens of Berlin. And therefore, as a free man, I take pride in the words 'Ich bin ein Berliner!'

author: John Locke
text: The reason why men enter into society is the preservation of their property.

author: Nicholas II of Russia
text: There is no justice among men.

author: Georg Wilhelm Friedrich Hegel
text: Mark this well, you proud men of action! you are, after all, nothing but unconscious instruments of the men of thought.

author: W. E. B. Du Bois
text: School houses do not teach themselves - piles of brick and mortar and machinery do not send out men. It is the trained, living human soul, cultivated and strengthened by long study and thought, that breathes the real breath of life into boys and girls and makes them human, whether they be black or white, Greek, Russian or American.

author: Joseph Conrad
text: The belief in a supernatural source of evil is not necessary men alone are quite capable of every wickedness.

author: W. E. B. Du Bois
text: Most men today cannot conceive of a freedom that does not involve somebody's slavery.

author: Tom Wolfe
text: The whole conviction of my life now rests upon the belief that loneliness, far from being a rare and curious phenomenon, peculiar to myself and to a few other solitary men, is the central and inevitable fact of human existence.

author: Henry Wadsworth Longfellow
text: Men of genius are often dull and inert in society; as the blazing meteor, when it descends to earth, is only a stone.

author: H. P. Lovecraft
text: Children will always be afraid of the dark, and men with minds sensitive to hereditary impulse will always tremble at the thought of the hidden and fathomless worlds of strange life which may pulsate in the gulfs beyond the stars, or press hideously upon our own globe in unholy dimensions which only the dead and the moonstruck can glimpse.

author: Albert Schweitzer
text: A man is ethical only when life, as such, is sacred to him, that of plants and animals as that of his fellow men, and when he devotes himself helpfully to all life that is in need of help.

author: Yoko Ono
text: This society is driven by neurotic speed and force accelerated by greed and frustration of not being able to live up to the image of men and woman we have created for ourselves the image has nothing to do with the reality of people.

author: Margaret Thatcher
text: I usually make up my mind about a man in ten seconds, and I very rarely change it.

author: Epicurus
text: There is no such thing as justice in the abstract it is merely a compact between men.

author: Friedrich Nietzsche
text: When a hundred men stand together, each of them loses his mind and gets another one.

author: Friedrich Nietzsche
text: Regarding life, the wisest men of all ages have judged alike: it is worthless.

author: John Milton
text: None can love freedom heartily, but good men; the rest love not freedom, but licence.

author: Frederick Douglass
text: Those who profess to favor freedom, and yet deprecate agitation, are men who want crops without plowing up the ground.

author: Pele
text: I've come to accept that the life of a frontrunner is a hard one, that he will suffer more injuries than most men and that many of these injuries will not be accidental.

author: Geoffrey Chaucer
text: By nature, men love newfangledness.

author: Marcus Tullius Cicero
text: Justice consists in doing no injury to men decency in giving them no offense.

author: Franklin D. Roosevelt
text: The truth is found when men are free to pursue it.

author: Pythagoras
text: As soon as laws are necessary for men, they are no longer fit for freedom.

author: Barack Obama
text: You have young men of color in many communities who are more likely to end up in jail or in the criminal justice system than they are in a good job or in college. And, you know, part of my job, that I can do, I think, without any potential conflicts, is to get at those root causes.

author: Hillary Clinton
text: I don't think feminism, as I understand the definition, implies the rejection of maternal values, nurturing children, caring about the men in your life. That is just nonsense to me.

author: Peter Abelard
text: The men who abandon themselves to the passions of this miserable life, are compared in Scripture to beasts.

author: W. Somerset Maugham
text: Like all weak men he laid an exaggerated stress on not changing one's mind.

author: Erykah Badu
text: It's almost like a lot of black people in America, a lot of young black men, are born with this cloud over their heads. It's their penitentiary cloud, this philosophy we all have, that it's harder for us.

author: William Hazlitt
text: Reflection makes men cowards.

author: Lucius Annaeus Seneca
text: Ignorant people see life as either existence or non-existence, but wise men see it beyond both existence and non-existence to something that transcends them both; this is an observation of the Middle Way.

author: D. H. Lawrence
text: Men are freest when they are most unconscious of freedom. The shout is a rattling of chains, always was.

author: Charles Caleb Colton
text: In life we shall find many men that are great, and some that are good, but very few men that are both great and good.

author: Andre Gide
text: It is easier to lead men to combat, stirring up their passion, than to restrain them and direct them toward the patient labors of peace.

author: Fred Allen
text: Life, in my estimation, is a biological misadventure that we terminate on the shoulders of six strange men whose only objective is to make a hole in one with you.

author: Clifton Fadiman
text: For most men life is a search for the proper manila envelope in which to get themselves filed.

author: Booker T. Washington
text: I shall allow no man to belittle my soul by making me hate him.

author: Bodhidharma
text: The ignorant mind, with its infinite afflictions, passions, and evils, is rooted in the three poisons. Greed, anger, and delusion.

author: Dalai Lama
text: As a human being, anger is a part of our mind. Irritation also part of our mind. But you can do - anger come, go. Never keep in your sort of - your inner world, then create a lot of suspicion, a lot of distrust, a lot of negative things, more worry.

author: Nina Simone
text: You feel the shame, humiliation, and anger at being just another victim of prejudice, and at the same time, there's the nagging worry that maybe... you're just no good.

author: George Herbert
text: Be calm in arguing; for fierceness makes error a fault, and truth discourtesy.

author: Robert Green Ingersoll
text: Anger is a wind which blows out the lamp of the mind.

author: Saint Francis de Sales
text: There was never an angry man that thought his anger unjust.

author: Ben Shapiro
text: President Obama and members of his administration constantly express rage and anger over events totally within their control. It's an odd and unsettling fact of American life that so many Americans seem to think that such expressions of frustration should substitute for actual competence.

author: Marianne Williamson
text: The ego mind both professes its desire for love and does everything possible to repel it, or if it gets here anyway, to sabotage it. That is why dealing with issues like control, anger, and neediness is the most important work in preparing ourselves for love.

author: Nicola Adams
text: Anger is an unnecessary emotion. Loads of stuff in life can trigger it, but what matters is how you react. I choose not to react.

author: Yair Lapid
text: Freedom of expression is tested during times of anger and conflict and enables all opinions and outraged expressions of dissent that we may not want to hear. But even for this there have to be limits.

author: John Dryden
text: Anger will never disappear so long as thoughts of resentment are cherished in the mind. Anger will disappear just as soon as thoughts of resentment are forgotten.

author: Alanis Morissette
text: When I was younger, I was terrified to express anger because it would often kick-start a horrible reaction in the men in my life. So I bit my tongue. I was left to painstakingly deal with the aftermath of my avoidance later in life, in therapy or through the lyrics of my songs.

author: Nagarjuna
text: Although you may spend your life killing, You will not exhaust all your foes. But if you quell your own anger, your real enemy will be slain.

author: Fran Drescher
text: Life is precious and there's not a lot of room for anger.

author: Margot Robbie
text: Being irrational and out of control is what happens in real life. Not cautiously choreographing your anger or your emotions, losing yourself in them is what happens in real life.

author: Gore Vidal
text: I think I have a normal threshold of anger, but it's true that I am, by nature, belligerent.

author: David Horsey
text: Maybe it's stress or anger or adrenaline or disillusionment or a bullying nature or simple fear of getting killed themselves, but there is a problem if a cop cannot tell the difference between a menacing gangster and the far more common person they encounter whose life is a little frayed and messy.

author: W. Somerset Maugham
text: The world in general doesn't know what to make of originality; it is startled out of its comfortable habits of thought, and its first reaction is one of anger.

author: Jakob Bohme
text: Christ hath instituted Baptism as a bath, to wash away the anger, and hath put into us the Noble Stone, viz. the water of eternal life, for an earnest-penny, so that instantly in our childhood we might be able to escape the wrath.

author: Clare Short
text: That feeds anger, and I mean when we went and at last thank heavens got towards peace in Northern Ireland we went for justice within Northern Ireland as well as using security well, as well as a political settlement, but surely that is the lesson.

author: Jack Henry Abbott
text: Imagine a thousand more such daily intrusions in your life, every hour and minute of every day, and you can grasp the source of this paranoia, this anger that could consume me at any moment if I lost control.

author: Richard Savage
text: When anger rushes unrestrained to action, like a hot steed, it stumbles on its way. The man of thought strikes deepest and strikes safely.

author: P. J. O'Rourke
text: In Israel, waves of anger and fear circulate all the time, but so do jokes and gossip and silky evening breezes. So, too, in America.

author: Alanis Morissette
text: My own approach has always been to push intense emotions down and attempt to deal with them later. When I was younger, I was terrified to express anger because it would often kick-start a horrible reaction in the men in my life.

author: Chris Cornell
text: The sense of anger I had when I was younger is something I thought would never go away. Over time, it's something you get almost bored with.

author: Nancy Gibbs
text: Emotional life grows out of an area of the brain called the limbic system, specifically the amygdala, whence come delight and disgust and fear and anger.

author: Ovid
text: Fair peace becomes men ferocious anger belongs to beasts.

author: Jesse Jackson
text: Many are observing Ferguson and witnessing the anger, demonstrations, looting and vandalism and calling for quiet. But quiet isn't enough. The absence of noise isn't the presence of justice - and we must demand justice in Ferguson and the other 'Fergusons' around America.

author: Sam Shepard
text: My father had a real short fuse. He had a tough life - had to support his mother and brother at a very young age when his dad's farm collapsed. You could see his suffering, his terrible suffering, living a life that was disappointing and looking for another one. My father was full of terrifying anger.

author: Ellie Goulding
text: It's usually a big kind of vent of frustration or anger or sadness that puts me in the right frame of mind to write. It's such a cliche to say that artists write when they're down, but it's true for me. It's a relief to get out what's eating away at my heart or my soul or my head.

author: Deborah Tannen
text: Conversations with sisters can spark extremes of anger or extremes of love. Everything said between sisters carries meaning not only from what was just said but from all the conversations that came before - and 'before' can span a lifetime. The layers of meaning combine profound connection with equally profound competition.

author: David Lynch
text: A lot of artists think they want anger. But a real, strong, bitter anger occupies the mind, leaving no room for creativity.

author: Karen Salmansohn
text: Basically, it's in your best mental interest to release your anger so you can see the world more clearly around you and seek better solutions for finding the happy, love-filled life you desire and deserve.

author: Mother Angelica
text: When anyone arouses my anger, I will immediately pray for them and regain my peace of soul.

author: Bill Flores
text: We do have our challenges. Some things don't always work right in Washington, and the anger you see from the electorate, I think, is a reflection of what's not working right.

author: Mike Nichols
text: I asked a shrink: 'Everything is so great. Why am I still so angry?' He said, 'Anger doesn't go away.' I always thought it was kind of a good engine.

author: Fiona Apple
text: My whole life, people have been saying, Why are you so angry?

author: Marlee Matlin
text: I want roles without anger and feistiness. I want to show weakness and sadness, some love, some happiness.

author: Martina Navratilova
text: I am just sorry my own mother had to live under that regime for most of her life. I was lucky. I got out and, 14 years later, Czechoslovakia became a free country. So I feel anger, even fury, at this bloody system that ruined so many people's lives for no reason whatsoever.

author: Grace Slick
text: When you learn that a truth is a lie, anger follows.

author: Jacqueline Bisset
text: At the time, 1980, people regarded actresses involved with production with a certain amount of fear, resentment and anger.

author: Jessica Lange
text: All through life I've harbored anger rather than expressed it at the moment.

author: Taya Kyle
text: Many of us who have cars have felt some form of extreme anger at other drivers because we feel they have put us in harm's way. We might even envision ramming their cars or cutting them off in return, but do we actually do it? No, because the overwhelming majority of us never want to take another human life.

author: Park Chan-wook
text: I guess I probably make violent films partly because I can't express my anger in my real life very well.

author: Peter Navarro
text: It's that evil twin part of me that always comes out at the absolute wrong political moment, like a demon possessing my soul; it exhibits itself as an arrogance or disdain or obnoxiousness or meanness or anger or pettiness - all traits that are lethal in politics.

author: Pamela Meyer
text: Contempt is the only asymmetrical expression in the muscular facial system: Disgust, fear, happiness, surprise and anger typically express themselves symmetrically. Contempt is marked by one lip corner pulled up and in a dismissive sneer.

author: Kevin Rudd
text: Something my mum taught me years and years and years ago, is life's just too short to carry around a great bucket-load of anger and resentment and bitterness and hatreds and all that sort of stuff.

author: Rowan Williams
text: Quite a lot of our contemporary culture is actually shot through with a resentment of limits and the passage of time, anger at what we can't do, fear or even disgust at growing old.

author: Jessye Norman
text: There's no anger ever in a spiritual. There's always the dream of a hope of a better day coming. That God understands the troubles that I'm experiencing.

author: Ann Nocenti
text: Green Arrow has gone through so many changes; he's been right-wing, he's been left-wing, he's been rich, he's been poor, he's been a social justice guy, then when I got him, he was a rich playboy guy. So it was a lot harder to get into a character that has so many personas in the past, and I just looked at his anger.

author: Clive Sinclair
text: Tel Aviv is buzzing with so much life, you could bottle it and sell it as honey, and even Jerusalem has a certain fizz. But if you want to see anger, go to Sheikh Jarrah in East Jerusalem on a Friday afternoon.

author: Adam Hamilton
text: I think anger is a normal response to something horrible that someone has done, another human being has done, and to rob people of life, and that's actually healthy to have, to feel that. At some point you have to figure out, 'How do I let that go?'

author: Jakob Bohme
text: God's love-eye does not see essentially into the wicked rebellious apostate soul; neither also into the devil, but his anger-eye sees thereinto; that is, God, according to the property of the anger or fire of wrath, sees in the devil, and in the false soul.

author: Jakob Bohme
text: We are children of the eternity: But this world is an out-birth out of the eternal and its palpability taketh its original in the anger the eternal nature is its root.

author: Mark Kirk
text: I would say that I definitely became much more religious. They say there are no atheists in foxholes, and this stroke put me into a very deep foxhole. Yet that feeling of faith sustained me, so I have no feelings of anger or regret.

author: Dave Mustaine
text: I guess because I had such a horrible life growing up, going from place to place not knowing what I was gonna do and ending up being homeless, there was a lot of pain and a lot of anger that was coming out through my guitar playing.

author: Eduard Shevardnadze
text: But on second thought, after I decreed the state of emergency, I came to the conclusion that that was impossible to achieve without bloodshed because the street protesters were full of anger and nearly out of control. This is why I thought we needed to find another way out.

author: Luke Ford
text: Acting in anger and hatred throughout my life, I frequently precipitated what I feared most, the loss of friendships and the need to rely upon the very people I'd abused.

author: Betty Williams
text: The thing that started the peace movement in Ireland was anger - my anger. It wasn't anger it was fury.

author: Clare Short
text: And we know there has been horrendous loss of life and suffering and we know that there is anger. Anyone who came anywhere near the general election in constituencies with a substantial Muslim population knows that.

author: Seymour Cassel
text: If you're an actor, and you're selfish and not strong, it's difficult to maintain a good personal life or a solid career, and I was selfish and had a lot of anger that went way back.

author: Daniela Bobadilla
text: I feel like everything comes into your life for a reason. With 'Awake,' I got to do a drama, and with 'Anger Management,' that's my comedy.

author: Laurence Yep
text: As a child growing up in San Francisco in the 1950s, I sometimes met insults when I ventured outside of Chinatown or my neighborhood. I have even been spat on and threatened with a knife. I could have let my anger fester until it became hate. However, I realized they were isolated incidents, and I simply got on with my life.

author: Seth Meyers
text: The nice thing about anger is that, as an emotion, it's strong enough to unplug me from the comedian's mind for a minute and just be a frustrated member of the citizenry.

author: Lucy Alibar
text: It absolutely helped - to write the father in both 'Juicy' and 'Beasts,' I had to see the whole story from his point of view. All of a sudden I understood more of what my own father must be going through - the fear, the frustration, the anger... the hope that he'll leave a legacy.

author: Alan Bleasdale
text: There is not in nature, a thing that makes man so deformed, so beastly, as doth intemperate anger.

author: Adam Sedgwick
text: As a system of philosophy it is not like the Tower of Babel, so daring its high aim as to seek a shelter against God's anger; but it is like a pyramid poised on its apex.

author: Wilhelm von Humboldt
text: True enjoyment comes from activity of the mind and exercise of the body the two are ever united.

author: Matt McGorry
text: The mind is the most important part of achieving any fitness goal. Mental change always comes before physical change.

author: Jean-Jacques Rousseau
text: A feeble body weakens the mind.

author: Joe Rogan
text: As a longtime practitioner of yoga and a person who's been involved in physical fitness my whole life, I can tell you, yoga helps you achieve altered states of consciousness. It is not just stretching. The only way you can say that it's stretching is if you haven't done it, or that you haven't done it rigorously for a long period of time.

author: Martina Hingis
text: I didn't have the same fitness or ability as the other girls, so I had to beat them with my mind.

author: Jackie Joyner-Kersee
text: Teaching kids about health and fitness is important to me. It's about being fit for life.

author: Stone Gossard
text: I think if you exercise, your state of mind - my state of mind - is usually more at ease, ready for more mental challenges. Once I get the physical stuff out of the way it always seems like I have more calmness and better self-esteem.

author: Ziggy Marley
text: Fitness has always been one of the top priorities in my life because that's the way I grew up, with soccer being the sport of choice.

author: William Graham Sumner
text: A drunkard in the gutter is just where he ought to be, according to the fitness and tendency of things. Nature has set upon him the process of decline and dissolution by which she removes things which have survived their usefulness.

author: Alison Sweeney
text: What's wrong with extreme dieting and hard-core fitness plans is that they don't take into account the rest of your life.

author: Joe Taslim
text: Doing nothing would stress me out. So I am still pretty much active practicing judo with my friends, who are former judo athletes, to maintain our fitness as well as the friendships among us. In my spare time, I usually go jogging around the Gelora Bung Karno stadium or head to the gym.

author: Greg Rutherford
text: People assume that you need to run fast to get to optimum fitness, but the truth is endurance lifting makes you stronger and leaner.

author: Goldie Hawn
text: Being a dancer is my metaphor for life because you have to know your body. Being a dancer and paying attention to fitness is all about moving in balance.

author: Sissy Spacek
text: I've been into exercise my whole life, been a runner and been into health and fitness always.

author: George Foreman
text: I tell my sons all the time, 'The most important thing in your life is fitness,' but a lot of fighters go overboard.

author: Richard C. Armitage
text: I try to keep at a non-obsessive level of fitness. It's not about looking great, it's about just feeling good. So I do a lot of yoga. Bikram just blows my mind. It's mental as well as physical; if I don't train, I get very depressed.

author: Cindy Crawford
text: Obviously, your family life is the priority, but there's still other stuff you have to get done in a day. I think the way I make it work is by taking care of myself, and that includes fitness and eating right and all those things, but also by being very organized and punctual.

author: Lee Haney
text: As the proud father of two teens and past Chairman to the Presidents Council on Physical Fitness and Sports, I am committed to educating parents and especially young people on ways to live a long, healthy and active life.

author: Jessica Capshaw
text: I'm very active when I'm not pregnant, but I think fitness should be a natural part of your life, not something you have to force yourself to do.

author: Karisma Kapoor
text: I think I have just evolved as a person, as a human being. I like fitness. It's an important part of my everyday life, and I enjoy and endorse a healthy lifestyle.

author: Michelle Ryan
text: When I left EastEnders, I could have earned an absolute fortune from sexy calendars, shoots for lads' mags, fitness videos and reality shows. But I always turned them down.

author: Paul Gascoigne
text: I thought I did well for someone who has been out for 10 or 11 months. Then I was sub against Liverpool and tried to play for the guys and work on my fitness.

author: Karan Singh Grover
text: I grew up watching Salman Khan and Arnold Schwarzenegger, who have always juggled fitness with acting. In real life, I'm a fitness freak. Besides, it is nice to look at an actor who is fit, and if you become a role model, that's a perk.

author: Moshe Safdie
text: Beauty connotes humanity. We call a natural object beautiful because we see that its form expresses fitness, the perfect fulfillment of function.

author: Franka Potente
text: I've published one book before, and now I'm writing a book of essays and stories about life in Tokyo. And I have one book coming out in May in Germany, about fitness.

author: Tara Brach
text: I decided to write 'True Refuge' during a major dive in my own health. Diagnosed with a genetic disease that affected my mobility, I faced tremendous fear and grief about losing the fitness and physical freedom I loved.

author: Andriy Shevchenko
text: My fitness is good. I hope to improve it even further during training.

author: Kimberly Williams-Paisley
text: I don't do very well with extremes of any kind - extreme diets, extreme fitness - so moderation makes a lot of sense, and Hershey's has really great portion-friendly desserts to help people incorporate treats into their lifestyles so they don't feel like they're depriving themselves and are still living a balanced life.

author: Nikos Kazantzakis
text: Since we cannot change reality, let us change the eyes which see reality.

author: N. R. Narayana Murthy
text: Growth is painful. Change is painful. But, nothing is as painful as staying stuck where you do not belong.

author: Colin Kaepernick
text: People don't realize what's really going on in this country. There are a lot things that are going on that are unjust. People aren't being held accountable for. And that's something that needs to change. That's something that this country stands for: freedom, liberty and justice for all.

author: Charles M. Schwab
text: When you start in life, if you find you are wrongly placed, don't hesitate to change, but don't change because troubles come up and difficulties arise. You must meet and overcome and conquer them. And in meeting and overcoming and conquering them, you will make yourself stronger for the future.

author: D. H. Lawrence
text: Ethics and equity and the principles of justice do not change with the calendar.

author: Elon Musk
text: I think you should always bear in mind that entropy is not on your side.

author: Andy Warhol
text: Isn't life a series of images that change as they repeat themselves?

author: Dick Gregory
text: People with high blood pressure, diabetes - those are conditions brought about by life style. If you change the life style, those conditions will leave.

author: Timothy Leary
text: You're only as young as the last time you changed your mind.

author: Anne Wojcicki
text: The reality is that the only way change comes is when you lead by example.

author: Hoda Kotb
text: People think that you have to do something huge, like go to Africa and build a school, but you can make a small change in a day. If you change Wednesday, then you change Thursday. Pretty soon it's a week, then a month, then a year. It's bite-size, as opposed to feeling like you have to turn your life inside out to make changes.

author: Khloe Kardashian
text: I know my soul is beautiful I know I'm a good person. And that will never change for me.

author: Emma Goldman
text: The ultimate end of all revolutionary social change is to establish the sanctity of human life, the dignity of man, the right of every human being to liberty and well-being.

author: Tupac Shakur
text: What I learned in jail is that I can't change. I can't live a different lifestyle - this is it. This is the life that they gave and this is the life that I made.

author: Amitabh Bachchan
text: Audiences change because life changes. Countries change geographically, climatically, socially and morally. Many things happen, and cinema, in a sense, reflects what's happening in the world.

author: Yoko Ono
text: If your life changes, we can change the world, too.

author: John Podhoretz
text: Pop culture is a reflection of social change, not a cause of social change.

author: Winston Churchill
text: A fanatic is one who can't change his mind and won't change the subject.

author: Sarah Zettel
text: Becoming a mother cannot help but change things. An author's life is reflected in their writing, whether they want it to be or not, and parenthood is one of the biggest life changes there is.

author: Vivienne Westwood
text: It's a philosophy of life. A practice. If you do this, something will change, what will change is that you will change, your life will change, and if you can change you, you can perhaps change the world.

author: William James
text: To change ones life: Start immediately. Do it flamboyantly.

author: John Lennon
text: I'm not going to change the way I look or the way I feel to conform to anything. I've always been a freak. So I've been a freak all my life and I have to live with that, you know. I'm one of those people.

author: Sting
text: I can't really change my life to accommodate people who are jealous. I don't see why I should.

author: Dan Quayle
text: I believe we are on an irreversible trend toward more freedom and democracy - but that could change.

author: Marcus Aurelius
text: The universe is change our life is what our thoughts make it.

author: Leonardo da Vinci
text: He who is fixed to a star does not change his mind.

author: May Sarton
text: The garden is growth and change and that means loss as well as constant new treasures to make up for a few disasters.

author: Stacy London
text: Style can change your look, certainly, but it can also change your life.

author: Rush Limbaugh
text: When you talk about change, you know what makes it really tough for people is on the one hand you've got tradition, and on the other hand you've got change; in many people's mind, change equals modernization. Tradition, however. I'm a big tradition guy.

author: Walter Lippmann
text: Our conscience is not the vessel of eternal verities. It grows with our social life, and a new social condition means a radical change in conscience.

author: Max Muller
text: While the river of life glides along smoothly, it remains the same river; only the landscape on either bank seems to change.

author: Gianni Versace
text: I try to contrast life today is full of contrast... We have to change.

author: Alvin Toffler
text: Future shock is the shattering stress and disorientation that we induce in individuals by subjecting them to too much change in too short a time.

author: Isaac Asimov
text: It is change, continuing change, inevitable change, that is the dominant factor in society today. No sensible decision can be made any longer without taking into account not only the world as it is, but the world as it will be.

author: Katherine Mansfield
text: Everything in life that we really accept undergoes a change.

author: Leo Tolstoy
text: The changes in our life must come from the impossibility to live otherwise than according to the demands of our conscience not from our mental resolution to try a new form of life.

author: Ice T
text: Redemption just means you just make a change in your life and you try to do right, versus what you were doing, which was wrong.

author: Jenny Craig
text: A change in bad habits leads to a change in life.

author: Zygmunt Bauman
